tei:titleStmt.tei:title: pod 35 gsung 'bum/_tA ra nA tha/ （dpe bsdur ma/）

tei:div.tei:p: spyi khyab bsdu sgrig 'gan 'khur ba gtso bo/ gzan dkar thub bstan nyi ma/bsdu sgrig 'gan 'khur gzhon pa dang / gtso sgrig pa/ karma bde legs/gtso sgrig gzhon pa/ 'gro 'dul rdo rje/bsdu sgrig pa/ mun sel/ thub bstan nyi ma/ bstan 'dzin blo gros /zla ba bstan 'dzin/ shes rab bzang po/zhu dag dang dkar chag sgrig mkhan/ dpal ldan rgya mtsho/ phur pa phrin las/dkon mchog bsam gtan/ thub bstan nyi ma/ bstan pa dar rgyas/par sgrig lag rtsal pa/ tshe ring chos sgron/ shes rab dpal g.yang /bsod nams 'brug rgyas/

〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉ces pa'i dpe tshogs 'di ni dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis bsgrigs shing 'di ga dpe skrun khang dang mnyam 'brel gyis bskrun pa'i dpe rnying dpe tshogs shig yin la/de yang mkhas dbang gzan dkar rin po che thub bstan nyi ma mchog gis spyi'i gtso skyong gnang ste/dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis nye ba'i lo bcu tsam gyi ring la 'bad brtson chen pos bod kyi sa gnas gang sar bzhugs pa'i bod yig dpe rnying po ti khrir longs pa rang byung dang mi'i gnod 'tshes 'jig la nye ba'i nyen kha las bskyabs te legs par bsgrigs shing dkar chag tu btab/dpe thum gsol/dpe sgrom bzhengs te srung skyob mdzad gnang ba dang gnang mus su yod pa ni/rang re'i mes po'i shul nor srung skyob rgyun 'dzin dang bod rig pa'i gal che'i dpyad gzhi mkho 'don gyi dgos pa che ba ma zad/rang rgyal mi rigs rig gnas nor mdzod dar rgyas dang srung skyob bgyi ba'i 'phrin las gal chen zhig red/nye char dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang dang 'di ga dpe skrun khang gnyis zhib gros byas mthar/srol rgyun rig gnas srung skyob dang bod rig pa'i dpyad yig myur skyob dang cha tshang du gtong ba'i dmigs yul ngos 'dzin gcig gyur thog〈bka' gdams dpe dkon gces bshus〉zhes pa'i dpe rnying dpe dkon gyi dpe tshogs chen mo zhig mu mthud nas legs sgrig dang dpe skrun byed bzhin yod pa dang /da char yang dmigs yul dgos pa gcig gyur thog 〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉ces pa'i dpe rnying dpe dkon gal chen gyi dpe tshogs chen mo 'di nyid par skrun bya rgyu yin la/de yang sngon byon mes po mkhas dbang dam pa du mas shul du bzhag pa'i gsung 'bum dpe dkon gal chen rnams dang /'thar 'thor du bzhugs pa'i dpe dkon gal chen dag phyogs gcig tu bsdus te bsgrigs pa 'di'i nang don thad la/nang don rig pa dang /gso ba rig pa/tshad ma rig pa/sgra rig pa/bzo rig pa/lo rgyus/rtsis rig ༵//sa bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas kun 'dus pa'i dpe dkon nor bu dgos 'dod kun 'byung lta bu zhig ——

'a 'dra' dpe skrun mnyam las go skabs legs po nged cag dpe skrun khang la thob pa na tu skal ba bzang zhing gzi brdzid kyi 'os 'gan zhig tu brtsis te lo 'ga'i dpe skrun 'char gzhi gtso bo'i nang du bkod zin cing / las gzhi 'di la krung go'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug nye gnas kyi dbu khrid dang rgyal khab phyi nang gi bod rig pa'i mkhas dbang du mas gdeng 'jog dang mthong chen gyis skul ma yang thob/〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉 gi ma phyi phal cher ni dbu med bris rnying sha stag yin pas/ ma dpe gsal mi gsal dang skung yig mang zhing bris tshugs 'dra min gyi dbang gis klog dka' ba'ang shin tu mang po 'dug 'on kyang dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis lo mang ring nyams myong bsdu len dang mkhas dbang du mar bka' 'dri zhug par brten yig gzugs gsar rgyag dang phyogs sgrig thub pa byung / par shing du 'khod yod pa rnams kyang dpe rnying gzhan pa dang bsdur te gtan la phab yod pa bcas te zhib cha deb so so'i bsdu sgrig gsal bshad du gzigs par zhu/dpe rnying srung skyob dang phyogs sgrig dpe skrun gyi las ka 'di la rgyab skyor dang thugs khur gnang mkhan gyi mkhas dbang rnams dang / lhag par du krung rka'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi dbu khrid lhan rgyas dang / mkhas dbang thub bstan nyi ma rin po che mchog sogs kyis rgyab skyor dang mdzub ston gyi bka' drin bskyangs pa la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu rgyu dang / dpal brtsegs zhib 'ju ga khang gi 'gan 'dzin pa lhan rgyas dang / zhu dag pa/ yig rgyag pa sogs mdor na las gzhi 'di la lhag bsam dang 'bad brtson chen pos zhabs phyi zhu mkhan rnams la snying thag pa nas bka' drin che zhes zhu rgyu dang /dpe tshogs 'di'i dpe sgrig dang zhu dag thad la ha cang nan tan dang zhib tshanas bgyi khul byas mod/'on kyang nga tshor shes tshad dman pa'i dbang gis nor 'jug mi nyung ba yod srid pas dpyod ldan dag gis nor bcos yo bsrang gi dgongs 'char lhug stsol gnang bar zhu zhu/zhes krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang nas/spyi lo 2007lo'i zla ba dang po'i tshes 10la/

de la 'dir rang cag kha ba can gyi zhing 'dir chos rgyal lo paṇa rnams dang / sa dge bka' rnying sogs kyi mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i dam pa'i skyes bu rnams kyis/ zugad sgrub kyi shing rta chen po bco brgyad rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i chos brgyud dang bka' srol mtha' dag dang / de dang rjes su 'brel ba'i thun mong gi rig gnas sum rtags snyan ngag mngon brjod sdeb sbyor/ skar rtsis 'byung rtsis / sgra tshad bzo gso sogs mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa'i gzhung lugs zab cing rgya che ba myong la ma nor ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig 'chad nyan 'gyur gsum dang / bshad sgrub las gsum gyi sgo nas thog mar srol gtod/bar du gtan la phab/ rim bzhin dar rgyas btang ba sogs 'dzin skyong spel bar mdzad pa'i bka' drin bdag rkyen la brten nas/ dbus gtsang khams gsum du bzhugs so cog gi glegs bam thams cad gcig tu sbungs na ri rab lhun po'i gtos dang mnyam zhing / chos tshan gyi rnam dbye ji snyed yod pa grangs su bgrangs na nam mkha'i gza' skar tshogs kyang skyengs par byed pa zhig mchis pa tsam du ma zad / rgya bal hor sogs kyi yul gru kun tu ring dar khyab che/da lta'i char bod rig pa'am bod kyi shes rig ces su grags pa 'di nyid 'dzam gling shar nub kyi yul gru dag tu ring mched de/ dper na/ o ka si phor dhi dang / har wid lta bu yo rob dang / a ri sogs su grags chen gyi slob grwa chen mo —1—

rnams su bod yig gi dpe mdzod wo po yod par ma zad/ bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung slob gnyer byed sa'i sde tshan dang slob ma yang mi nyung ba yod/da ni gong du smras pa'i bshad sgrub shing rta chen po bco brgyad ces pa de gang dang gang yin pa'i ngo sprod mdo tsam zhu na/ de yang ji skad du/ 'jam mgon kong sprul rin po che'i zhal nas/ chos blon thon mi be+e ro ska cog zhung / /gnubs chen rin bzang rngog lo sa skya pa/ /bu ston bshad rgyun 'degs pa'i ka chen bcu// zhes dang / bod yul sgrub brgyud shing rta chen po brgyad/ /rnying ma bka' gdams lam 'bras bka' brgyud pa/ khangs pa zhi byed sbyor drug bsnyen sgrub bo/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ shes bya'i gzhung lugs sna tshogs kyi 'gyur khyad dang 'chad tshul gyi dbye bas bshad rgyun 'degs pa'i ka chen bcu dang / sgrub pa nyams su len tshul la brgyud pa'i khyad par dang man ngag gi dbye bas sgrub brgyud 'dren pa'i shing rta brgyad de/ bshad sgrub shing rta chen po bco brgyad rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i gsung rab rgya mtsho lta bu zhig bdag cag gi yab mes gong ma rnams kyis gces pa'i lus srog longs spyod thams cad phangs pa med par btang ste/ phyi rabs rang re'i brgyud 'dzin rnams la 'phran yun phan bde'i dpal la dmigs nas bzhag pa'i nor bu rin po che yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po mtha' yas pa zhig mchis/de dag las mang che ba rig gsar lo bcu'i god chag chen po sogs dus kyi rgud pa'i dbang gis sems med 'byung bzhi'i 'jig pa dang / sems ldan mi dang mi min gyi gnod pas nyams nyes chen por gyur pa ni rgya bod yongs grags ltar lags/—2—

rig gnas gsar brje'i mjug sgril ba dang changs cig tang gi yang dag pa'i srid jus kyi nyi 'od slar yang 'phros te/ tang dang rgyal khab kyis 'go khrid dang rtsa 'dzugs gnang nas/ dpe rnying 'thor bsdu dang / legs sgrig dpe skrun/ sgyur spel sogs kyi sgo nas rang rigs kyi rig gnas nyams pa sor chud dang / mi nyams gong 'phel gyi bya bar so so'i 'khos bstun gyi sri zhu sgrub pa'i skal ba bzang po'i dpal la longs su spyad du yod pa'i skabs 'dir/ rang re'i yab mes rnams kyis bzhag pa'i pha nor mang po zhig da dung yang nged cag gi bsod nams kyi bgo skal du lhag yod pa rnams la gces spras chen pos srung skyob dang dar spel byed rgyu ni mes rgyal gyis gnang ba'i las 'gan yin par ma zad/ 'u cag bod kyi rig gnas slob gso'i bya bar legs skyes 'bul mkhan gyi rgan dar 'bring gsum gyi shes yon can la mtshon na/ rang re'i phrag par bab pa'i gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i gzi 'od bla na 'bar ba'i 'os 'gan mchog tu gyur pa zhig kyang yin par sems/der brten/ phyogs dang ris su ma chad pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis ljags rtsom gnang ba'i gsung rab/ bshad sgrub shing rta bco brgyad las grub pa'i mdo sngags kyi gzhung bshad dang / chos 'byung dang gdan rabs/ rnam thar dang gsan yig brda sprod dang snyan ngag /rtsis dang gso rig sogs dpe dkon 'thor ba rnams bsdus/ chad pa rnams bsab/ nyams pa rnams gsos/ 'khru / gas pa rnams bsgrigs te dpe tshogs 'ga' rim pa bstar chags su par du bskrun pa dang bskrun rtsis las/ —3—

da lan 'dir jo nang rje bcun tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum dpe bsdur ma 'di rgya che'i gzigs pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du phul ba yin/'byung char nga tsho'i dpe tshogs dpar skrun zhu rgyu'i skor la lhag bsam ldan zhing mkhyen spyan yangs pa'i mkhas dbang rnams kyis dgongs 'char gyi bka' slob stsol gnang dang / dpe dkon gyi ma phyi g.yar gnang gi skyabs 'jug yong ba mkhyu/na mkhyu/na/ /zhor 'phros gsal 'debs zhu ba/ lhag par du da lta lus kyi lang tsho rgyas shing / sems kyi blo gros bkra ba'i gzhon skyes rnams la mtshon na/ snying pos dben pa'i kha pho 'don pa las/ zol med kyi lhag bsam dkar po snying la 'chang / don ldan gyi rnam dkar bya ba dang du len/ lhad med kyi chos dang rig gzhung slob gnyer byed/ 'khos bstun gyi sri zhu zhi las ka cung zad re sgrub nus na/mes rgyal la zhabs togo 'gru/ba/ rang rigs la legs skyes 'bul/ rang nyid kyi la rgya mngon thub pa zhig kyang 'ong ba ni mthong chos mngon gyur lags pas/ de bzhin dgongs dbyings su chub par zhu'o/ /phran 'brog rgan 'khyams po thub bstan nyi mas/spyi lo 2007pa'i zla tshes la gus phul/—4—

bsdu sgrig gsal bsdo/da/da lam nga tsho'i jo nang rje btsun tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs te par skrun zhus pa 'di ni/ gzan dkar mchog sprul thub bstan nyi ma'i bka' slob dang bdag rkyen 'og byung ba zhig yin/de yang spyir khong la gsung 'bum pod bzhi bcu tsam zhig yod tshul phyis su bris pa'i rnam thar 'ga' las gsal yang / dngos su pod bzhi bcu'i dkar chag kha gsal zhig da sngon nga tsho'i mjal rgyu ma byung / da lam dngos su mjal rgyu byung ba'i pod bco lnga ni/ deng sang yongs grags su rtag brtan par ma zhes 'bod pa 'di ni/ bod rab byung bcu pa'i me 'brug (spyi lo1616) la/ mnga' ris smad kyi gung thang gi rgyal rabs nyi shu rtsa gsum pa'am/ yang lugs gcig la dmar po sde bsgrangs na nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa bsod nams dbang phyug sdes yon bdag byas/ tā ra nā tha'i dngos slob gnya' yi ban+di dkon mchog legs pas/ thog ma'i mtshams sbyor dang par byang 'bri ba sogs byas te/ dus 'khor sngags phreng dang skad gnyis shan sbyar sogs chos tshan bcu bzhi shing par du bkos pa/ rtag brtan dam chos gling du spyan drangs te bzhugs su gsol/ de'i steng du rtag brtan rang nas brkos pa bcas pod — 1—

bco lnga tsam zhig yod pa de'i bu dpe par ma tshar gcig /rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos 'bras sbungs dpe mdzod khang du gdan drangs ba/ phyis dus 'gyur skabs su pe cing mi rigs pho brang du bzhugs kyang / deng seng bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du spyan drangs te bzhugs pa de yin/yang gangs can mkhas grub rim byon gyi ming mdzod las/ khong la gsung rtsom shin tu mang po yod par grags kyang rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos/gsung 'bum shing par rnams bka' rgya btab ste par mi chog pa mdzad pas da lta khong gi gsung rtsom rnams kha tshang ba ha cang dka'/ rgyal dbang lnga pa zhing du gshegs rjes/ blo gros brtan pas khong gi gsung 'bum la dkar chag bsdus pa zhig mdzad 'dug /de'i rjes zha lu ri phug sprul skus mdzad pa'i tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum dkar chag dwangs gsal me long zhes pa'i nang du/ pod ka nas tsa bar bcu bdun la chos tshan nyis brgya don gnyis dang / ldeb grangs bdun stong brgyad brgya lnga bcu bzhugs/da lta pe cing mi rigs pho brang du pod bcu bdun la chos tshan nyis brgya don brgyad dang / ldeb grangs bdun stong dgu brgya lnga bcu rtsa brgyad bzhugs zhes gsal yang nga tsho'i gong gi dkar chag gnyis po da sngon mjal rgyu ma rnyed/ de yang zha lu ri phug sprul skus dkar chag dwangs gsal me long zhes pa ljags rtsom gnang ste/ sngar —/sda brtan gyi shing par dus zing dbang

gis nyams chag shor ba rnams/ kha gso mdzad tshul thos kyang zhib phra'i lo rgyus kha gsal mjal rgyu ma byung / da lta dgen 'jam dbyangs rnams rgyal gyi dpe mdzod du bzhugs pa'i par rnying pod bcu bdun 'di/ zha lu ri phug sprul skus nyams gso mdzad pa de yin nam snyams ste/ da lta rtag brtan gyi par rnying bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa pod bco lnga dang / pod grangs dang chos tshan mang nyung tshig mtshams sogs cung mi 'dra ba yod pa'i phyir/da lam nga tshos khong gi gsung 'bum glog klad nang du bcug skabs kyi thog ma'i ma dpe ni/ nye char bla ma yon to bzang pos 'dzam thang du shing par la brkos pa'i glegs bam nyer bzhi can de la byas te zhu dag thengs gsum byas/ de rjes sngar jo nang rtag brtan du bzhugs pa rtsom pa po tā ra nā tha rang nyid kyi phyag dpe skabs 'gar phyag mchan yod pa/ da lta 'bras sbungs gnas bcu lha khang nang bzhugs bris ma pod chung bcu la chos wo43la bsdur gzhi dang / jo nang rtag brtan gyi par rnying pod bco lnga bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa dang / a ri ba dgen 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal gyi dpe mdzod du bzhugs pa par rnying pod bcu bdun yod pa gnyis phyogs bsdoms kyis/ par rnying pod nyi shu tsam la chos tshan 314byung ba la sdur byed byas te dpe bsdur thengs dang po zhus/—3—

de nas rtag brtan gyi par pod nyi shu la bsdur gzhi dang / 'dzam thang gi par mas sdur byed byas te dpe bsdur theng gnyis pa zhus pa yin/ 'on kyang par ma snga phyi gnyis dang bris ma gcig bcas dpe gsum po rtsa ba'i cha nas gcig mtshungs su bzhugs pa las khyad par chen po mi 'dug /cho ga'i skor la mi 'dra ba cung zad yod pa ni spo dkyus su shor ba yin 'dug pa rnams kyang / gug rtags nang du bcug te gsal po byas yod/ rtag brtan par rnying dang 'bras sbungs bris ma gnyis su dpe ma bzhugs pa/ 'dzam thang par ma'i nang bzhugs gsung thor bu'i skor wa rtags can dang / zha rtags can gnyis dang / za rtags can dbu ma theg mchog gi zin bris rab byed drug pa yan chad/ tā ra nā tha'i zhal gsung slob ma ye shes rgya mtshos zin bris su bkod pa dang / rab byed bdun pa brgyad pa gnyis dza 'go'i dge bzhes mchog grub rgya mtshos gsar du bsnan pa/ 'a rtags can nyang yul gyi lo rgyus tā ra nā thas zhabs btags mdzad par grags pa bcas chos tshan121la 'dzam thang gi par ma'i dpe gcig pu las/ rtag brtan par rnying dang 'bras sbungs bris ma gnyis kyi bsdur gzhi ma rnyed/ rtag brtan par rnying gcig pu las gzhan gnyis la med pa chos tshan4/ yang rtag brtan dang 'dzam thang par ma gnyis char med pa/ 'bras skrungs gnas bcu lha khang du bzhugs pa'i gral nas chos tshan bco brgyad la ldeb193gsar rnyed byung —4—

ba bcas la/ zhu dag byas te kha skong gi tshul du bzhag yod pa bcas khyon bsdoms deb bzhi bcu zhe lnga la chos tshan900yod/ da lta nga tsho'i ma dpe g.yar rgyu ma rnyed pa sngon rtsom pa po'i phyag dpe'i gral nas yin pa/ 'brasasbungs gnas bcu lha khang / dpe rtags phyi298nang bzhugs gtam du bya ba nor bu'i 'byung gnas ldeb6/ yang phyi508nang bzhugs 'khor lo gsum gyi rnam bzhag chos dbyings rgya mtsho'i rgyan rnam par bkod pa ldeb92/ ste lag bris kyi chos tshan gnyis po ma 'ongs par dpe g.yar thabs bya dgos/da lta nga tshos dpe bsdur dang zhu dag gi skabs su ma dpe rtsa 'dzin byas te/ dpe gsum mi 'dra ba'i tshe rtag brtan la〈〈rta〉〉rtags 'di dang /'dzam thang la rtags〈〈rjo 〉〉'di/ dag cha nor bcos la gug rtag 'di/ 1dang / mchan rnams gug rtag〈 〉'di'i nang du blug yod/gsal bshad zhu rgyu zhig la deb bzhi pa'i nang du/ kun mkhyen dol po pa'i gsung chos tshan bzhi/ rig 'dzin tshe dbang kun khyab kyi gsung lho sgo'i cho ga zhes pa'i chos tshan gcig bcas 'dzam thang par mar bzhag yod pa dang / yang sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen gyi gsung dus 'khor phyag rgya'i skor chos tshan gcig rtag brtan par rnying du yod pa rnams rang 'jag bzhag yod pa dang / khong gi rang rnam gtso bor gyur pa'i lo rgyus zhal gdams rnams su/gtsang gi yul skad yin nam snyam pa'i tha snyad go dka' ba mang po zhig —5—

bed spyad gnang ba dag kyang rang sor bzhag yod/da lam bka' 'bum 'di rtsis 'khor nang du blugs pa'i 'gro song tsā 'dra tshogs pa nas zhus shing / par skrun tshar lnga brgya'i 'gro song bod rig pa dpe skrun khang nas bgyis/ tshar brgyad brgya'i 'gro song hrin krin sogs kyi rgya'i sbyin bdag rnams kyis gnang zhing / tshar nyis brgya'i 'gro song tsā 'dra tshogs pa nas bgyis pa bcas kyi mthun rkyen las/ da lam dngos su par du bskrun thub pa byung ste rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du phul ba yin/las gzhi 'dir bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang nas ma dpe pod bco lnga g.yar gnang byung ba dang / 'dzam thang bla ma mun sel mchog nas kyang ma dpe btsal rogs dang / go rim sgrig rgyu/ zhu dag bcas la rogs ram gang mang gnang ba dang / khams sprul bsod nams don grub mchog nas nyang yul chos 'gyung zhu dag gi rogs ram gnang ba dang / bla ma dpal ldan rgya mtshos zhu dag gi las ka spyi'i thugs 'gan che bzhes gnang ba bcas la thugs rje che zhu rgyu ba'o/ /dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas karma bde legs kyis/—6—

khong ni slob dpon wo tshu rno dza 1 6 3 'byu / nga gnas dang / paṇ+ḍi ta gha ya dha ra/gnyos lo tsā ba/ kha rag sgom chung sogs skyes chen mang pos byin gyis brlabs shing / bod skyong brtan ma bcu gnyis kyi nang tshan kha rag khyung btsun gyi gnas jo mo kha rag ces pa'i 'dabs/ chu bo chen po lo hi ta'i nye 'gram du rwa lo tsā ba chen po'i brgyud pa bar ma chad par byon pa la/ shar nub gnyis su gyes pa las shar ba kun dga' seng ge'i gdung brgyud/ sngags 'chang tshul khrims rgya mtsho'i sras rnam rgyal phun tshogs dgung lo bzhi bcu zhe dgu pa rje 'di'i yab dang /yum rdo rje bu dga' dgung lo bcu dgu pa gnyis kyi sras su bod rab byung bcu pa'i shing phag (spyi lo1575) la/ ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas sku 'khrungs te mes pos pad+ma sri gcod rdo rje zhes mtshan gsol/sku bltams te zla ba brgyad song rjes bzhengs nas gom pa spo thub pa dang / dgung lo gcig tsam nas gsung byon te nga bla ma kun dga' grol mchog yin zhes zhal gyis bzhes pa dang / gzhan yang sku gong ma'i rten gsum dang spyin bdag / nye gnas sogs kyi lo rgyus gsal bar gsungs pa sogs kyis/jo nang bla ma kun dga' grol mchog gi yang srid 'khrul med du shes te/ dgung lo bzhi par jo nang mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho dang / zhabs drung bkra shis — 1—

stobs rgyas dbang po sogs rta pa brgya dang drug cu rtsa lnga tsam gdan 'dren du byung nas/ gtsang phyogs su gdan drangs te sku gong ma'i slob ma rdo ring kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ lha dbang grags pa/ mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho/ mkhas dbang byams pa lhun grub/ rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang sogs kyis chos lung byang rtser khri ston mdzad/ rdo ring pa chen po 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi drung du/ thog ma'i rten 'brel du sgrol dkar gyi rjes gnang dang / gshed dmar lha lnga'i dbang / lam 'bras gtso bor gyur pa'i dbang dang gdams pa mang po gsan/de nas dgung lo drug pa nas yi ge sbyor klog phul du phyin pa mkhyen te/dbang dang rjes gnang sogs yig thog nas gnang ba la dka' tshegs med pa byung /dgung lo brgyad par rje gong ma'i dngos slob mkhas dbang byams pa lhun grub yongs 'dzin du bsten nas/ tshad ma rigs gter sbyangs pas gzhung don la go ba rnyed rung blo 'dzin la zla ba lnga tsam 'gor/ gas yang mdo rgyud kyi gzhus lugs mang por gsan bsam mdzad pas mkhyen rtogs rgyas/dgung lo brgyad la phebs skabs stag lung kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan gdan drangs te thog mar bka' gdams glegs bam gyi lung zhus te/ de nas bod rab byung bcu pa'i chu rta khrums stod zla ba'i tshes lnga (spyi lo1582)la/ chos lung byang rtse'i mchod khang gi yang thog tu/ dpal stag lung pa chen po rje btsun kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyi —2—

mkhan po dang / 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos slob dpon dang / rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang pos dus go ba/chos rje mchod gnas pas grogs dan bgyis te yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen dang bar ma rab byung sngon du 'gro bas dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes te/ mtshan kun dga' snying po bkra shis rgyal mtshan zhes gsol/ dag pa'i gzigs snang du rgya gar gyi paṇa chen dz+wa la nā thas tā ra nā tha zhes pa'i mtshan gsol/chos rje brag stod pa lha dbang grags pa'i drung nas chos drug dang phyag chen sogs/ zab chos mang po gsan pas nang zab lam gyi rtogs pa mngon du gyur/ rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang las dus 'khor gtso bor gyur pa'i zab chos mang po gsan/ mkhan po lung rigs rgya mtsho'i mdun dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang dang rgyud bshad/ dpal rgyal ba jo nang pa'i lugs kyi spyor drug gi zab khrid mtha' dag gsan te nyams len mdzad/ bu lugs kyi sbyor drug gi khrid kyang rdzogs par gsan/ gzhan yang jo zhal bla ma mang po'i gdams khrid dang bka' bstan sogs rgya gzhung gi man ngag mang po dang / kun mkhyen dol bo pa'i gsung 'bum sogs lung mang po gsan/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes/rdo rje 'dzin pa ye shes dbang po sogs las/ sa skya jo nang shangs pa zhwa lu 'brug pa kaX tshang / stag lung sogs kyi chos skor bcas rgyud sde bzhi'i dbang khrid man ngag mtha' dag ma lus par gsan/ gzhan yang rgya gar gyi grub chen gu ru lho phyogs pa sangs rgyas sbas pa'i mgon po/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga'i mtshan can sogs bzhes gnyen mang po'i zhabs la gtugs te/ zhung tshal pa'i chos —3—

skor dang / yang dgon pa'i bka' 'bum/ dwags po lha rje'i bka' 'bum/ ri chos ma drug gi khrid/ mai tri bcu gsum ma'i dbang / sangs rgyas thod pa'i dbang /o rgyan bsnyen sgrub skor gyi khrid lung yongs rdzogs/ mar pa nas brgyud rngog pa'i bka' babs dgyes rdor yab yum/ gur rigs bsdus/ gdan bzhi yab yum/ ma hā mā ya ste drug 'e ti nas brgyud pa 'jam dpal gsang ldan bcas rngog dkyil bdun/rngog ṭīka rin chen rgyan 'dra'i mdzub khrid/brtag gnyis sa rngog gnyis ka'i bshad srol/ stag lung thang pa'i bka' 'bum/sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang /ni gu chos drug 'jam dkar gyi rjes gnang /'grel chen dri med 'od dang /rdo rje snying 'grel dang / dgyes pa rdo rje'i rgya gzhung / dgyes rdor skor la gtso che'i chos sna sum cu so dgu dang / gdan bzhi'i khrid tshul rgyas pa/ ār+ya de wa'i chos lnga sogs rgya gzhung bcu/ sa ra he'i chos lnga/ nag po'i gzhung drug ྅ hi smad lnga/dril bu skor gsum/ gshed dmar bi rū pa'i gzhung brgyad/ ku ku ri pa'i chos bdun/ sgrub thabs mtsho skyes sogs dgyes rdor gyi gzhung shin tu mang po dang / dpe med 'tsho'i sbyor drug rtsa 'grel/dza la rgyu ri'i do ha/ sems kyi phyag rgya sogs mdo sngags spyi dang / khyad par du gsang sngags rgyud sde'i dbang bskyed rdzogs mtha' yas pa gsan/de nas dgung lo bcu bdun pa rab byung bcu pa'i lcags yos hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu bdun (spyi lo1591)la/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis mkhan po/ bla ma byams pa lhun grub kyis las kyi slob dpon/dge ba'i bshes gnyen blo bzang pa dang / rje drung kun dga' bsod nams —4—

sogs kyis kha skong gnang ste bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi sdom pa bzhes te/ phyi ltar ngur smig gi rgyal mtshan 'chang ba'i dge slong 'dul ba 'dzin pa/nang ltar gzhan phan snying rje chen pos thugs rgyud yongs su brlan pa'i rgyal sras sems pa chen po/ gsang ba bskyed rdzogs kyi zab gnad la mnga' brnyes pa'i sngags 'chang rdo rje 'dzin pa zhig tu gyur/de nas bsam sdings su dpal ldan bla ma dam pa byams pa'i mtshan can gyi drung du rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang yongs rdzogs dang / dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dbang bcas zhug/ bla ma dpal ldan chos kyi bzang po'i zhal snga nas/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang yongs su rdzogs pa bdag po chen po'i mthar thug pa dang / gsang bdag 'khor lo chen po/dril bu lha lnga/ gzungs grwa lnga/ dril bu lus dkyil sogs dbang mang po gsan/ g.yin yang dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams las/ gsang 'dus 'phags lugs dang / zhabs lugs/ gshi/na rje gshed dgra gdong 'jigs gsum/gshed dmar bram ze dpal 'dzin gyi lugs/ gdan bzhi'i gzhung bdun/sangs rgyas thod pa phyogs kyi rgya gzhung mang po dang / rgyud sde 'og ma ci rigs pa dang / grub pa sde bdun/ snying po skor drug yid la mi byed pa'i chos skor rnams dang / phreng ba skor gsum/ rgyud 'grel grags can phal che ba dang /bslab btus dang / byang sa sogs gzhung mang por thos bsam gnang bas blo gros kyi lus stobs ches cher rgyas te gzhud lugs rab 'byams smra ba'i mkhas pa chen por gyur/—5—

de nas bla ma kun dga'i mtshan can dang slob dpon rin po ches bka' bzhin/ rje 'di nyid dgung lo nyer gcig pa rab byung bcu pa'i shing lug hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes lnga(spyi lo1595)la/ ri khrod chen po jo mo nang gi gdan sa par bskos pa bzhin bla brang gi rtsis sprod rtsis len gnang rjes/ skyid phug tu zla gcig lhag tsam bcad mtshams la bzhugs te phag mo'i ljags bsnyen gnang skabs/ rmi lam du ngo bo slob dpon pad+ma yin pa'i rnal 'byor pa gzi brjid che ba zhig gi drung du/ dwags po rnyi ba rin po che dge bshes bgres song gi rnam par bzhugs 'dug pa las/ rnal 'byor pa'i zhal nas nga dang dol po pa ngo bo gcig yin gsung pa dang / bod kyi dge bzhes bgres song des kyang nga yang ngo bo gcig yin gsung pa rmis pas/ dang po pad 'byung gi rten 'brel de sad de sgom gyi sa bon thebs/ bar skabs su dwags po rin po ches chos kyis rtogs pa brnyes/ phyis kun mkhyen chen po'i bzhed dgongs ltar nyams su myong ba'i brda ru go / de nas rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta sdi rta nan+da dang pra yā mā nan+da gnyis dang mjal 'phrad mdzad de gsung gleng gnang bas/ khong gnyis grub mtha' nang par 'dug kyang pha mes kyi chos rig byed la yang chen che bas/ phyi rol pa'i lha gcig gnyis bsten gyin 'du gi pas dbang chos sogs ni ma zhus/ rig pa'i gnas thams cad la shin tu mkhas par 'dug pas dogs gcod mang du bgyis shing bstan bcos kyang than thun bsnyur/ bha ra ta dang rā ma ya ṇa la sogs pa'i lo rgyus kyang mang du thos/ de skabs rā ma ya ṇa'i srung ma ha nu ma tha'i cho 'phrul lus —6—

byang chen gyi ri dang mnyam pa'i spre'u dang / bha ra ta'i srung ma rgyal po sgyi ma dngos su mthong bas paṇ+ḍi ta na re/ khyod la 'go bar 'dug mthu dang snyan grags longs spyod r+ṣa po yong gsungs na yang / chos la mi dad pa'i lha 'dre bsten pas ci bya snyam nas yal bar dor ba yin zhes gsungs/lo dus chag med jo nang du spyor drug gi khrid gsungs pas ngo ma 'phrod pa gcig kyang ma byung / rgya gar gyi slob dpon su ni khyu ṇa shrī dang puṇ+ḍa badz+ra sogs las zab khrid kyi gdams pa mang po gsan/ jo nang du sgrub mchod la dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs te/ 'dus pa bdun brgya tsam la dbang bcu gcig pa rdzogs par gnang / dgung grangs nyer drug skor rwa sgreng du phebs te tshogs su chos 'brel tsam dang / rje tsong kha pa'i bzhugs khri'i steng nas lam rim gsungs/dgung lo nyer dgu par jo nang du bzhugs skabs tho rengs shig la rje btsun byams pas zhal gzigs te/ khong rang la thim pa'i gzigs snang byung bas gzhan stong dbu ma'i grub mtha' la nges shes gting nas rnyed/ kun mkhyen dol po pas zhal yang yang gzigs nas lung bstan gnang ba dang /gzim lam du sham+bha lar phyin nas rigs ldan sprul pa'i sku dang mjal te chos gsan pa'i snang ba sogs gzigs snang mang po byung /dgung lo so dgu par chos 'khor lha sar phebs nas dar chen mang po bslangs te jo bo'i mdun thugs smon zab rgyas gnang / de nas kun mkhyen dol po pa'i sku brnyan gsung byon ma dang / thugs rje chen po/ tshe dpag med bcas —7—

byin rlabs can gyi rten gsum po'i mdun du mchod 'bul dang thugs smon rgya chen gnang ste smon lam rgyal ba rgya mtsho yang brtsams/dgung lo zhe gcig pa rab byung bcu pa'i shing yos hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes bcu gcig (spyi lo1615)la/ gtsang pa sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal gyis chos gzhis dang / lha 'bangs sogs rgya cher phul nas mthun rkyen sbyar ba las/dpal rtag brtan dam chos gling nges don dga' ba'i tshal gyi gnas gzhi'i las grwa btsugs te/ phyi gtsug lag khang dang grwa khang brgya phrag tsam lcags ri dang bcas pa/ nang gi rten sangs rgyas rabs bdun dang / tshe dpag med/ sgrol ma/yum chen mo/ dzam bha la sogs gser zangs las grub pa mang po dang / dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i sku zhal phyag yongs rdzogs gser zangs las grub pa dang /bde gshegs mchod rten cha brgyad sogs rten gsum dpag tu med pa bzhengs/jo nang du yang lha khang gsar bzhengs dang nang rten byams chen thog tshad gnyis tsam gser zangs las grub pa sogs mang po bzhengs/ gzhan yang lha bzo sogs lag rtsal pa rnams dang po rgya bal sogs nas gdan drangs/ de nas bris pa dang / spar brko shing bzo sogs lag rtsal pa gso skyong gnang bas/las rigs lag rtsal pa rnams kyang gzhan la re mi dgos pa byung ste/ bka' bstan 'gyur ro cog tshar mang po dang / bka' 'bum skor po ti bzhi bcu shing par du brkos pa sogs rten gsum mang po gsar bzhengs gnang /skabs shig ri bo che nas rgya dpe pod bcu tsam zhig 'byor byung ba'i nang / yar klung lo tsā ba'i phyag dpe ngo ma dus 'khor 'grel wo pod gnyis —8—

'dug dus 'khor rgyud kyi dpe de dbus phyogs nas snga mo zhig tu lag son byung ba dang / 'grel pa 'di skabs su rnyed pa la ya mtshan chen po byung ste thengs mang bklags pas zung sbyor la yang blo skyed chen po byung / gzhan yang dbang mdor bstan gyi 'grel pa don dam bsdus pa'i mdzad byang la nā ro pa'i mtshan yod pa dang / kyai rdo rje'i 'grel pa rdo rje'i tshig bsdus kyi mdzad byang du byang chub bzang po'i skad dod bo dhi bha dra zhes yod pa sogs mang po byung /yang skabs shig gtsang pa sde srid kyis sog po'i steng du dmag dpung chas rtsis la srung 'khor dang sku rim gnang ba'i tshe/ khong ni rje tsong kha pa chen por lhag tu dad pa che ba dang / khyad par du chos sde chen po 'bras skrungs la nye sems kyi bag chags shin tu che ba zhig yod pas/ chos sde chen po de nyid dar zhing rgyas pa dang rtsod pa 'jam po'i sgo nas zhi ba'i smon lam btab kyang / nus pa ma thon pa ni phyogs gnyis ka las ngan gyi dbang gis ded pa la g.yol thabs bral zhes gsungs/ de nas dpal 'khor bde chen/ rtse chen chos sde/'jag bsam gnyis/ thar pa gling / rtag brtan chos 'phel sogs dbus gtsang gi chos sde mang por chos dang longs spyod kyi bsnyen bkur rgya chen gnang ste bskyangs/de nas dgung grangs re gcig bzhes pa rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing phag (spyi lo1635) la/ rtag brtan dam chos gling nges don dga' ba'i tshal gyi gdan sa 'jam dbyangs sprul sku sangs rgyas rgya mtsho la gtad de/ chos lung rtse dang jo mo nang du dus khrid phyag len rgyas pa gnang nas/ da res ma gtogs —9—

'dir chos mi 'chad gsungs te bu slob rnams la zhal ta mang po gnang ste/ lo de'i nag pa zla ba'i tshes nyer brgyad la zhi bar gshegs so//slob ma/ sprul sku sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ mkhas dbang ye shes rgya mtsho/mkhan chen rin chen rgya mtsho/ mkhas grub blo gros rnam rgyal rnams dang / sgam po sprul sku/ chos rje ngag dbang pa/ bla ma chu bo chung ba'i sku skye/ mkhan po kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ sprul sku ngag gi dbang po/ tre bo sprul sku/chos rje rin stengs pa/ dus 'khor shar chen pa/ chos rje lha bo pa/ dge slong snying po mtha' yas/ byams pa yon tan mgon po/ ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ mi pham dkon mchog legs pa/ kun dga' 'phrin las dbang mo/gtsang gi rgyal sras kun dga' bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan sogs mang po byung /gzhan yang bstan pa'i spyin bdag gtsang pa sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal/ byang bdag bkra shis stobs rgyal/ yar 'brog bstan 'dzin mi 'gyur dbang gi rgyal po sogs mang ngo/ /dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas karma bde legs kyis/—10—

shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i snying po'i mdo rnam par spund pa sngon med legs bar/da bzhugs/ 1sher phyin snying po'i mdo'i tshig 'grel rmad du byung ba bzhugs/ 168'phags pa bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam gyi rgya cher 'grel pa bzhugs/ 188'phags pa byams pa'i smon lam gyi rnam par bsha/da pa bzhugs/ 285tshigs bcad gcig pa'i rnam bshad sogs bzhugs/ 323tshigs bcad nyung ngu'i bstod pa rnam par 'grel pa bzhugs/ 346'phags pa sgo drug gzu ngas kyi rnam par bshad pa bzhugs/ 350bcom ldan 'das tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa'i gzungs mdor grags pa bzhugs/ 363bkra shis kyi rnam bshad bzhugs/ 383

par ba4/da pa sngon med legs bshad bzhugs/oṃ swā sti/ bcom ldan 'das ma shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i snyingapo'i 'grel pa sngon med legs bshad zhes bya ba/ sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/khyab dang rtag pa'i rang bzhin can/ /rgyal ba thugs rje'i bdag nyid la/ /gu gi(pas btud nas mdo 'di'i don/ /cha tsam 'byed la spro ba skyes/ /de la mdo 'di'i ming ni bcom ldan 'das ma shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i snying po zhes bya ste/ de la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zhes bya ba ni/ji skad du 'phags pa thogs med zhabs kyis gang gsungs pa de kho na phyogs kyi glang po'i zhal snga nas kyis kyang drangs pa/ shes rab pha rol phyin gnyis med/ /ye shes de ni de bzhin gshegs/ /sgrub bya de don sbyor ba yi/ /gzhudalam dag la de sgra yin/ zhes gsungs te/ rang bzhin sher phyin dang / 'bras bu sher phyin dang / lam sher phyin te/ brjod bya don gyi sher phyin rnam grangs gsum dang / gzhung sher phyin ni/ rjod byed tshig gi sher phyin te/ sher phyin gyi rnawagrangs bzhi'o/ /de la rang bzhin sher phyin ni/ chos thams cad kyi dzinasalugs spros pa dang bral ba'i ye shes chos dbyings gdod ma nas gnas pa gang yin pa ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po zhes bya ba'i tha snyad gang la 'jagapa'i gzhi de'o/ /de nyid gzhi lam 'bras bu gang gi yang ldog cha dang ma sbrel

bar/ rang rkang du bzhag pa'i tshe rang bzhin zhes bya zhing / gnas lugs de nyid de bzhin gshegs pa ste/ don dam pa'i sangs rgyas dngos kyang yin la/ de sgrib gnyis byang zhing tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i skyes bur thob pa na/ skyes bu de'i 'bras bur 'jog dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan dang sbrel nas/ 'bras bu sher phyin cesabya zhing / don la ye shes gcig nyid sangs rgyas kyi skyes bu kho na la ltos nasa'abras bu dang / gzhi lam 'bras bu'i chos spyi'i mtshan nyid kyi sgo nas rangabazhin du bzhag lko /de bas na 'bras bu de dngos ni gdod ma rang byung yin pa'iphyir/ lam gyis bskyed mi dgos kyang / gang zag des 'bras bu de thob cingamangon du 'gyur ba ni/ lam gyis bskyed dgos pa'i phyir/ 'phags pa'i lamogyis bsdus pa spros bral rtogs pa'i ye shes ni lam sher phyin no/ /de gsum brjod byar ston par byed pa'i ngag tshig de bzhin gshegs pa'i bka' yin pa de la ni/ gzhung sher phyin ces bya ste/ skabs 'dir shesarab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zhes pa yang gzhung sher phyin no/ /gzhung de yang rnam pa gsum yod de/ sangs rgyas rang snang gi gsung dbyings theg pa chen po'i mdo sdeni/ gnyis med kyi ye shes nyid rnam pa thams cad par shar ba'i nang tshan gyi mdo sde'i dag gi rnam pa don dam de yin pas 'di ni rang bzhin sher phyin nam 'bras bu sher phyin dang ngo bo gcig ste gzhung dang po'o/ /gzhan 'phags pa dngaso so skye bo rnams kyi yid la sgra phyi'i rnam par shar ba'i ming tshig yi ge'i tshogs pa theg chen gyi mdo sde ni gzhung gnyis pa'o/ /de dang mthun par ngag tu brjod pa'i sgra ni gzhung sher phyin gsum pa ste/ phyi ma 'di gnyis ni/ rang bzhin 'bras —2—

bu lam gsum las ro bo shin tu tha dad mod kyi sangs rgyas rnams kyi smon lam las byung ba/ chos kyi sku'i rgyu mthun pa sgrib gnyis spong bar byed pa'i nus mthucan yin pa'i phyir/ zag med kyi chos dang / rnam par byang ba'i dmigs pa dang/yongs grub kyi khongs su gtogs pa yin par shes par bya'o/ /de dag ni zhib mor dpyad pa'i snying po yin la/ dpyad pa ma btang bar rags bshad du byas na/chos dbyings gnyis med ye shes kun khyab tsam rang bzhin dang / chos dbyingasade sgrib pa spangs pa'i dag pa gnyis ldan sangs rgyas kyi chos sku ni 'bras bu dang / de thob byed rnam par mi rtog pa'i sgom pa ni lam dang / de gsu༅po ston byed sangs sa rgyas kya bka' ni gzhung sher phyin no/ /zhes kyang rnam par bzhagago /gzhan yang theg pa chen po'i mdo sde rgyas pa mtha' dag shes rab pha chol tu phyin pa brjod byar ston par byed pa'i phyir/ nges par na gzhung shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yin mod kyi/ sher phyin gyi mtshan mdo thams cad la ma gragasapas/ skabs 'dir mdo sde gang la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mtshan btags pa de nyid nges par bzung ngo / /bcom ldan 'das ma zhes pa ni gongadu ji skad bstan pa'i rang bzhin dang 'bras bu sher phyin de nyid/ sangs rgyasanyid yin pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das zhes bya la/de'i ngo bor spyir ( 〈rdza〉 gi sbyor ba ) thabs dang shes rab zung du 'jug pa yin kyang / skabs 'dir shes rab kyi cha gtso bor smos te/ brtsatshaldan 'das ma zhes mo rtags kyi sgras bstan pa yin no/ /de ston par byed pa'i gzhung la yang bcom ldan 'das ma zhes mtshan du gsol zhing / de ltar na —3 —

bcom ldan 'das ma shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mdo 'bum pa la sogs pa thams cad kyi brjod bya'i don 'dus shing / tshig shin tu nyung ngus ston pa'i phyirasnying po zhes bya'o/ /mdo rgyas pa de dag dang gzhung 'di la brjod bya'i ngo bo rgya tshechung gi khyad par yod par 'dod pa mi 'thad la/ brjod bya ston tshul rnam grangasami 'dra ba mang nyung gi khyad par ni shin tu che'o/ /de la mkhas pa chen po 'ga' zhig 'di skad gsung ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ 'bus pa la sogasartepa sher mdo mtha' yas pa rnams yin la/ de'i don gyi snying po'i mchog gi rnamathar sgo gsum mo/ /rnam thar sgo gsum rtogs pa'i ye shes ni/ 'a mi sher phyin gyi snying po yin la/ de nyid cha tshang bar ston byed kyi mdo yang gzhung sher phyin gyisnying por 'gyur bas/ tshig nyung ngus de 'dra ston pa ni sher phyin gyi snying po'o/ /de yang mdo 'dir stong pa nyid dang mtshan nyid med pa dang / ma skyes pa dang / ma'agags pa dang / drim med pa dang / drim dang bral ba med pa dang /drib med pa dang / gang ba med pa ste rnam grangs brgyad gsungs so/ /de'i dang po gnyisastong nyid dang / bar ba bzhi mtshan med dang / tha ma gnyis smon med do//gzugs sogs chos rnams ngo bo nyid med pa dang / rang spyi'i mtshan nyid kyisastongs pa'i phyir stong nyid dang / kun nas nyon mongs kyi rten 'brel la bskyed byed kyi rgyu ma grub cing / rnam byang gi rten 'brel la 'gog byed kyi rgyu mgrub pa dang / dri ma ni kun nas nyon mongs yin la/ dri ma dang bral ba ni rnam par byangaba'o/ /bzhi po de kun byang gi rgyu'i don dang 'brel bas/ de dag la blang dor gyi mtshan ma ma dmigs pa'i phyir mtshan ma med pa dang / skyon bri ba dang yon tan —4—

gyis gang ba ma grub ste/ bsal bzhag med pas na/ skyon spong yon tan thob pa'i phyir mi smon pas smon pa med pa'o/ /de la gcig du bral gyi rig pasarobos stong pa dang / rdo rje gzegs mas rgyu'i mtshan ma med pa dang / yod med skye 'gog gi 'bras bu la smon pa med pa rnams grub la/ don de tsam zhig gis yumagyi snying por 'gyur zhing / gzhi lam 'bras gsum la rmongs pa sel ba'i don du/rnam thar sgo gsum du phye ba yin gyi/ ngo bo'i sgo nas ni stong nyid gcig pura'adus so zhes gsungs te/ gzhung gi tshig don 'chad pa'i skabs rnam pa gzhan du bshad dgos kyang / mtshan don gyi skabs 'dir bshad tshul 'du yang khasablang bar bya'o/ /de la mdo 'dis brjod bya'i don stong nyid kho na gtso borabastan pa yin na/ stong nyid de yang ji skad du/ chos dbyings bstod pa lagastong pa nyid ni ston pa'i mdo/ /rgyal bas ji snyed gsungs pa gang / /de dag kun gyis nyon mongs bzlog khams de nyams par byed ma yin/ /zhes dang/ rangabazhin gsum la 'jug pa'i sgrub pa las kyang / kun btags dang ni gzhan gyi dbang / /nyon mongs mtshan nyid shes par bya/ /rnam par byang ba'i rang bzhin ni/ /yongs su grub par 'dod pa yin/ /zhes kyang gsungs te/ lung don dang lam bsgoms pas rtogs pas btags pa'i chos nyon mongs rnams 'gog pa yin mod/ yongs grub rang bzhin gyis dag pa'i khams/ chos dbyings dam pa zad mi shes de ni/ stong gzhi'i ngo bor rtag tu yod do/ /de'i phyir stong rkyang du blta bar mi bya ste/ dkon mchog brtsegs pa las/ gang zhig stong pa khonarabalta gyur pa/ /de ni gsor mi rung zhes rgyal bas gsungs/ /zhes dang / klu sgrub — 5 —

kyis kyang / gang dag stong pa nyid lta ba/ /de dag sgrub tu med par gsungs/zhes so/ /rang stong par grags pa rnying pa rnams kyis bsam pa/ stong pa yangamistong pa la bltos pa'i phyir/ mi stong pa'i chos mi srid pas stong pa yang mi srid de/de'i phyir kho bo cag bsam byung gi rigs pas kyang stong par mi 'dzin la/ sgo༅pa'i tshe gang du yang rnam par mi rtog pa'i phyir skyon med do snyam na/ mi stong pa gtan nas mi srid par gob de ka bsam byung ni blos stong rkyang du lta ba zang ma yin pa'i steng du/ stong pa yang mi srid par go bsan/ de bas kyang ches shin tustong par 'dzin pa ma rungs par song ste/ grong khyer gyi mi rnams shi bas stongasapar gyur pa'i rjes su/ khyim rnams kyang zhig na tshes stongs par 'gyur ba bzhin no/ /des na bsam byung de ni stong par 'dzin pa yin pa grub la/ gzhan yangadangos gzhi mi rtog pa tsam yin du chug kyang / 'dzin pa mngon 'gyur ba'i rnamapar rtog pa log pa tsam gyi sgom pa ni/ stong nyid du blta ba rang ta de min shasache yang de tsam zhig sgrib pa gang gi yang gnyen por 'gyur ba ma yin te/ de 'drade sngar brjod pa'i lta ba de dang 'brel lam ma 'brel/ 'brel na thi de posagazhi'i skabs der 'dzin stangs mi gsal ba'i cha shas kho nas yon tan du ma ster nus shing 'tshengs na ma gtogs/ sbyor ba thos bsam skabs las lhag rgyu ci yang ma byung la/ de ni stong rkyang du 'dzin pa de kho nas bsgos pa yang yin no/ /'dzin stangs mi gsal ba tsam de la ni/ ngo mtshar ba'i phan yon cung zad kyang yod pa ma mthong la de 'dra ba'i rnam rtog rags pa log tsam kho na don du gnyer ba la ni/ stong pa dang mi stong pa'i dpyad pa gang yang sngon du 'gro mi—tshu1—

dgos so/ /yang sngar gyi dpyad pa dang phyis kyi sgom pa ma 'brel ba ga thar pa'i don dag sgom pa'i don du dpyad pa de yang mi dgos par 'dod na/ thug med kyidapyad pa 'dis ci zhig bya ste rtsod pa lhur len kho nar zad do/ /de bsan dbu ma 'jug pa las/ rtog rnams log par gyur pa gang yin de/ rnam par dpyad pa'i 'bras bur mkhas rnams gsungs/ /zhes 'byung ste/ lta ba mtho ru re ba 'angathang che che mo/ don go bde bde 'dra ba/ tshig legs legs ltar snang ba 'di 'dra'i rigs mang pos/ rgya bod kyi mkhas par grags pa phal che ba yang bsluskapar gyur to/ /des na slob dpon klus byang chub sems 'grel las/ de pos po zhes bya rnam rtog ste/ /rnam rtog med pa stong nyid yin/ /gang la rnam rtog snangayod pa/ /de la stong nyid ga la yod/ /ces gsungs te/ de'i phyir stong nyid dngos ni ye shes yin la/ ye shes shar ba dang rnam rtog nub pa 'gros ba khrin pa las/ cir yang ma grub tsam gyi stong nyid ni de 'dra ma yin te/ rnam rtog ni snangab ma nyams par yod kyang de'i snang ba yod pa yang mi 'gal ba'i phyir rdo /de bas na stong nyid tsam la spyi ldog nas/ rgyan las/ med pa'i stong pa nyid shesashing / /de bzhi yod pa'i stong nyid dang / /rang bzhin stong pa nyid shes na//stong nyid shes pa zhes brjod do/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar kun btags rnams ni/zhen yul du shar ba tsam ma gtogs/ gnas lugs la lta ci smos/ kun rdzob kyi shes pa slang pos gzhigs na/ shes pa kun rdzob pa de'i ngor yang ma grub pa'i phyir/ med pa'i stong pa nyid ces bya ste/ de'i phyir thos bsam sgom gsum gyi rim pas/ med par shes dgos pa tsam zhig yin pas shes byar bshad la/—7 —

gzhan dbang ni med bzhin du dngos por 'khrul ba'i blo la dngos por gsal bar snang ba yin pas/ 'khru/la snang rgyu dang bcas pa spang dgos pas spang bya dang / kun rdzob kyi shes pa la gsal bar snang ba yin pas yod pa'i stong nyid de rgya skad du sā ta zhes pa yod pa'i dngos po'i don no/ /yongs grub ni dri ma sbyangaba'i gzhi/ gdod nas chos kun gyi rang bzhin du yod pa yin kyang/ de ltaraslartogs pa'i dri ma sbyong dgos shing / mngon sum du rtogs shing thob par bya dgos pas na/ sbyang gzhi dang / thob bya dang / reg par bya ba yin cing/ rang gi ngo bo don dam yang yin/ spros bral gyi stong nyid kyang yin/ chos thams cad kyi rangabazhin du gnas pa yang yin/ glo bur gyi dri ma'am 'khrul snang gis gdod nasastong pa yang yin pas de la rang bzhin stong pa nyid ces bya'o/ /de ltar na stonganyid rnam pa gsum gyi dbye ba 'di ma shes na/ 'khor lo gsum gyi mdo sde rnamasalas stong nyid kyi rnam bzhag mang po gsungs pa'i dngos bstan yang rtogs par mi 'gyur na/ dgongs don lta smos kyang ci dgos la/ 'di shes pas na de bosabastan dang dgongs don mtha' dag la mkhas par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du shesarab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mdo rnams las/ rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa chen po ni/ nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / r+ṣa po stong pa nyid dang/don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stongapa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tham med pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba med pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang/— 8 —

rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang/ midamigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa stong pa nyid dang /ro bo nyid stongapa nyid dang / dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid yin no/ /zhes gsungasaso/ /'o na shes rab snying po'i mdo 'dir stong pa nyid bcu drug tshang b.ragasungs sam ma gsungs zhe na/ 'dir stong nyid kho na brjod bya'i gtso boragasungs mod/ dngos bstan tshig zin la bcu drug gi rab dbye mi gsal gsungs pa ma yin kyang / shugs la bcu drug rdzogs par bstan te/ mig med ces sogs kyis nang za ba po stong pa nyid dang / gzugs med ces sogs kyisaphyi bza' ba stong pa nyid dang / khams bco brgyad med par bstan pas bzungasnang dang rnam shes kyi sbrel thag rten dang bcas pa bkag pas phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / gzugs sogs bkag pas/ gnas snod kyi 'jig rten chen po stongapa nyid dang / ye shes med ces pas/ lam gyi ye shes dang de'i rnam pa bkagapa'i phyir/ don dam stong pa nyid dang / stong nyid stong pa nyid gnyis bstan to/ /lam med ces pas/ 'dus byas kyi dge ba ste/ 'dus byas stonge nyid dang/'gog pa med ces pas 'dus ma byas stong nyid dang / thob pa dang ma thob pa med par bstan pas dgob mi zad pa'i phyir dor ba med pa stong nyid dang /sdug bsngal dang kun 'byu/nga med ces/ pas sems can la phan pa bsgrub pa'i phyir/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / sdug kun nyid 'khor ba yin na de bkag pas 'bor ba la spang byar zhen pa bkag pa'i phyir/ thog mtha' med pa stong nyid dang / dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad sher phyin zab mo 'i de la— 9 —

bsten ces pas/ zig/sa rnam par dag pa rang bzhin stong gnyid dang/ sngags kyiphan yon rnams kyis ni gzugs sku dang chos sku'i yon tan dag bstan pa'i phyir/ mtshan dpe dang stobs sogs bsgrub pa'i phyir du rang gi mtshan nyid stongapa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid rnams bstan pa yin te/ de ltar na bcu bzhi yin cing / gang zag dang chos kyi bdag med pa ni dngos po med pa stong nyid de/ dbu zhabs thams cad du bstan la/ dngos po med pa'i cho bo nyid stong pa nyid ni/ stong nyid khyad gzhin byas nas/ gzugs sogs 'gog pa dngagazhan yang don dam gzhan stong chen po gsal bar bstan pa'i tshig rnams kyis bstan to/ /mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid ni dngos med stong pa nyid dang don gcigal ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ni dngos med ngo bo nyid dang don gcig go /ldog 'a khyad par ni/ dngos med stong nyid ni/ ngo bo'i sgo nas ma grub pa dang/midamigs pa ni ye shes kyi ngo bor dmigs su med cing mthong rgyu med pa'i don no/ /ngo bo nyid ni phyin ci ma log pa'i rang bzhin de lam gyis gsar du mabacos pa'i don dang / khos med ngo bo nyid kyi don ni dngos po rnams yod nas ma grub pa'i shul na chos nyid mi g.yo zhing brtan par gnas pa'i don no//de bzhin du stong nyid nyi shu'i dbang du byas na/ rang gi ngo bo stong pa nyid ni/dngos med stong nyid dang gcig la gzhan gyi ngo bo stong pa nyid ni dngos med ngo bo nyid dang gcig go /rnam gzhag 'di ni shin tu gsal bar sngags kyi theg pa bla na med pa'i rgyud gnyis las 'byu/nga ba dang / mdo lugs kyi dbus mtha' rnatsha'abyed rtsa 'grel dang / yum gsum gnod 'joms dang / brgyad stong don bsdu— 10—

'ang lam 'a par bya'o//de bzhin du shes gi rnam par rtog pa rngajo'i gnyen 'ad na/spros pa' mtha' bcu'am/rnam g.yeng rnam par rtog pa gnyen/ por yang gsungs pa yin te/ji skad du/rgyal ba'i sras rnams kyi ni kho dngar tsho ra tshor tsho 0rir dzo rdo bye shānye/ne/rdeya dpa she //ring ming cho kau rnyi rtag daX gag dang du 'a she//tswadangakhyad par rtag dang nga dan ban du/ri/yos skaba'am ris sa skabaX yangadag spang bar pe kyi//zhes/ mi tu phyin pa ltar gas kya ru ba 0 // gas 'i bu mgangardegi la shes rab pha rol tu na pal spyod ces bya ba/chi/da 'a rnam g.yengarde ni yo pa'i sgyu stan to//rnyi po lnga po de dag kyang rang ba gyas stong pa shesardepa she yod ṭā rnam spung she 'i pho//shed ni sku rwa pa phu sna debasasnro'adagaX nga 'bar tson dzo//stang pa dar she sa she spre / rngo pa nga wi rki phur de bas sgyu / dngas pog/ pe'og rnga//kau pa dzod dzi yi grub lte she/sa med ces sags she/stang 'i dngadaspoṭā 3 par 'a pa' gto pa'//gzugs swā~X/ sbying stang rno nyad gzhan she rdemamu/stang ༷ 3rded las she 'a ma na pa ni /༷ dad du bo kyi tugardepa' garang giX/she/sa thams ༷ stang yi sna nyad ༷ ༷spres pa sto /ca rdzab oṃsbyims mun cha dzhai skyeng grub ༷ra rtag pa' gar+sā she/'i/ dzi gu dzi she da pa' bar ba la sa kri mo 1 / pa khyad pa zag tshul / spyo zi du rtag pa gnya'/ pa'//thab/pa med ces pas/chos/rnams thob tshul ra bkag pas bye brag tu 'brel/babakag rnyi tsor la/de'i phyir ming don ji 'brel rjo ༵ bkag pa ste/sprang ji rngi byā ba don du rtog pa kau /doX kyi ṭā ba nga du rtog she go sko pa'//gzhan yang gzugs sags dngas pa nyad bkag pas/kun rjab/ rnams/

'a du med pa'i ming rkyang zhu du go bar tsor sa/don dam 'a ming don gnyas sa nas ma grub cang/kun rdzob snro ri gi mang don gnyas blo mi cang la zhes kyas sbrel 'ab ma gtogs/don la nga —sa stongs pa dang / ladon gyas stongs pa yan no// 'i kyishe de dzi bas nā/dzo gu ston gu nyad — zhal snga nas/༷rgong dzi ri lo dang poragatags pa stang pa nyad kya mad chen pa las kyang /kun dga' ba de lta bsan/gang la gang med pa de des stong ngo zhes bya bar/yang dag par rjes su mthongabazhi /la lhag ma gang yod pa de/de la yod 'a spyo bya bar yang dag pa ji lta ba ba du rges tu shes te/kun dga' bo 'ad lta ste/zag pa rnam//zad pasnas pa med 'a mngon par 'dus ma byas pa /ma par grol ba jas shing pa 'ad na/stong dro kyi la 'jug pa bla na phyi da pa yan no/phyi/zhes gcos shing shes/wo po stong pa nyad mdo las kyang /— dang nang dang — sa pa nyad po/rdo5rde' 4 pa yang de dang 'dra la/'khor ra lo b.ra~Xshes rab kyi pha ro~Xdag—na pa' mdo zhin ga rnams las kyang /de la gzhan — dngos po stong pa — gang zhe na/de ba na gshe/gas pa rnams byung yang rung /ma byung yang rung/chos/gnasapa nyid dang /i nyid dang /i kyi dbyings dang /i skyon kho pa smi dang /de bzhin nyid dang /ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang /gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin rnga ri 0rirde ge snye ju/ra dzordenyad ge ges /yang dkri pa' 'a de na gnas pa 3da de/de ltar gzhan sa staḍipa gang yan pa de na gzhan gya dngos po stong pa nyad ces bya'o//rab wor de — byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa wo po lha no//zhes gsungs shing/'boralo

tha ma'i mdo rnams las ni lhag par yang rgyas shing gsal bar gsungs te/bka' 'khor lo gsum char gyi dngos bstan dang / shugs bstan dang /dgongs don gyi gtso bo'i stong pa nyid ni/ gzhan stong dbu ma r+pā po'i kho na yin gyi/ srid tshad thams cad rang stong du 'dod pa'i lugs ltar gsungs pa ni med do/ /de lta bas na kun rdzob kyi chos thams cad gdod ma nas rang gi ngo bosastongs par 'jog pa'i grub mtha' ni/ rang stong rnam dag rgyal ba'i dgongs pa yin yang / mthar thug don dam dbyings kyang / rang gi ngo bos stongs para'adod pa ni/ shin tu tshes log par lta ba yin pas/ de gnyis bsdoms pa'i grub mtha' thal rang gi lugs 'di dag ni kha zas bzang po dug can dang 'dra la/ kun rdzob thams cad rang stong dang / don dam dbyings gzhan stong du 'byerashes pa/ zung 'jug gi lta ba yon tan kun dang ldan pa 'di ni/ chos nyid kyi gnas lugs dang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dgongs pa'o/ /de'i rgyu mtshan chos nyid rtag tu gnas pa bden grub la bden med do zhes skur ba btab pas/ don dam pa'i chos dkon mchog la sdig bsags pa dang / chos sku don dam de kun khyab yin pa la kun khyab min ces dang / kun khyab kyi chos nyid yon tan ( 〈rdza〉 rke kun ldan la yon tan )med ces don dam pa'i sangs rgyas dkon mchog la skur ba btab pa'i nyes pa chen po dang / 'phags chen rnams kyi mnyam bzhag rnam pa kun ldan yin pa laci yang snang ba med do/ /zhes dge 'dun dkon mchog la smad pa'i kha na mthob ches mi bzad pa dang bcas pa rnams ni thal rang par grags pa rnams la thog — 13 —

tu babs pa dang / gzhan stong smra ba rnams ni skyon de las grol ba'i phyir ro/ /da ni tshig gi don la 'jug par bya ste/ de yang mdo 'di 'chad par byed pa la/ dang por gleng bslang ba'i tshul gyis ngo mtshar bskyed pa dang/ bar du zab cing rgya che ba'i don gtan la dbab pa dang / mthar yi rang mngon par bstod pa ste don gsum las/ dang po la/ gleng gzhi'i tshig dang / mdo sde'i chos 'byungaba'i sgo gnyis las/ dang po ni/ 'di skad bdag gis thos pa zhes pa la sogasapa ste/ de la 'di skad ces pa ni/ sangs rgyas kyas bstan pa'i chos de yang ji ltabu zhe na/ 'di skad dam 'di ltar te/ de nas bcom ldan 'das zhes pa nas rjes su yi rang ngo zhes pa'i mthar thug pa 'di skad du thos zhes pa yin pas/de ltaran chos phun sum tshogs pa'o/ /bdag ces pa ni bsdud pa po phyag na rdorje bdagagis dngos su thos pa ste/ mdo sde dam pa 'di gsung ba'i dus na/ ston pa 'khor dang bcas pa'i tshogs pa der mngon sum du rang nyid yod pas na/gzhan las brgyud de thos pa ni ma yin no zhes pa'o/ /ston pa ni rnam par 'phrulartab rgyu ma lta bu la mnga' brnyes pa'i phyir/ dbyar dang ston la sogs pa'i dusa'adi lta bu'o zhes nges bzung su ma brjod par/ dus gcig na zhes yangs pa'i sgra smos te dus phun sum tshogs pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das zhes pa la bha ga lhan gyi sgra las drangs na/ legs pa'i yon tan phun sum tshogs pa thams cad dang ldan pa'i phyir legs ldan nam/ nyes skyon dang 'jigs pa dang sdug bsngal thams/cad bcom zhing zhig pa dang / gzhan gyi nyes skyon rnams 'joms par mdzad pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa'i phyir/ bcom ldan zhes bya la gang rang nyid skyon — 14—

spangs shing yon tan kun dang ldan la/ gzhan gyi sdug bsngal sel bar mdzad pa de ni/ skyabs dang skyobs pa dang / skyes bu dam pa bla na med pa yin pagashākya thub pa bcom ldan 'das de ni/ ston pa phun sum tshogs pa zho /'dasazhes pa'i sgra ni/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'amā 'khor ba pa dang theg dgrun pa'i spyod yul las 'das pa'i don du sbyor zhing / 'jig rten gyi lha khyab las/nagapo sogs la yang 'jig rten du legs ldan dang bcom ldan du grags pa las/khyad par 'byed cing mi nor ba'i phyir dang po'i lo tsā bas bcug pa'o zhes grags pa ni/ spyir de ltar yin la/ 'das pa'i skad dod med do zhes kun tugrags na/ bha ga wān zhes pa/ bha ga bcom pa dang / wān ldan pa'i skad dod yin pa bzhin du/ 'das pa'i skad dod shig bcom pa dang ldan pa'i skad dod las logs su yod pa ma yin kyang / de nyid la 'das pa'i don yod du tseb ni/ bha ga zhes pa nyid kyi/ bha la yi ge bsnan pas/ a bha wi pya ti sto 'byung b.rami 'gyur ba dang / ga ni ga ti ste song ba zhes pa yin pas/ song zhing mi 'byung ba ni/ yang dag pa'i gnas su song zhing log pa'i gnas su mi 'byung bste/ 'jigarten las 'das pa'i don no/ /de'i phyir mi nor ba'i wo kho nar skad dod dang ma 'brel ba zhig /glo bur du dbang che'i rigs pas bsnan pa ma yin gyi skad dod dang yang 'brel ba nyid yin no/ /grong khyer rgyal po'i khab kyi shar phyogasakyang yin la de'i sa yul du gtogs pa na/ dka' thub kyi gnas bya rgod phungapo'i ri bo yod pa yin te/ de yang sems can phal ba rnams kyi snang ngo ltar na/yul phyogs dang grong khyer de dang ri bo der snang ba yin la byang chub sems— 15 —

dpa' dbang thob pa dang / sangs rgyas kyis gzigs pa'i spyod yul ltar na/ngobo chos dbyings ye shes kyi rang bzhin/ rnam par dag pa'i zhing mchog gzhal med khang dang bcas pa ste/ de skad du gser 'od dam pa sogs las kyang/ bya rgod phung po chos kyi dbyings/ /zab mo sangs rgyas spyod yul na/ /zhes gsung༅pa'i phyir/ phyi nang gi bya rgod phung po de ni/ gnas phun sun tshogs pa kho /dgoslong gi dge 'dun chen po zhes pa la/ spyir byang chub sems dpa'i dge slong yangashin tu mang mod kyi/ 'dir dge slong zhes pa 'di ni nyan thos kyi yin la/ de las kyang phal che ba ni/ nyan thos dgra bcom pa yin pas/ don dam pa'i dgoslong yang yin mod kyi/ khyad par du so so thar ba rigs brgyad kyi nang wo dgeslong gi sdom pa dang ldan pa kho na'o/ kha cig gsol bzhi'i las kyi dge slong kho na'o zhes zer ba ni ma brtags pa ste/ ye shes khong chud kyi bsnyen par rdzogasapa'ang mang du yod la/ tshur shog gi bsnyen par rdzogs pa ni shin tu mang ba'i phyir ro/ /byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun zhes pa la/ spyir sems yang dgapar bskyed pa'i so so skye bo yang byang chub sems dpa' yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni theg chen 'phags pa rnams bzung ste/ don dam pa'i sems bskyed pa dang /debazhin gshegs pa'i rigs su skyes pa'i phyir ro/ /de'i rgyu mtshan yang kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems tsam bskyed pa na/ bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi go 'phangaladamigs nas/ sems can thams cad de la 'god par 'dod pa'i sems pa tsam yod kyang / byang chub kyi rang bzhin mngon sum du ma ma'ong bas/ byang chub la ji lta ba bzhin du sems par mi nus la/ 'phags pa rnams kyi chos nyid — 16 —

ma phyo sum du da she pa'i i nyid de byang she kyi ra~X bzhin yin she dam sems sgyu da mi dod dodage ge sde thab pa na/byang chub swā dngas su she nus pa' yang na mus rgyas she sku gsung thugs dang wā ba 'a de bzhi nag/ thab pa'i ri/myur kya phyar du spyad pa mthu dang ldan par spyad pa ngaXn gas pa' dz+nyā/ne /su skyes ༵ la byang chub spre ge ge snye dpa' zhes bya ste/pa ni snyi zhes pal/bo byangachub na la/sems dpa'i 4 sto snad dod zhes zhes rnyi na/sheng stobs4shesa' rkang 'ang/ga gas sna tsho//da 'dun sa pa swā 3 kau mang du na po ni du yad kyang /'ar re zhag gas pa da pa 'dus pa'a~Xn 'a swā/chen po yi pa bsgyu/rdeXng ḍi de /ga kyang de dzi bta/sa pa kho na na pa' phyar ches 'i chos be dan na// dag kyang bzhan pa'i ༷ la blta zi dang/chug/ chas kha bas/༵/sems can zhe ge 0 5 ) dge sgo ge ge ge /dgangs brnyi/ pa dang/bya rnyi sheg pa dang /tsho/sa she tu 'dus pas na thabs sheg tu ga tsho/pa she stir phun sum 'as paX//sbud dge ka' lha/da ༷ pa phun sum tshags pa semasang / pa'i dge 'dun ni ched du bya ba'i gdul zhabar je slo dang /byang chub sema~X shā/pa' dge 'dun ched du bya ba 'a gdul bya phun sum gas pa she/phun rdzum sa pa bdun du she 'a bzhag she rung la/ngang la na pa'i pa pa dhoṅgilags su byas she/na tsho chas kyag 1 sa zhe 1 phun sum blo ༷ zhwa ri rdzo dang lda/ rdo bo ge ge mu pa dam ram nge sa zhesaXzhad rti/ wo nga she//dus sheg na ༷lta/pa dus kya khyad par ma sa pa dang //thas pa sa pa dngas su thas pa kha na la'ajog pa ni/theg pa wo lo mdo phal che ba'i dbang du byas pa zhi gyi/zha7

thos kyi mdo phal che ba dus kyi khyad par nges pa can yin pa dang / bka' bsdub po kun dga' bo lta bus kyang / mdo sde dngos su thos pa yang yod/ phro suslathos par brgyud nas thos pa yang yod ces bshad cing / chos kyi phung po bgyod khri bzhi stong las/ stong phrag nyi shu tsam brgyud nas thos par bshad pa yang yod pas/ bshad sgros gcig gi phyogs zhen la brten nas/ rnam grangs du ma 'byungab rnams dgag par mi bya'o/ /de bzhin du thos pa zhes pa thos pa tsam yin gyi/sangs rgyas kyi chos zab mo rtogs par ma nus so zhes 'chad pa yang / chos kyi che ba dbyung ba'i skabs 'ga' zhig tu yin gyi rnam pa thams cad du 'chad dgos pa ma yin no/ /yang kha cig gleng gzhi zhal nas gsungs pa'i bkar byas nagaston 'khor gcig pa'i rnam bzhag mdzad pa ni/ lugs gzhan yin pas pha chol tu phyin pa'i theg pa dang / phar phyin theg pa 'di'i phyogs mtshungs kyi sngags rgyud rnams la sbyar bar mi bya'o/ /'di la dpa' phyogs kyi glang po'i zhal snga nagaston pa dbang po 'khor dang ni/ /yul dang dus kyi ngas bstan pa/ /bsdud porang nyid tshad mar ni/ /rab grub phyir yin 'jig rten na/ /yul dang dus kyanganyer mtshon cing / /dpang por bcas pa smra ba yi/ /smra po tshad mar rjesasurtogs/ /zhes brgyad stong don bsdu las gsungs te/ ston pa dang yul dus ngesapa dang / 'khor tshogs dpang por bzhag nas bshad pas/ smra ba po'i tshig yid rtse༅can du 'gyur ba'i phyir dang / gzhung mdzes par 'gyur bas dad ldan 'jug pa'i yan lag go /zhes phyir gzhung mdzes par 'gyur snyam na/ mdo sdephal che ba ni zhu ba dang / zhu lan spel/ ba'i tshul yin pas/ de 'dra la ni gleng— 18 —

gzhi ma smos par/zhu lan kho na btsan thabs su bkod na/mgo bcad pa'i shing bzhin mi mdzes par 'khyu/ra ba las/gleng gzhi bkod pas 'brel chagasardeshing brjid bag wo por snang bar bya pa'i phyir ro//dri med bzhes gawo na ne'akhor gyi ming ma smos pa dpang po yin par yang mi grub cing /yul de dgatusong zhing dris na nges pa rnyed par 'gyur srid kyang /de ltar mi nus pa rnamasakyis mdo don la nges pa mi rnyed par thal bar 'gyur ro zhes phyogs kyi glang po 'gog pa ni/rigs pa yang ltar snang yin la/dgag yul gyi sa mtshamos/yangam zin pa'o//de'i rang lugs la chos nyan pa'i skal ba yod pa rnams waṃrasmos pa yin ces zer ba ni/rang gi ji skad bstan pa'i skyon de thog tu 'babate:sku/ ‘ri ge 0 ri skyo sku/ :spro rde zu shesno /sde/nga ma smos pa' phyar/skal ba dang ldan pa yang su na nges pa rnyed pa raro'i//de bzhin du thar srogs ma dang lnga ci sdo su/bcom ldan 'das 'phagasardepa' mus rnam thar sgo gsum dang /sa ge rtse gnas pa bsam ge mus gzug༅rdemed kya tang nge 'dzin dang /tshangs pa' gnas pa tshad med bzha' sgo nasabazhugs zhes 'chad pa yang /don dang ma 'brel zhing /'og tu zab mo snang ba'i ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs par bshad pas/de dag ni dgos med lhag po'i bshad /ra snang las/yang sku spyod lam dang /gsung chos gsungs pa dang/thugs tang nge 'dzin gya gnas pas bzhugs zhes 'chad pa yang /spros bshad khonar bas so//'di skad ces pa'i skabs su/'di skad kho na yin gyi/tshulardegazhan gyi sgo nas ma yin te/don gzhan na tshig gzhan gyi rim pas byung ngasasnyam pa'i the tshom gcod pa'o//yang 'a/ skad ces pas/'di khon ltar zhi gyi

tshig dang don gyi rim pa gzhan ni ma yin no/ /zhes mdo tshig 'di dag la lhagachad la sogs pa'i 'khrul ba med par bstan to/ /zhes kyang 'chad pa rnamagrangs su ni rung la/ snye bor gyi grangs la kha cig stong nyis brgya lnga bcu'i dgo'adun dang / dge slong lnga stong tsam gyi dge 'dun zhes/ mdo sde gzhan dgalasa'abyung ba la/ kha yar ba stong phrag lnga la/ bzhi tshan du bsdebs na/ bzhi tshan pa stong nyis brgya lnga bcu 'byung bas/ de gnyis don gcig go zhes zer ba yang blun gtam du snang ngo / /mdo 'di la yang sher mdo rgyas pa bzhin du/ dge slong lnga stong dang / bzang skyong la sogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' zhes 'chad pa nyimado 'di nyid las grangs dang dmigs gsal ma gsungs pa dang / sher mdo rgyas pa'i dus dang 'khor sogs dang / 'di'i dus dang 'khor sogs gag pa kho na'i rgyu mtshan mi snang bas/ rang bzo'i bshad par 'gyur ba yin no/ /gnyis pa mdo sde'i chos 'byung pa'i sgo ni/ de'i tshe bcom ldan 'dasazhes pa la sogs pa ste/ de'i tshe zhes pa ni/ 'khore 'dus pa de'i tshe zhes/pa yin mod kyi/ 'on kyang de'i tshe ched du bya ba'i gdul bya rnams yongs su smin pasachos 'di bstan na grol bar 'gyur nges pa'i 'dus yan par mkhyen pa'o/ /desan zab mo snang ba zhes bya ba la/ zab mo ni shin tu rtogs par dka' ba ste/ chosakyi dbyings spros bral nam du yang 'gyur ba med la rnam pa thams cad pa yang yin pa ste/ de mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ye shes ༷ni ( 〈rdza〉 cha de )snang ba ste/ zab mo snang ba de dang ldan pa'i mnyam bzhag gi thugs ni zab mosnang ba'i ting nge 'dzin no/ /sgra bshad de ni sangs rgyas kyi mkhyen pa spyi la tsha'o/ —20—

yin kyang / spyi ming bye brag la btags pa'i tshul gyis/ bshad pa'i chos kyi rnamagrangs 'di 'byung ba'i rgyu ting nge 'dzin gyi khyad par la de skad ces bya ba yin no/ /de yang dngos su na/ de bzhin gshegs pa ting nge 'dzin thams cad la rtag tu mnyam par bzhag pa yin pas/ skabs 'dir zab mo snang ba'i ting nge 'dzin la gsar du mnyam par bzhag pa ma yin kyang / ched du bya ba'i gdul bya rnamasartekyi snang ngor/ ting nge 'dzin de la gsar du mnyam par bzhag par bstan pa yin no/ /yang dag par na sangs rgyas kyi rnam par thar ba ni/ sangs rgyas khona'i spyod yul las gzhan ma yin mod/ ston pa'i gzugs kyi sku ni gdul bya'i snangangor bstan pa'i nges pa las/ gang gdul bya rnams kyis ji lta bu zhig mthongabar 'gyur ba/ de lta bur byin gyis brlabs pas de ltar snang ba yin te/ lungalas kyang / ston pas 'jig rten pa'i thugs bskyed pa'i tshe/ srog chags grogasbur phyin chad kyis kyang ston pa'i thugs shes so zhes 'byung ba lta bu go /yangade'i tshe zhes pa ni/ de kho nar ma zad gzhan yang zhes pa ste/ ston pa nyid ting nge 'dzin de la mnyam par bzhag ma thag de'i tshe'o// /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po zhes pa la/ byang chub sems dpa' ni gong du bshad zin la/sems dpa' chen po ni/ dag pa'i sa la gnas pa dag la spyi khyab tu 'a rdzun pa tsam yin yang / gtso bor 'od zer chen po'i dbang bskur ba thob pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rgyal tshab rnams so/ /de'i sgra bshad pa ni/ yon tan zin po tshebasdud pa las/ rtsi phyir 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' bya zhe na/ /chags pa gcod byed kun nas chags pa zad par 'dod/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi byang chub —21 —

chags med 'gyur la reg/des na 'di ni byang chub sems dpa'i ming thob bo/zhes dang /ci phyir 'di ni sems dpa' che zhes bya zhe na//sems can tshogasarnams mang po'i mchog tu gyur pa dang //sems can khams kyi lha rnams chen po gcod pa ste//de phyir 'di ni sems dpa' che zhes rab brjod do//gtong ba che dang blo che ba dang mthu che dang //rgyal ba rnams kyi theg chen mchog la zhugs pa dang //go cha wo po bsgos shing bdud kyi rgyu 'dul ba//de yi phyir na semasadapa' che zhes brjod pa yin//ces gsungs pa ltar ro//tshig bcad 'di dgagi sbas don 'og tu yang 'chad par 'gyur ro//'phags pa spyan ras gzigasani don gnas tshul la rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid yin la/'jig rten khams/gzhan mang po zhig tu sangs rgyas nyid du yang ston mod kyi/sangs rgyas gzhan thams cad kyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor du/byang chub sems dpa'i tshul yang ston pa'i phyir/gdul bya rnams kyi snang tshul gtso che ba'i dbang du byas nas de ltarasmos la/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo la spyod cing nyams su len pa'i tshul gyis yang dag pa'i don la mnyam par 'jog cing /lhag pa'i shes rosakyis rnam par blta la zhes spyir smos nas/khyad par du shes rab kyi pha rolatuphyin pa la 'jug pa'i sgo phung po lnga po de dag rang bzhin gyis te gdod nas stong par rnam par blta'o//de dag kyang ci ces kyang yi ge sgras/khams dngaskyemached la sogs pa 'jug sgo thams cad kyang bstan to//de yang mdo rdze'i rgyas bshad gsungs pa po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs yin pas/chos/kyi rnam grangs kyi tshig 'di dag 'byung baX hwa/don dam stong nyid rtogs pa'i ye

shes de gsar du bskyed pa'i tshul bstan pa yin cing /phung po lnga sogs stongapar bsgoms so zhes bstan pa ni/rjes 'jug rnams kyis kyang phung so gos stonganyid du bsgoms pas/sher phyin gyi ye shes rtogs par 'gyur rdo/zhes go ba'i r+pā do//gnyis pa bar du zab cing rgya che ba'i don gtan la dbab pa la/drilanagyi sgo nas rgyas par gtan la phab pa dang /mthun gyur gyi sgo nas the tshom bsal ba'o//dang po la/dris pa dang /lan gnyis so//dang po ni/denas yosargyas kyi mthus zhes pa la sogs pa ste/de yang skabs de'i gdul bya rnams kyi snang tshul gyi dbang du byas te/'phags pa shā ri'i bu ni shes rab can khyimachokayin pa'i phyir/zab mo'i chos 'di lta bu la gleng bar 'os pa zhi la/wan kyangatheg chen gyi chos zab mo 'di nyan thos rnams kyi spyod yul ma yin pa ga'adi'adri ba yang rang stobs ma yin gyi sangs rgyas kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i mthu yin no//don du ni/shā ri'i bu yang byang chub sems dpa' chen po zhig nyanathos kyi tshul bzung ba yin par nges pas/theg chen gyi chos la dbang bsgyurabar mi nus pa ste ma yin mod/de yang sangs rgyas kyi mthu ni yin te/'jigarten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bde dge thams cad sangs rgyas kya mthu nyid kyi phyir ro//rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo zhes pa ni/skyes pa dang bud med de/de las gzhan ma ning gi 'gro ba ni chos spyod pa la mthu chung b.radagongs pas ma smos pa'o/khres rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo spyad pa spyod par 'dod pa ni/zhes pa la/spyir byaX /ba sems dpa'i spyod pa ni rnam pa bzhi

ste/ theg dman la mos pa rnams kyi ched du byang chub phyogs mthun gyi spyod pa dang / theg chen la mos pa rnams kyi ched du phar phyin drug gi spyod pa dang /deganyis ka mdun pa'i phyir du mngon shes kyi spyod pa dang / gnyis ka gdul ba'i phyir du sems can yongs smin gyi spyod pa ste bsdu dngos bzhi'o/ /de thams cad kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i spyod par mi 'du ste/ thams cad shesarab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rtogs pa'i thabs yin pas so/ /de ltar yang rgyalatshab chen pos/ lus can theg pa chen po dang / /theg pa dman la mos pa rnams/ /gnyis ka mdun par bya ba dang / /gdul ba'i phyir ni brten rnamasakyi/ /spyod pa bzhi po mdo bzhin du/ /rjes su 'brangs nas bshad pa yin/ /ces so/ /don 'di ni 'phags pa dkon mchog brtsegs pa'i nang tshan gtsug na zin po tshes zhus pa'i mdo las 'gyung ngo / /de dag las kyang las dang po pas lagalen du 'debs sla ba'i dbang du byas nas/ chos spyod bcu ste/ de ltar yang/ yi jige 'bri mchod spyin pa dang / /nyan dang glog dang len pa dang / /'chad dngakhaton byed pa dang / /de sems pa dang sgom pa ste/ spyod pa de bcu'i bdaganyid ni/ /bsod nams phung po dpag tu med/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ khres rabakyipha rol tu phyin pa'i mdo sde la/ chos spyod bcu'i sgo nas nan tan du bsgrub pa thisher phyin zab mo la spyad pa spyod pa ste/ 'dis ni sher phyin rtogs pa'i rgyu thabasakyi phyogs rnams kyang gsal bar bstan pa'o/ /'dir 'grel chen ltar na/rigs kyi bu mo zhes pa mi 'don zhing / 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbangaphyug ces bod pa yang med par/ rigs kyi bu gang la la zhes 'don te/ rigs —24—

kyi bu zhes pa sangs rgyas kyi sras yin pa'i phyir 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs la bod pa'i tshig tu bshad mod kyi/ don bsgyur zhing bshad na de ltar 'byung srid kyang / sgras zin ltar na/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs la ma gus/pa'i tshig tu'agyur bas/ mdo 'don tshul de dag bshad tshul de mi legs par mthong ngo / /gnyis pa la/ sher phyin la spyod tshul mdor bstan pa dang/ sher phyin gyi ngo bo rgyas par bstan pa dang / de rtogs pa'i lam gyi yon tan dang/ la 5 desathob pa'i 'bras bu mngon du 'gyur tshul dang / phan yon dang bcas pa'i gzungs sngags bstan pa dang / don bsdu'i tshul du sher phyin slob par gdamasapa'o /dang po ni/ de skad ces smras pa dang / zhes pa la sogs pa ste/ gangalal ces pa snga phyi gnyis ni/ gang ci yang rung ba sher phyin la spyod par 'dod pa de thams cad ces pa'i don no/ /'di ltar rnam par blta bar bya zhes pa ni/ de mthag tu 'chad par 'gyur pa 'di ltar shin tu bsgom par bya zhes pa ste/ chosaspyod bcu dang phyin drug dang bsdu dngos bzhi sogs/ spyod pa bzhi po gang la'ajug kyang / rang gzhan snod bcud kyis bsdus pa' phung po lnga po de dgarangabazhin gdod ma nas stong par blta ba ste/ stong par mngon sum du mthong ba'am/mos pa'am/ myong ba'i sgo nas shin tu rnam par te lan mang po dang/ ldan ringapor sgom pa'o/ /kyang gi sgras rnam grangs gzhan bstan pa yang gong dang 'dra ste/mdor na spyin sogs spyod pa thams cad spros bral rtogs pa'i lta bas zin pa cig dgos so zhes pa'o/ /—25 —

gnyis pa sher phyin gyi ngo bo rgyas par bshad pa la/ zab mo'i mtshan nyid rnam pa brgyad kyi sgo nas rang bzhin sher phyin gtan la phab/ mkhas par bya ba'i dngos po drug la mkhas pa'i sgo nas lam sher phyin ji ltar sgom tshul lo/ /dang po ni gzugs stong pa'o sogs te/ stong pa ṣ+ka dang / 4ni ṣ+ka ṣ+ka pa dang / ma skyes pa dang / ma 'gags pa dang / dri ma med pa dang/dri bral med pa dang / bri ba med pa dang / gang ba med pa ste/ brgyad las dang po stong nyid cung zad rgyas par bshad cing / lhag ma gzhan rnams des rigs bsgres na goblabar dgongs nas ming tsam smos pa'o/ /de la phung po lnga sogs dang/ de dgastong par shes pa la/ thog mar shes bya spyi'i rnam gzhag rgyas pa shes na ni legs la/ shin tu blo gros zhan pas kyang 'di tsam zhig shes dgos te/ 'dirashes par bya ba'i chos thams cad ni mdor bsdu na/ dngos po'i 'dus byasasugatogs pa dang / 'dus ma byas su gtogs pa gnyis so/ /dngos po'i 'dusabyas te yang gzugs can du snang ba dang shes pa dang de dag gi gnas skabs la btags pa ste gsum du yod la/ dang po gnyis ni dngos po de dros yin la/ phyi ma ni btags pa ba'o/ /de'i dang po ni yul dpyad pas gzugs su rung bstoreg pa bskyed pa dang / thogs pa dang bcas pa sogs/ dbang shes kyi spyod yul lam rten gyi mtshan nyid can no/ /de yang rgyu'i gzugs can ni/ srab dang/bsher ba dang / drob dang / g.yo ba'i rang bzhin gyi rdul te/ 'byung ba chen po sachu me rlud rnams so/ /'i 'bras bu gzugs can ni/ dkar dmar tho seralasogs pa kha dog dang / gru bzhi zlum po la sogs pa dbyibs te gzugs dang/—26—

thos pa bya ba snyan pa dang / mi snyan pa dang yang na glu dbyangs lta bu sems can gyi rgyud du gtogs pa dang / myu lta bu der mi gtogs pa ste sgra dang / snoms pa ni zhim mi zhim gyi khyad par sogs dri dang / mngar skyur la sogs pa'i ro dang/'jam rtsub la sogs pa'i reg bya mang po zhig dang / mig rna ba sna lce lusakyidabang po ste de rnams ni/ rgyu 'byung ba las byung zhing dngos su 'gyung ba rnamasadang 'brel bsan/ 'byung ba las gyur pa'i gzugs zhes bya'o/ /spyir 'byungabarnams kyang reg bya'i nang du 'du ste/ sra ba'i reg bya la sogs pa'i ngo bo yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar na gzugs sogs lnga dang / mig sogs lnga stobastopo de dag ni/ gzugs kyi khams dang gzugs kyi skye mched nas/ lus kyi khams dang lus kyi skye mched kyi bar du/ khams bcu dang skye mched bcu yin la thams cad kyang gzugs can du snang ba yin pa'i phyir/ gzugs kyi phung po zhesabya'o/ /'grob drug gi lus dang / phyi rol kyi ri dang / ljon shing dang/ chu bo dang / rgya mtshodang / bza' ba dang btung ba la sogs pa/ khas lus lo ca(spyod 'di dag thams cad ni/ gzugs can bcu po de dag phan tshun du cho gosashing 'dres pa'i gong bu yin pas de dag las gzhan du mi bsam mo/ /gnyis pa shes pa ni/ dbang po lnga'i rnam shes dang / yid kyi rnam shes te drug ni rnam shes rags pa dang / bdag tu snang ba'i nyon yid ni 'bring po dpa/de kun la khyab pa'i kun gzhi ni phra bste/ de dag thams cad rnam par shes pa'i phung po yin pa dang / mig gi rnam par shes pa'i khams nas yid shes kyi khams kyi bar du khams drug dang / yid khams te bdun ni/ skye mched kyi skabs yid —27—

kyi skye mched gcig pur yang yin te/ 'on kyang kun gzhi rnam shes ni chosakhams su bsdu ba'ang snang ba logs su dpyad par byar yod do/ /dbang shesadrug po de dag dang 'brel bar bde ba dang / sdug bsngal dang / btang snyomasagasum tshor zhing nyams su myong ba ni/ tshor ba'i phung po dang / phyi dang nang 'dusabyas dang 'dus ma byas kyi chos gang la yang / 'di ni bum pa'o/ /'i de ni snamabu'o/ /'di ni bzang ba'o/ /'di ni ngan pa'o/ /'di ni ring bzho /waṃ ni thubaba'o/ /'di ni ka zhes pa'o/ /'di ni ka ba zhes pa'o/ /zhes pa la sogs pa/ming tsam du 'dzin pa dang / don tsam du 'dzin pa dang / ming kho na 'odzen pa dang /don kho na 'dzin pa dang / ming don gnyis ka 'dzin pa'i mtshan ma can gyi rtog pa rnams ni rgyu mtshan gtan tshigs la brten pa dang ma brten pa dzi ltar yin yang rung ste 'du shes kyi phung po zhes bya'o/ /'dod chags zhe sdang la sogs pa'i nyon mongs pa dang / dad pa dang / brtson 'grus la sogs pa'i dgob dang/rtogasadapyod la sogs pa ma nges pa dang / de kun la khyab pa yul yid la byed pa dang /yul la g.yo ba'i sems dpa' la sogs pa mdor na las byed pa dang 'brel ba'i rnam rtog thams cad ni/ mtshungs ldan 'du byed ces bya lte 'du byed kyi phungapo'i phyed snga ma dang 'du byed dngos dang 'du byed kyi gtso bo yin no/ /de ltararnam shes tshor ba 'du shes/ 'du byed kyi phung po'i phyed de/ phung po byed dang bzhi po de ni rig pa'am shes pa yin no/ /'dus byas rnams kyi mtshan nyid/ skyeb dang / gnas pa dang 'jig pa la sogs pa dang / mi dang mi phan tshun 'drabalasogs pa'i skal mnyam dang / sdug bsngal thob pa dang / rgyal srid thob pa dang/—28 —

sdom pa thob pa dang/lam dang 'bras bu thob pa la sogs pa'i 'gyur ba'i khyad par ni thob pa ste/de dag la sogs pa gzugs sems kyi dngos po'i khyad paral sa pa shin tu mang rab dag ni/'a na 'du byed sa pa'i 'ang she/'du byed kya phung po'i phyogs gcag gam/phyed phya ma ste/btags pa 'du byed dang 'du byed rnam grangs pa'o//rnam pa rig byed ma yin pa'i gzugs zhes pa ni sdom pa dag sdom min dang /dge ba'i brtul zhugs tsam po rnams la zer te/'di ming gi sgo nas gzugs phung du bsdu yang /gzugs sems gnyis 'dusakyi gnas skabs la btags pa tsam yin pas/dngos po btags pa pa'i nangasno yin no//de ltar na de dag ni phung po lnga ste chos kyi 'a kyi phyed sladang/chos kyi skye mched kyi phyed ma ma gtogs skye mched bcu gnyas dang khams bco brgyad kyang de la tshang ngo //phyed ma de yang ci snyam na/po ni ma byas su gtagasapa yang 'a te ba pa / ri pa spyi nga dngos so/pye/nga po pre/'a mkha' dang/'gog pa gnyas/ dang / gas — la sogs pa na la 'ad na phung por tshagatogs par 'dod cing khams dang skye mched du ni 'dus te/tshor 'du 'du shes 'du byed de phung po gsum dang 'dus ma byas btags pa ba 'di rnams bsdoms pa ni chos kyi khams dang chos kyi skye mgo do//gnyis pa 'dus ma byas dngos ni don dam pa'i sems nyid rnam pa thams cad pa rtag brtan zhi ba g.yung drung bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po/chosadabyings de bzhin nyid do//de la 'dus ma byas btags pa ba ni/gos su na 'dus byas yin kyang /rang gi mtshan lha rwa me kyis med pas/skye 'i 'jug gnas pa

dngos por med pa'i phyir/ 'dus byas gzhan rnams dang mtshan nyid mi 'drab shin tu che ba'i phyir na 'dus ma byas su btags pa'o/ /lam gyi chos rnams ni 'dus ma byas rtogs pa'i thabs yin yang / ngo bo ni dngos po ste/ dad pa dngabartson 'grus dang shes rab la sogs pa'i sems byung dang rnam shes su 'dus pa yin no/ /'bras bus bsdus pa'i chos la ni/ nyan thos dang/ rangasangasargyas dang byang myu sems dpa'i rnam par grol ba'i ye shes ni lam yin pa'i phyir dngos po nyid du 'gyur la/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam grol lam dang/khyad par lam dang por thob pa yang de dang 'dra zhing / theg pa gsum la spang bya sgrib pa rnam 'gags pa'i spangs pa ni so sor brtags 'gog yin pa'i phyir/'dus ma byas btags pa ba dang dngos med yin no/ /'gog bden ṭa ngos ni/don dam chos sku gzhi lam 'bras bu kun gyi chos nyid/ sangs rgyas kyi snying po de yin te/ de dngos po dngos med gnyis ka ma yin cing / 'dus ma byas ni de hrasayin no/ /spros pa thams cad dang bral ba'i dbyings dang / stong pa nyid ces bya ba yang / sems nyid 'dus ma byas 'di kho na yin gyi/ gzhan ni yang dag param yin no/ /de ltar na chos nyid 'di res 'ga' chos kyi skye mched yin pa ltarabashad pa ni dgos pa'i dbang gis gsungs pa ste/ rig shes rjes dpag gisachos nyid 'di la dmigs nas don spyi'i tshul gyis spyod yul du byed pasadabyings 'di yang yid kyi yul rjes mthun yin pa la dgongs so/ /nges par na des de yul du byed mi nus te/ rnam par shes pa dag rnam par rtog pa'i yulamayin pa'i phyir ro/ /'di ni dngos gnas la phung khams skye mched gang yangatsha—30—

yin la/ rten 'brel las kyang grol ba'o/ /don dam pa'i ni phung khams skyemached dang rten 'brel du yang 'jog mod kyi/ phung sogs de dag kun rdzobakhonas rab tu phye ba yin pa'i phyir/ de yin pas de dag yin par mi 'gyur te/dngul chu'i skyes bu ma yin pa bzhin no/ /de bas na nam mkha' la sogs pa de dag dngos med yin la/ gzugs sogs phung po lnga ni dngos po nye de gnyisal 'dus byas dang 'dus ma byas su grags kyang / so so skye bo rnams kyi rtog ngo dang mthun par gsungs pas drang don kun rdzob tu de ltar yin gyi/ yang dgapar na dngos med rnams kyang 'dus byas te/ dngos po la brten pa la kho na'i phyir ro/ /de'i phyir don dam dbyings ni phung khams skye mched gang yang ma yin pa dang / de rnams la 'dus byas kyis khyad pa dang / 'dus ma byas de dros yin na dngos po dngos med gnyis ka las grol bas khyab pa yin no/ /de las de ngosamed rnams ni btags de kho na yin pa'i phyir/ mtshan nyid kyi ngo bo med pas na/snang ba yang med/ myong ba yang med/ blang bya dang dor bya gang yang ma yin pa'i phyir/ zhar byung tsam du bzhag nas de ma gtogs pa'i lhag ma chos thams cad phung khams skye mched ces pa re res kyang bsdus pa yin mod/ de gsumapomatshan gzhi dbye ba med pas/ phung po gang yin skye mched yin pa sogs mdoran dngos med rnams phar bzhag nas lhag ma gsum po phan tshun du spyi ldog nasango bo gcig go /dgos pa'i dbang dang / ldog cha'i sgo nas rnam tso thad da par bstan te/ dngos po rnams chos mi 'dra ba du ma kho na yin pag skyes pozho/bud pho do/ /ri'o/ khreng sdong ngo / khang bzang ngo / /zhes pa la sogs pa /—31 —
