'gal lo snyam na/ don dam pa'i ma rig pa ni ma rig pa ma yin cing/ ma rigapa 'gags pa don dam pa yang ma rig pa 'gags pa ma yin pas na/ ci'i phyira'agal bar 'gyur / de bzhin du sdug bsngal ba dang sogs la 'dir sdugabasngal ni/ nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga 'khor dang bcas pa ste/ sems can rnams kyi gnas snod kyi 'jig rten dang / nang lus sems kyi dngos po dang / de dag gi nye bar spyod pa thams cad sdug bsngal gsum po gang rung dang 'brel ba'i phyir sdug bsngal lo/ /sdug bsngal de la bde bar bzung na ni/ rangagimatshan nyid dang 'gal bas bya byed thams cad bslus par 'gyur la/ de sdugabasngal du shes pa ni yul dang mthun pa'i blo yin pa'i phyir/ nyams myong gosgonas mi bslu bas na bden pa zhe bya'o/ /mi bslu ba de yang 'phags pa rnams kho nas mngon sum du rtogs pa'i phyir/ 'phags pa'i bden pa ste/ 'khor ba'i gnas lus longs spyod rnamasasdug bsngal yin par bden pa ni/ sdug bsngal 'phags pa'i bden pa'i don yin la/ bden pa zhes bya ba'i don dam dpyod byed kyi rig ngor bden pa'am/'phags pa'i mnyam bzhag ngo bor bden pa'i don ma yin gyi/ tha snyad pa'i tshad ma'i yul yang dag kun rdzob tu bden pa'o/ /'phags pa'i bden pa'i go don kun 'byung dang / lam dang / 'gog bden gyi phyogs gcig kyang de dga'adra'o/ /kun 'byung gi sdug bsngal gyi rgyu ste/ spyi ldog nas sdug bsngal gang yin kun 'byung du'ang 'jog mod kyi/ 'dir las dang nyon mongs pa gang yin pa de thams cad kun 'byung ngo / /lam bden dngos ni/ mthong sgom mi slob la5— 84—

gsum gyis bsdus pa'i ye shes gsar byung rgyu rkyen las skyes pa rnams yin la/rjes mthun pa ni so so skye bo'i lam rnams kyang ste/ lam bden gyi ngo bo ni 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad dang / pha rol tu phyin pa bcu la chogasardepa'o/ /de'i yang gtso bo ni/ yang dag pa'i lta ba dang / lam shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /'gog bden ni gnas skabs pa dang mthar thug pa gnyis las/dang po ni/ lam bsgoms pas sgrib pa rnams gsar du spangs pa'i spangs pa ste/so sor brtags pa'i 'gog pa rnams yin la/ phyi ma ni 'khor 'das kyi chosakun 'gog pa'i gzhi/ rang bzhin 'od gsal bde bar gshegs pa'i snyingapo'o/ /'di ni chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs yin par bden cing/ 'phagasapa'i mnyam gzhag ye shes kyi ngo bor grub pas bden pa ste/ 'di yang kun rdzob kyi chos kyi ngo bor med la/ blos btags shing bzung ba ltar ma grub pa'i phyiraskabs 'gar med pa'i phyir skabs 'gar med pa'i tha snyad yang bya la/ bden pa gzhan gsum dang so sor brtags pa'i 'gog bden ni/ kun rdzob kyi shes pa la/ sgyu ma ltar snang la rang bzhin med pa dang / don dam pa'i ye shes kyi ngorasnang ba yang med pa'i phyir/ gdod ma nas ma grub cing med pa go /ye shes med ces pa mkhas par bya ba bcu'i dbang du byas na/ dbang po la mkhas par ston pa yin yang / drug gi dbang du byas na/ gnas dang gnas ma yin pa lamakhas par bya ba'i nang du 'dus te/ de la bden bzhi rtogs pa'i ye shes kyis nyon mongs pa'i sa bon spong ba ni/ gnas yin cing 'thad la/ 'jig rten pa'i snyoms 'jug rnams kyis de spong ba ni/ gnas ma yin pa dang /cho so kyi bdag— 85 —

med ge ge mu pa'i ༵ shes kyis shes sgrib spong zhing /de nyid thabs dang ba a pa thob pa na gnas nin la/thaba~X dang bral ba'ang ye shes de med na 'ad/cad mkhyen pa thob pa gnas ga mi dā no zhes sbyar te/ye shes dang de' byed las/smos pa'ang gnas dang gnas man kya 'gre tshan no//'i 'dangos su na/bdag med gnyis rtogs pa lam gya ye shes de bden par med la/ye shes zhes pas chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyang zur gyisa'aphangs par 'gyur na ni/de ni gnyis kyis stong pa'i phyir 'dus byas su med pas na med ces bya'o//ye shes med/mi shes pa med ces dpe kha cig/lasade ma mu 'a sgyu sku/ shā)tu dzo'adan pa ltar na/mu shes dang de' spang bya gnyas kar rang ban med pa dan te/gang bden pa' don mi shes pas 'khor bar 'khyam pa gnas yin pa dngarnam par mi rtog pa'i gnas mi shes pas/theg pa chen po'i lam dang 'bus bu rtogs par mi 'gyur ba gnas yin cing /de dag las zlog pa gnas ma yin no zhes sbyar ro//thob pa med ces bya ba ni rnam bshad byed pa phal che bas byang chub thob pa/nal ste ya spra spyor yang 'dir ni thob dro dang ma thob pa zhes spyi la sbyar nas/chos/gang mug cha rung ba de thams cad kya 'phel 'grib dang /gnas skabs so sor gyur ba 'a cha ste/ji skad du/thob pa gang zhe na/dge ba dang mi dgob dang/lung du ma bstan pa'i chos/rnams kyi/'phel ba dang ge ge ge mu pa thob pa dang/zhi/ pa dang ldan pa zhes gdags so/ci/zhesa~Xs gang ba 1 sang dang gang ga sa bon 'phel brtas pa dang /nus pa dman nga 'ag ba 1 sa pa dang/mngan gyur thob zi myo/ba'am mngon du ma gyur kyang /nus pa skyi 6 med gsar du rnyed pal/thob zin

nyams pa las byung ba rnyed pa dang / thob pa'i rgyun ma nyams par yod pa'i ldan pa ste/ sems can gyi rgyud dang 'brel ba de lta bu ni thob pa'i mtshon byed yin pas/ mdor na chos gang dang gang yin pa rang rang gi mthun pa'i rgyu las skye ba dang / 'gag pa dang mthun pa'i rgyus 'gag pa dang / gnas pa'i rgyus rigs mthun gnas pa dang / 'gyur ba'i rgyus rigs mi mthun du bsgyur ba sogs te/dper na mi'i rten la dge ba spyad pas tshe de nyid la ring du gnas pa ni/ ri'i rten gnas pa thob pa yin cing / de bzhin du dge ba'i mthu las phung po'i rigs rgyun lha'i rten du skye ba ni/ lha'i gnas skabs gsar du thob pa yin pa dang / de bzhin du mi dge ba'i rgyu las dmyal ba'i gnas skabs thob pa dang/gzhan yang bde ba thob pa dang / sdug bsngal thob pa dang / dar zhing 'phel ba'i dngos po thob pa dang / 'gribs shing rgud pa'i dngos po thob pa dang / skye ba thob pa dang / 'chi ba thob pa la sogs byung zhing gyur pa de ni mngon gyur du thob pa yin la/ da lta mngon du ma gyur yang / nges pa can gyi rgyu las 'byung bar ngesashing / 'gyur bar nges pa'i skabs su gyur pa yang de dang de thob pa sngar 'dasazin pa'i shugs de ltar yod na de yang byung zin dang gyur zin gyi dngos po ldan pa ste/ rnam pa 'di lta bu dag ni thob pa yin la/ de dag dang mtshan nyid 'gal ba'i dngos po ni ma thob pa ste/ thob pa dang ma thob pa 'di dag ni/ yas dngaganas ma yin pa dang yongs su 'brel ba'o/ /de yang dge ba byas pas mtho risathob pa ni gnas yin la/ ngan 'gro thob pa ni gnas ma yin te/ de mtho bo pa nyid gnas so/ /sred pa dang bcas pas skye ba thob par 'gyur ba ni gnas yin — 87—

la/ sred pa dang bral bas skye ba mi thob pa gnas yin cing / tshe zad na 'chib thob pa gnas yin pa sogs dang / de dag las zlog pa ni gnas ma yin pa sogs te/ de ltar yang rgyal tshab chen pos/ mi 'dod 'dod dang rnam dag dang/mnyam dang 'byung dang dbang byed dang /4/thob dang kun tu spyod pa dag /gzhan dbang nyid kyi don te gzhan/ /ces 'dod pa mtho ris sogs bde ba dang / mi'adod pa ni ngan song sogs sdug bsngal dang / gnas lugs rtogs pas semasarnam par dag par 'gyur ba dang / yul gyi tshad dang / dus kyi tshad 'a dang 'di lta bur dngos po 'di dang 'di dag mnyam du 'byung ba dang / mnyam du mi 'byungab dang / ngo bo dang bya ba gang dag gzhan gyi dbang du gyur pa ste/ dbang byed pa gzhan dbang du gyur pa dang / thob pa gzhan dbang du song ba dang / kun tu spyod pa gzhan dbang du song ba la sogs pa/ de dag ni mtshon byed de/ chos gang dang gang gi rgyu dang rkyen du rung ba dang / rgyu rkyen du nges pa las/ de dang de thob pa ni gnas yin cing / de las zlog na gnas ma yin pa'o/ /de ltar na de lta bu'i thob pa dang / ma thob pa'i rnam pa'i rab dbye tha dad pa thams cad kyang/rten 'brel tsam gyi mthu las kun rdzob sgyu ma tsam du ni ma 'dzings bar snang ba shar ba tsam yin gyi/ yang dag par na thob pa dang ma thob pa gnas dang gnasatshayin pa de dag cung zad kyang grub pa med do/ /de lta bas na gnas drug po de rnams la/ kun rdzob tu rang rang gi rgyu rkyen mtshan nyid rnam pa'i rab dbye mtha' dag zhib cing ma 'dzings la gsal bar shes pa dang / don dam par de dang de dang gang du yang ma grub pa'i mtha' bral dang / de dag gi rang bzhin chos nyid — 88 —

'gyur med rnam pa thams cad pa sgra rtog gi yul las 'das pa'i mtha' bral chen po la/ thos bsam gyi dus su nges pa rnyed par byas shing / blo gros gsal bas cig car blo la 'char zhing 'byung ba lta bu'i thabs la bslab/ sgom pa layid byed dang bcas pa dang / rnam par mi rtog pa'i tshul gnyis kyis nyamasasublangs shing dge ba'i rtsa ba gsog pa ni/ theg pa chen po las brtsams nasamakhas par bya ba'i dngos po drug la mkhas par byed pa yin la/ kun rdzob dngadon dam ji lta ba dang / ji snyed pa'i gnas tshul de dag 'phags pa'i salamangon sum du rtogs pa gyur na ni/ gnas drug la mkhas par byas zin pa ste/theg chen 'phags pa'i gnas skabs thob pa'o/ /de ltar na phung po rang bzhin med pa dang / skye mched rang bzhin med pa dang / khams rang bzhin med paragatan la dbab pa gsum ni/ chos de dang de'i kun rdzob kyi mtshan nyid lamakhas pa dang / don dam pa'i rang bzhin la mkhas pa'i dmigs pa'am rgyu mtshan no/ /rten 'brel bcu gnyis/ la mkhas pa dang / bden pa phu rgol mkhas/pa ni/ de dang der rang bzhin med par thos bsam sgom gsum gyis gtan laphab ste bsgoms pas/ blang dor kun rdzob bden pa dang / blang dor gyi gzhi don dam bden pa la mkhas par 'gyur ro/ /bden bzhi dang rten 'brel gnad gcig la/ de yang rgyu 'bras kyi ngo bo la rmongs pa bsal ba'i don du bden bzhibastan pa yin te/ kun 'gyung ni rgyur gyur pa'i 'khor ba dang / sdug bsngal 'bras bur gyur pa'i 'khor ba'o/ /lam ni thob byed rgyu'i rnam par byang ba dga'agog pa ni thob bya 'bras bu'i rnam par byang ba'o/ /rgyu de gnyis kyis 'bras/bu — 89 —

de gnyis 'grub tshul ni/rten 'brel yin te/kun 'byung gis sdug bsngalardebaskyed tshul la/ma rig pa nas rga shi'i bar 'khor ba lugs 'byung gi rten 'brel rnams 'byung ba yin cing /lam bsgoms pas sdug bsngal 'gag tshulardeni/rgyu lam bden gyis 'bras sdo 'gog sa thob tshul te ye shes skyes pa na rnyi rig pa 'gags dā nas/rga sha 'gags pa' bar du 'khor ra ba lugs zlog rten 'brel bcu gnyas so//gnas dang gnas ma yin pa la mkhas pa ni/rten 'brel gyi rgya brten du 'ong ba yin te/gang ci yang rung ba phyi nang gi rten 'brel mtha' dag gi rgyu 'bras rten 'brel phra zhing phra ba thams cad kyang rtogs pa'i phyir te/rten 'brelabacu gnyis ni rtsa ba'i rten 'brel yin la/'di ni yan lag phra mo rnams go/skyo sku :sku yiri'ad dang zhe ma spro zhi pa la ge 'di rtse cha stong nyad bsgoms par byas pas na/de rnams kya rang ba na stong pa nyad dang /ci / lha 'gyur rgyu 'bras la mkhasardepar 'gyur ba ste//spre tha/ran mkhas par bya bcig dngos ༵po drug la byang chub sems 'a yi mi sa geb mu tan du bslab par bya ba na no//gsum pa dertogs pa' lam gya yon tan na/de lta bsan byang chub sems dpa' rnamasalathob pa med pa'i phyir/zhes pa la sogs pa ste/'dir thob pa med pa'i phyirazhes pa ni tha ma'i gsal byed yin pas/gzugs med snros pa nas brtsams/pa thams cad la snyeg pa mngon la/gtso bor thob pa spyod smos pa gaganasalugs la rgyu 'bras bskyed bya skyed byed gang yang grub pa med cing /med pa ltarabyang chub sems dpas bsgoms pa na ༷din du gyur pa'i tshe/rang gi semasal

gnas pa'i sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa gdod nas stongs shing med pa dang / skrag pa ni 'jigs pa ste 'khor ba'i las nyon sdug bsngal rnams dang /ma rig bag chags kyi sa dang / zag med kyi las dang / yid kyi lus bas5gyis mi khyab pa'i 'chi 'pho dang bcas pa tshud chod kyang / 'khrul ba'i snang ba tsam ma gtogs gdod nas med par mthong bas phyin ci log 'gag ste/ mi rtag pa la rtag par 'dzin pa dang / rtag pa la mi rtag par 'dzin pa sogs phyin tsi logagi rnam rtog gi 'khrul ba dang / gzung 'dzin 'khrul ba'i snang ba ni phyin ci logagi snang ba ste/ de 'dra las 'das pa tsam po ni sa dang po thub pa nas 'byung zhing/de nas sa gong nas gong du phyin ci log de las shin tu 'da' bar 'gyur ro/ /myangan las 'das pa ni rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas yin la/ de la reg par byed pa nimathar phyin pa ste/ sa bcu rgyun gyi tha mar rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin mthon du byed pa'i don no/ /mdo'i 'di'i dngos bstan lta na sal ma gyi mngon par rtogasapa rnams gzhung tshig gi skabs 'dis gsal bar bstan pa yin no/ /rigs pa drug cu pa las/ de ngos la mkhas pa rnams kyis ni/ /dngos po mi rtag bslu ba'i chos/ /gsog dang stong ba bdag med pa/ /rnam par dbyen pa zhes bya b.ramathong / /zhes pa ltar mkhas par bya ba'i gnas drug la mkhas par byas pagaphyin ci log las 'das nas/ rnam par dbyen pa ste gnas lugs la reg parabya pa'i don no/ /bzhi pa lam des thob pa'i 'bras bu mngon du 'gyur tshul ni/ dusagasum gyi sogs te/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyang shes ra pa pha —91 —

rol tu phyin she ma 'a la bzhi she mnyam she gzhag pas/bla na ༷ pa da dag ༵ rdzags 'a byang chub tu mngan sa ring bzhi na she gas rgyas rdo yan tas/zab gyi mtshan nyad brgyad dang ldan ga par ba ba'i nga ngos she la dgasas yul sa du bar+sā pa dang /mkhas 'a ngh+ru bshe dngas pa drug laXpha5rdepa' lam sher phyan nyams len du bsten pa nyad sa sa//de ltar yang bstad pa las/dbyen pa'i ye shes rig gyur pa//'jig rten 'das khyod phyag 'pha5rderke tsho de tsho 0re rdo nyi bru pe nosnyud/ce/gaX kau/da dra ge ge ge de ge ge de ge ge ge ge ge /me/do ce ngas thugs 3sa snabajegyur//sa gzi//da ltar gang du 'a da sa ༷ she ma thab pa rmed pabar thrung/sgras zan la mkhas par bya ba 'a yul 'a pa/spras ༵༷du ma lha pa ce blordophab /la / ye bsnan de'i yul sdig la mkhas pa' snyen sa/ ༷na bas ces re kho/par ba3n la/༷ gas 'a phan yan she ༵bras zi na/dad lta baX kau/ pa mu/mu ye skyabangs me shes rgyas sa bar ra//da ltar na mu gi ljo na tsha/ kya bdag ༷ pa kha na 'a dbang ༄ de ni sa sa 'dzi kya/kha zag she 'i phyi gu tsho she 'dan she/she/ 'di ༵'a sgoragang zag gi rnga da 1 ga/me/'an snye rwa ri shadage sde ge byung du kha na nyad la ༵khaX pa de sgan gang zag che rdo/dug da ci spre shan tu rgyas par bstan pa byed na rnyi/ ltar yangargyal tshab po'i/she dang rgyu dang za she nga she//da pa dang 'ar pa 9 /bstsurardedang //she she rtag pa 'di //nyan ru mi pa dang za lta zhes//sa//rnal swā/she cu ni ma gral//'a dag sdund bdaX nye zhe ༵//// dang/mkhas kha na rnam bcu //bdag / ༷lta ba 'a gnyan pa'// gsungs pa

las/ bdag gcig pur 'dzin pa'i gnyen por phung po la mkhas pa dang / rgyura'adzin pa'i gnyen por khams la mkhas pa dang / zab por 'dzin pa'i gnyen por skye mched la mkhas pa dang / byed por 'dzin pa'i gnyen por rten 'brelalamakhas pa dang / bdag kun nas nyon mongs bya dang rnam par byang byar 'dzin pa'i gnyen por bden pa bzhi la mkhas pa ste/ de dag sngar bshad pas gol/bdag por 'dzin pa'i gnyen por dbang po la mkhas pa ni/ ye shes med cesapas bstan te/ dbang po nyi shu rtsa gnyis las/ pho mo dang srog gi dbang po ni lus dang yid kyi khams su 'dus shing / mig rna sna lce lus yid kyi dbang po drug ni/ mig med ces sogs kyis gtan la phab zin la/ tshor ba'i dbang po lnga po yang tshor ba med ces gtan la phab zin pas/ lhag ma dad sogs dbang po lnga ni sbyor lam ba'i ye shes yin la/ kun shes par byed pa'i dbang po mthong lamogyi ye shes dang / kun shes pa'i dbang po sgom lam gyi ye shes dang/ kun shesaldan pa'i dbang po mi slob lam gyi ye shes yin pas/ ye shes med ces pasadabang po brgyad po de rang bzhin med par bstan pa yin no/ /dbang po phyi mgasum po spyir/ ji skad du/ mthong sgom mi slob lam la dgu/ zhes pa lta bu/dad sogs lnga/ yid dang tshor ba gsum gyi rdzas su yod par bshad cing / gzhung gzhan las/ kun shes byed pa la rdzas bcu yod par yang bshad mod kyi/ gotshobo ni shes rab kho na'o/ /rang dbang du 'dzin pa'i gar+sā por/ khas dngaganas min la mkhas pa ni/ thob pa med sogs so/ /rnal 'byor can du 'dzin pa'i gnyen por/ theg pa la mkhas pa ni/ sgrib pa med cing skrag pa med ces pa —93 —

dzhai/sni ltar yang /yon ta/ skyon dang rnyi/ bya po/yugasangs pa'i las gagadi /nges pa~XpaXyā/rdeng 'ad dge ge mu bya// lted las/skabasa'ar rnam par ti pa' ye ge she la bar 9 rdo dzin : 'a ཿ༷ bha gsal bar bstan ta//bdag rnyi gral ba dang gral bar /rngan pa' gnyen paras sde byas 'a ༷nyis dzo byas ste tre / ltar mkhas pa na/mya ngan las 'dasapa' mthar phyan ta/'a/gāX / 'a yang /tis bcas rgyu~Xn che khri ma.ā+oṃ daX //rab tu zha sna kyi dan bcas na//tha ṭā nyad du bstan rdo snya//'i ba'i ///snyus byas ye nga/ 'a 'dzo she /zhes rje she she wo tushesaXsne rig dod dod dge//skye zhiba'i she mub lte ge 'a brta~X/mu rtse ga 'gag de thob dung/'a tu sa ba 'a 'gag pa mu spo she zhang /lam dzin 'a ru she thabs yan pas rab tu zha spro ni dus/bdagazhes sogs kyis bstan te kun/dus snar la rtse she par bya ba /dus gsu5du zi myo / sku nga kyas bstan /'a ga me tu dzo rnga rdzo thams cad dus gsum du byunga~X kha na na pas/dha gtu 'khor zhi dal/dan 'a par dus gsum rangaX/ngad pas/dus la rtag tu 'kha/ra nga tshugs thub pa' bdag rtag pa gal yad/ces pa'o//des na gang zag bdag med kyi ngo bo ngos 'dzin tsam ni/sna che 0ri :)theg ze'i na/rdechung gnyas ma de 'dra bar she kya 1 nga she /rnam grangs kyi las rgyas pas stora~Xstana~X tsam ra ༵ bstan she//bzhe pa las kyang se/phung pa tsaX las graX ḍi she//mas can da par ye she( lags//mas can sde/ lam che7/gzhal bar//thub pa wo pa khyad ༷༷ bzhugs//zhes te/le ngon rten nyer

len gyi phung po sdug bsngal 'di thams cad las las skyes la/ de yang nyon mongs las byung zhing / de'i rtsa ba bdag tu 'dzin pa yin no zhes/ dkon mjogagasum la skyabs su song ba thams cad la thun mong du bsgrags pa yin no/ /bdag 'dzin 'di ni dngos po la log par zhugs pa yin gyi/ don dang mthun par blos bzung ba ma yin te/ bdag ces bya ba blos btags pa ma yin paratshugs thub zhig yod na ni/ phung po nyid yin nam/ phung po las gzhan du lod/dang po ltar na/ mi'i phung po dor nas dmyal ba'i phung po len pa sogs mi srid par 'gyur te/ phung po ni bdag rtag pa dang gcig pa'i phyir ro/ /phung po du ma'i rang bzhin can ma yin par 'gyur te bdag gcig pu'i mtshan nyid can gyi ngo bo yin pa'i phyir ro/ /yang phung rbo ni bdag ma yin te/ bdag go nye bar blang bya yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ltar na/ bdag la bde sdug myong ba sogs 'dus byasakyimatshan nyid med par 'gyur te/ bdag de ni phung po tsam sto phung po thams cad las grol ba'i phyir ro/ /'dus ma byas la ni 'gro 'ong dang bde sdug myong ba sogs thams cad 'gal ba yin no/ /de'i phyir yang dag par na bdag med kyang bdag tu blta bas bcings pa'i sems can rnams la thugs rje'i gzhan dbang du gyur nas sangs rgyas nyid thob par mdzad pa'ang yin no/ /de la rnawa'abyor pas ting nge 'dzin dang lam ji ltar sgom pa dang mngon du 'gyur ba'i tshul ni/ 'di yin te/ gang zhig theg pa chen po la slob par 'dod pa des dkonamachog gsum la snying pa thag pa nas skyabs su song zhing / 'grub na so so thar—95 —

pa rigs gang rung gi sdom pa blang dgos te/ sdom pa 'di theg chen gyi la5skye ba'i rgyur med na ye mi rung bar rang ta ma yin mod kyang / 'di la bslab paraminus pas byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa la bslab nus pa'i phyir dang /gzhan mu stegs byed pa sogs dang mi 'dre zhing sems can gyi don spyod pa'i mthu dang ldan pa'i phyir dang / theg pa mtha' dag la slob dgos pa byang chub sems dpa'i bslab bya yang yin pa'i phyir bslab pa rjes su bsgrub dgos pa dang / 'di nyid sems bskyed kyis zin na theg chen gyi nyes pa spyod kyi sdom pa'i tshul khrims kyi gtso bor 'gyur ba'i phyir theg chen las kyang 'di shin tu bsngags pas so/ /de nas nges par byang chub tu sems bskyed de/ skyabasasubab pan sems bskyed kyi sdom pa yang blang ngo / /de nas dge ba'i bshes gnyen dam pa la bsten cing / theg pa chen po'i mdo sde gcig la dmigs te ge tsobo rabasgoms na/ ting nge 'dzin ni skye sla bas de ltar bya ba'am/ gzhan du na gsungarab spyi la dmigs kyang rung ste/ nges par 'byung ba la sogs pas rgyud bskulanas/ snying rje wo po dang stong pa nyid kyis don sgom pa dang / bsngo ba la sogasapa thabs la mkhas pa'i khyad par la slob cing / chos spyod bcu'am thos bsamasgom gsum gyis dus 'das pas/ ring zhig na shin tu goms shing byang bsa'abad rtsol dang dga' ba med par ngang gis 'jug pa dang / dad pa dang shesarab kyi stobs kyi tshe de la rkyen gang byung kyang / dkon mchog gsum dang thegachen nam du yang mi spong bar gnas pa dang / bde sdug tsi byung ba thams cad myongatsam nyid nas las kyi 'bras bur shes pa dang / nam du yang chos las 'da' — 96 —

bar mi dpyod pa de tshe/ zhi lhag gi ting nge 'dzin skyes kyang rung / ma skyes kyangarung ste/ lam sna zin pa dang tshogs kyi lam rgyud la skyes pa yin no/ /de nas yon tan de gong 'phel du song nas/ tshogs khyad par can bsags pa las/ dbang po rno rtul gyi khyad par gyis dus la nges pa med kyang/de kho na nyid kyi don la dmigs pa'i zhi gnas dang lhag mthong nges par grub/chos rgyun gyi ting nge 'dzin chung ngu thob pas/ sangs rgyas mang po'i zhal mtho/ sum du mthong / gsung gi snang ba yang 'byung ste/ chos kyi sgo'i ting nge 'dzin 'di ni/ stong nyid la dmigs pa'i lhag mthong dang / sangs rgyas la dad pa zung du sbrel ba de/ sangs rgyas kyi sku dang zhing khams yid la byed pa'i zhi gnas kyisamago bsdus pa las 'byung ngo / /'di ni 'bad rtsol gyis yid la byed pa bsgrubasapas 'byung ba yang yod/ skye ba shin tu mang por tshogs bsags shing smon lamabatab pa'i mthu las/ dus skabs der ngang gis skye ba yang yod de/ tsho gos kyi lam mthar phyin pa yin no/ /de nas chos thams cad la bdag med rnam pa gnyis cha mnyam du sgom dgos pa yin kyang / stong nyid la gsal snang skye tshulonirim can du 'byung ste/ kun btags thams cad dang khyad par gzung ba phyi rolakyi don rnams gdod ma nas ma grub pa la gsal snang chung ngu skyes pa na/ sbyoralam drod yin la/ gsal snang 'bring du skyes pa na sbyor lam rtse mor zhi 'gyurang/skabs 'dir ting nge 'dzin gyi lus grub pa dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi stobs kyisaphyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing mang po rim can du yin yang myur bor bgrod par nus so/ /de nas de la gsang snang rab kyi mthar phyin pa skyes shing/de'i — 97 —

stobs kyis 'dzin pa bden med la yang gsal snang 'ol spyi skyes par gyur pa de'i tshe sbyor lam bzod pa yin no/ /de nas mnyam gzhag tu gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa mngon 'gyur ba 'gags shing / 'dzin pa rang bzhin med pa la gsawa snang tsam po mthar son pa dang / rjes thob tu yang snang ba sgyu ma ltar 'char te/skabs 'dir chos kyi sgo'i ting nge 'dzin wo po thob par 'gyur ba ni sbyor lam chos mchog go /ting nge 'dzin gyi lus thob pa yan chad nas/ gzung༅dang tingange 'dzin dang rnam 'phrul mtha' yas pa dang / dbang po yang rnon po kho na'i gnas skabs thob cing / thabs la mkhas pa'i khyad par dpag tu med pa dngaldan pa yin no/ /de nas de'i rjes su sngar yun ring por tshogs bsags pa dang /de kho na nyid la goms pa'i 'bras bu cig char smin nas/ mthong lam rnam parami rtog pa'i ye shes cho se nyid mngon sum du mthong ba/ rjes thob yon to dpag tu med pa dang bcas pa stan thog gcig la 'byung bar 'gyur te/ mnyam/gzhag dang rjes thob gnyis kar gyi yon tan sngar sbyor lam chos mchog chen po'i dus kyi des kyang / brgya stong gi cha la sgrun par mi nus pa 'byung la/ de ltaramathong lam du chos nyid kyi rang bzhin ni mthong zhing / spros pa dang bral ba rnams dpyad phyogs kyi mtshan nyid mtha' dag gsal bar rtogs nas sgro 'dogs chod pa yin kyang / yongs gcod kyi phyogs rtag cing brtan pa dang / rnam pa thams cad pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ rang stobs kyis mtha' dag rtogs pa ma yin mod/ sangs rgyas kyis gsung la bsten nas ni rtogs so/ /lam de rgyud la skyesapa dang / 'khor ba'i lusang ga yid gsum spangs ba dang / mtshan dpe rjes—98 —

mthun can gyi yid lus dngos grub pa dang / nyan rang gi spangs rtogs thams/cad rdzogs pa dus mnyam/ phyi nas mthong lam de rjes thob la yang yun bdu gnas pa srid de/ de dag mthong lam nyid du gtogs so/ /byang chub semasadapa' 'phags pa ni thabs la mkhas shing rnam 'phrul la mnga' brnyes pa'i phyir skabs gzhan nas mthong lam nyid la yang bskal pa mang por gnas pa dang /che 'bring chung gsum re re yang gsum gsum dgu'i dbye ba byas pa sogs yod pa'ang mi 'gal bar ma zad ngo mtshar chen po'i gtam yin la/ theg dar na gyi mthong lam la ni de 'dra mi srid par grags par ltar 'thad do/ /mthong latsharjes thob dang bcas pas sa dang po'i phyed 'byer zhing / sa dang po'i phyed phyi ma ni sgom lam yin no/ /sa gnyis pa nas bcu pa'i bar du yang sgom lam yin pa las/ de dag gi spangs pa dang / rtogs pa dang / yon tan gyi khyad par dang/'phrin las ji ltar spyod pa'i tshul sogs rnam gzhag mtha' yas la/ de dga'aphags pa sa bcu pa las rgyas par bstan pa dang / 'phags pa dkon mchog brtsegs pa'i nang gi blo gros mi zad pas zhus pa dang / gzhan yang mdo sdedagongs pa nges par 'grel pa la sogs pa/ mdo sde rgya chen po dag las shesapar bya dgos so/ /de lta mi nus na mdo sde gang yang rung ba gcig la dmigasagatan du byas nas/ zhib bshad rnams rje btsun gyi rgyan dang dbus mtha' rnama'abyed sogs las blang bar bya la/ gzhan dbu ma 'jug par grags pa las bstan pa sogs ni/ lhag chad nor gsum dang bcas pa'i phyir yid brton parami 'os pa'ang snang ngo / /'dir sa bcu ngo bo zur tsam smos na/ rgyal tshes zhi —99—

pos gsungs pa/ byang chub sems dpa' lta ba rnam par dag khri 9 /khrin/sa shin tu rnam dag mnyam par gzhag /chos la nga spangs rgyud dang kun nyon phros/ /rnam par dag pa tha dad nga rgyal med/ /skad cig gcig blo thob pa btang snyomasapa/ /zhing rnams sbyong ba sems can smin byed pa/ /mkhas pa mthu chen lusayongs rdzogs pa dang / /nges par bstan la mkhas pa dbang bskur na/ khe 〉 ༅gsungs pa ltar bu ste/ sa dang po rab tu dga' ba ni/ chos nyid me phe/ sum du rtogs pa'i phyir lta ba rnam par dag pa dang / rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes yangadag par thob pa'o/ /spyir sa thams cad du pha rol tu phyin pa bcu ka la yongasasu sbyor ba yin kyang / 'dir sbyin pa la gtso bor spyod pa'o/ /sa gnyis pa la ni/lus ngag gi lta ci smos sems kyi nyes lhung phra mo tsam yang kun tu spyod pa med cing / nyes lhung med pa de la ngang gis 'jug pa yin gyi bsgrim mi dgos pa'i phyir tshul khrims shin tu rnam par dag pa ste de'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'o/ /sa gsum pa ni spyir bsam gtan gzugs med sogs 'jig rten pa'i ting nge 'dzin thun mong pa rnams ni/ snga rol nas thob zin mod kyi/ rdzer ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams nyid kyi thun mong gi spyod yul yin yang gzhan mu stegs dang / nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams dang thun mong gi spyod yul du ma gyur pa/ bsam gtan gzugs med sogs dang rigs mthun pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi khyad par 'jig rten pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi rigs can dpag tu med pa bsgrubs shing mnyam par 'jog pa'i don te/ 'dir lung gi chos la yid cesapa'i dad pa bla lhag tu 'phel zhing / 'on kyang chos la sred pa cung zad ma log— 100 —

par yod do/ /sa bzhi pa la ni/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi thun mongawayin pa'i/ byang phyogs so bdun gyi khyad par mi 'bral ba mtha' yas pa thob pa dang / brjod bya rjod byed kyi chos la tha dad pa'i nga rgyal spangs shing/ go tshe/tumangon par zhen pa ni snga nas kyang med mod/ 'dir brda tsam du rtogs pa'i phyiralung gi chos la sred pa ni rtsa ba nas log kyang / dad pa 'gribs pa ni ma yin te 'phel ba'o/ /sa lnga pa ni/ bden bzhi'i don nyan thos rang rgyal rnams kyis ming tsam dang / phyogs tsam yang ma rtogs pa'i don gyi rnam pa'i rab dbye dang /'jug ldog gi de kho na nyid mtha' yas pa rtogs pa'i phyir/ de'i grub don du skye ba med pa mnyam pa nyid la sogs pa bcus mnyam nyid kyi tshul gyis rang gzhan snod bcud thams cad rgyud tha dad par 'dzin pa leg ste/ rgyud la nga rgyal spangasab yin no/ /sa drug pa ni/ rang rgyal man chad dang thun mong ma yin pa'i kun rdzob kyi de bzhin nyid dang / don dam pa'i de bzhin nyid kyi rten 'brel 'gra/ldog gi rim pa dang de'i gnas lugs la shin tu goms par byas pas/ kun nas nyon mongs dang rnam byang tha dad du blta ba'i nga rgyal spangs pa ste/ kun byangastong par rtogs tshul sngar bas kyang ches lhag pa'i khyad par thob pa yin no/ /sabadun pa la ni/ bsgrim pa'i rtsol ba yod kyang / de las gzhan pa'i mtshan wamed pa'i ting nge 'dzin la rtag tu gnas pa'i mthus/ skad cig skad cig la byangaphyogs so bdun la sogs pa/ chos kyi sgo mtha' yas pa ci char rgyud la bskyed pa'i mthu thob pa yin te/ sa snga ma drug rgyu dang 'di 'bras bur 'jog pa'i rnatshagazhag kyang byung ba/ sa bdun po rang las nang tshan du phye na lam dang 'bras ja'i— 101 —

tshul du gnas pa'ang yin no/ /sa dang po drug la ni/ mtshan ma'i rnam par rtogapa mi 'dod kyang 'byung ba'i skabs yod la/ sa 'dir ni de lta bu 'byung ba med pas 'dod pas bskyed na ma gtog gas mtshan ma med pa nyid la gnas nus pa yin no/ /sa brgyad pa la ni/ 'bad rtsol med par mtshan ma med pa lhun gyisagrub par gnas te/ de'i rgyu mtshan gyis rtogs pa dang ye shes rgyun chad pa med pa'i phyir/ phyir mi ldog pa dang / mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa wo po thob pa yin no/ /'di la 'bad rtsol med pa'i phyir btang snyoms zhes gsungs shing/ kun gzhi rigs mthun pa gcig gi phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du cig char lus ston nus pas/ zhing sbyong ba la rang dbang thob pa yin no/ /sadagu pa la ni/ so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi thob ste/ sems can mtha' yasapa'i bsam pa dang mtshungs par chos ston pa la sogs pa/ sems can yongs su smin par byed pa la dbang thob pa'ang yin no/ /sa bcu pa la ni/ ye zhe parashes pa la sogs pa'i mthu phul du byung ba dang / ting nge 'dzin dang gzungs kyi sgo r+sā med pa thob pa'i phyir/ chos kyi lus yongs su rdzogs pa dang/ dag spru ldan du skye ba ston pa la sogs pa sprul pa sna tshogs pa ston pa la dbang thob pa yin no/ /sa 'di dang por thob nas mi ring ba na/ 'od zer ho po'i 63 paradabang bskur ba 'byung zhing / de nas dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyiskugasung thugs kyi gsang ba rtogs pa dang bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po'i mtshan nyid rang stobs kyis mngon sum du mthong ba dang / sangs rgyas kun gyi 'phrin las dang lhan cig spyod pa yin no/ /sa dang po thob pa nas brtsams te/ sladag— 102 —

pa'i lus ni ye gyur/yid kyi rang bzhin gyi ni dang /rang snang gokhornyims phun dzo gas pa tsho go/bal/sa twan dro rdzags ye ye la mi//ye/da zhe pa mus sum swā pas brgyan paX ri pa yin ci dang /'an sprag pa she pya' 'a 'char she mthunaX ra spyad pa yan nga /༵༵ ge glu pa re dzo mtharan/sdug pa bkad pa' zhang dngas la bgrad par 'gyu/ra la/sa mthara'og min gyi zhing de nyid du/rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin bsgrubs te/los rdzo snye shā ge tsho de 7rde no si hu smirdege shad dodage ge rtogazigadod dge ge ge ge ge sde ge ge ge ge ge ge sde spyo shad dodage du skye shā sdoXsproraXgyur rdzo bas/da ltar sa ༵swā~X/ skabs da dkri tu ye she gas myos rdzo/ du rdo stan dā sags/khams gsum she yi//can snas kyas she she minang na dag na//༷ par she pa kha she si par sa//༷ga she sbyis pa' rjas su/dgas mu sa ༵dzad pa bcu 'a 'a kya tshul stan pa shas bar ༷ge ge zhe la/sa bcu' ga5/ mas sher na mu nyad kya rnam pre gci las she grel 'a kya mdzad pa sde ri // spyang paX rdod caX sprang rnam pa gag tu na/ni nas byang chub kyi snying por gshe/ spyad pa mu nga /da' rnam 'khru/༷ rda/ min rdzo ldan nas zhi/ lha byang chub kya she par gas rnyi' brdo du yang ཿnga la/dzog na du dzo sa ye dzo dzi pa nas nga khrang sherdes/'ar yang spu rdzo/nga chub dzi ༷ dang /mas kya lhor la 'a ba sgyu tshul rdo nordeye ge' ༷snyaXri sku she shes she//'bras gā snras rgyas kya bsngis mun mu/tho kyā sku spras cing gya shas dzir 'da~X kya spo yang de mu la ni nyid mkhyen tshul rgyas khyab gong/mdag pa' snang ba ༷rtog pa ye shes nyag gtsi mkhyan na yin/ pa dang /rang ngo bo mkha' mkho rnaX rdor mi rtog pa ye shes nyag

no/ /longs spyod rdzogs sku dngos ni/ gong du spyod pa'i i sku de nyid/ sangs rgyas rang snang la sku mtshan dpe can rnam pa thams cad pa dang / gsung brjod bral sgra dbyangs thams cad pa dang / 'khor dang zhing dang mchod pa'i bkod pa dpag tu med pa dang bcas par 'char ba'o/ /yang dmigs pa'i yul de khon rang la dmigs pa yin kyang / de'i gnas tshul las gzhan du snang ba/ sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams la nges pa lnga ldan gyi longs sku gnas dang 'khor dang bcas par snang ba 'di yang longs skur bsdu ste/ snang tshul gyi dbang du byasapa'o/ /longs sku gnyis po de la bya ba sgrub pa'i ye shes kyi snang cha'i tshul du sprulasku'i sku gzugs dang zhing dang 'khor dang mdzad pa thams cad/ cig char rtagatu'achar ba zhig yod pa las/ sangs rgyas rang snang gi don gnas tshul gyi sprulaskudangos yin cing / sa bcu'i sems dpa' la snang ba de dngos ma yin kyang phyogasamathun du bsdu la/ de dag ni sprul pa'i sku yin gyi sprul pa ma yin no/ /de dgagogazugs brnyan gyi tshul du sprul pa byung ba ni/ gnas gtsang ma'i steng gi namamakha' la gnas gtsang ma chen po 'og min gnyis pa dbang phyug chen po'i gnas su/ 'od lus rdzus te skyes pa'i tshul du sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku 'byung ste/'dzam gling bye ba phrag brgya rnams su sprul pa'i skus mdzad pa ci tsam ston pa thams cad des kyang gnas der gzugs brnyan gyi tshul du ston par mdzad do/ /'di ni mchog gi sprul sku chen po'o/ /nam mkhar zla ba gcig shar ba na chu klung bye ba phrag brgyar gzugs brnyan re re 'char ba bzhin du/ des mdzad pa bstan pa'i gzugs brnyan 'dzam gling bye ba phrag brgyar sprul pa'i sku 'byung ba — 104 —

ni/ sprul sku chung ngu yin te 'di gnyis ni sprul pa ni dngos te sku ni snang tshul gyi dbang du byas pa'o/ /'phrin las ni de ltar sku gsum po dngos dang btags pa ba de dag gis sems can rnams kyi sdug bsngal zhi ba dang / 'gro rnams nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas dang bla na med pa'i byang chub rnams la 'god par mdzad pa rnams yin te/ so so'i skal ba dang 'tsham par sbyor ba'o/ /zhes rtogs par bya'o/ /de ltar gong 'og tu gzhi lam 'bras bu spyi don cung zad brjod pa 'di rnams ni gzhung chen po dag shes zin pa dang / da lta mi shes rung 'thul du slob par 'gyur ba dag la nges par bshad dgos pa ma yin kyang / gzhung rgya chen po slob par mi nus shing / chos kyi don rags pa go bar 'dod na phyogasa'adi'i rab tu byung ba'am/ dge bsnyen nam kun spangs kyi spyod pa can thamasacad kyis thun mong du 'don pa/ tha na bag med pa'i khyim btsun dang grong mi phalapa la yang grags pa'i mdo sde tshig gi shin tu nyung ngu 'di dag la brten nas/chos kyi tshul go bar gyur na legs par mthong ste/ phyogs tsam smos pa yin la/tshigs gsal por brjod mod kyang / don dbyings che bas sngar gzhung lugasamishes pa dag gis/ dpe klogs pa tsam gyis ni go bar dka' yang / 'der ji skad bstan pa'i don rnams shes pa'i slob dpon gyis yang nas yang du 'dzub khrid du byas shing nan tan du dpyad na rtogs par 'gyur ro/ /lnga pa phan yon dang bcas pa'i gzungs sngags bstan pa ni/ de ltabasan shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sngags/ zhes pa la sogs pa ste gong du bstan pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i ye shes rgyal ba rnams kyi chos sku — 105 —

de'i rgyu mthun pa'i gas sngags yin ces pa'o/ /rigs pa chen po ni/ 'dod pa'i don thams cad 'grub par byed pa'i don te/ dka' ba med pa dgos don 'grub pa'i thabs la rig pa zhes grags pa'o/ /bla na med pa ni/ chos sku rig sngags kyi rnam pa can de'i 'od lta bur 'jig rten du rig sngags byung ba yin pas/ rig sngags 'di yang 'jig rten las 'das pa ngo bo shin tu bzang ba ḍādilas gong na gzhan med pa'o/ /mi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ni/ 'o de las gong na lhag par lta zhog 'dra ba yang med ces pa ste/ dpes mtshon du med pa go /yangan mi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par byed pa'i don yang yin no/ /yang gzhan don gyi dbang du byas na sems can gyi sdug bsngalathams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i don no/ /chos sku mi brdzun cing bden pa grub pa de'i rgyu mthun pa yin pa'i phyir/ rig sngags 'jig rten du byung ba 'de yang / log pa'am/ brdzun pa'am/ bslu ba ma yin par/ rang gzhan gyi don mtha' dag sgrub pa la bden cing nges la/ yid tshes par byed pa zho /de lta bur shes par bya ste zhes sngags kyi phan yon yid la byed dgos par bstan nas/phan yon de dang ldan pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i rig sngags 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyis smras pa ste bshad pa ni/ ta du blo ni/ 'de lta ste/ gte ga te ni gshe/gas pa gshe/gas pa zhes pa la gde/gas pa'i don rtogs pa ste/kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i bden pa rab ( 〈rdza〉 rgo tu ) rtogs pa'o/ /pa ra ni mchog ga te gong bzhin yin pas/ mchog tu rtog pa mthar thugagi gnas lugs rtog pa'am/ chos thams cad kyi gnas tshul du song zhing— 106—

gshegs pa'o/ /pa ra sang ga te ni mchog tu yang dag par gshegs pa ste/ dzisnyed pa'i chos thams cad la ye shes yang dag par song zhing rtogs pa de yang ji lta ba las g.yo bar mi byed pas na mchog go /bo dhi ni byang chub ste chos dbyingasade nyid bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi ngo bo yin pa'i phyir ro/ /swāhā ni sngon gyi lotsāb rnams kyi gzhi tshugs shig par bsgyur te/ rig sngags de 'grub par smen pa yin la/ spyir 'di la don shin tu mang ba zhig bshad du yod de/ sngags bsgyuraba'i don ni de tsam yin la/ rigs sngags kyi yi ge'i 'bru re re'i phan spon ni bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ye shes kyi spyod yul yin pas/ tshur rol mthong ba bdag lta bus ba4/da pa ga la nus/ dpe kha cig las/ sngags smras pa zhes/mi'adon par sngags rig pa'o zhes 'byung ba ni/ u ka ta dang yug ta'i sgra'i khyad par gyis yin la/ dri med bshe/sa gnyen gyi 'grel ba'i lugs la ni/ gzugasardesngags med cing / sngags su bstan pa'i phan yon rnams/ mdo tshig gongamarnams kyi che ba bstan pa 'chad de/ 'on kyang 'di ni glegs bam ma dag pa'i skyon yin pas dkyus su bshad pa nyid legs la/ yang kha cig shes rab pha rol tu phyin pa'i mdo sde 'di sngags kyi theg pa ston pa'i phyir yin zhes smra ba ni 'brel med cal col tsam mo/ /drug pa don bsdu'i phyir du sher phyin la slob par gdams pa ni/ shā ri'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sogs te/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab momatshan nyid brgyad dang ldan pa de la mkhas pa'i thabs drug la sogs pa thabasatshul de lta bu'i sgo nas bslab par bya'o/ /— 107—

gnyis rgyal bas mthun 'gyur sgo nas the tshom bsal ba ni/ de nasabacom ldan 'das sogs te/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyis mdo 'di'i rgyas bshad zin pa'i dus de la/ bcom ldan 'das zab mo snang ba'i ting nge 'dzin de las gzhengs pa'i tshul bstan cing / gdul bya rnams kyis de ltar shes par byin gyis brlabs nas/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs la legs so stsal ba ste/ legs so sbyin nas zhes bya ba ni/ mdor bstan yin la/ legs so legs so nas yid rang ngo'i bar rgyas bshad do/ /des na legs so zhes bya ba yin nas/ ji ltar legs so stsal zhe na/legs so legs so zhes sogs yin pas/ nas zhes pa go rim snga phyi ston pa'i tshig ma yin no/ /de yang 'khor rnams kyi rnam par rtog pa la/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyis bstan pa 'di yang zab cing rgya che ba yin mod kyi/ hon kyangade bzhin gshegs pas dngos su gsung na ni/ 'di bas kyang ches lhag pa zhig yod do snyam na rgyal ba'i sras kyis bstan pa la mgus pa zlog pa'i phyir ro/ /legs so gnyis smos pa ni/ ngo mtshar ba dang rtsod pa dang/ khrodang zhu5dang nges bzung dang / /dga' dang dad pa dag la ni/ /tshig gcag la na gnyesarde'abyung ba yin/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ / rigs kyi bu zhes ston pa nyid kyis spyan rasagazigs la bos nas/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la bslab tshul ni de khon bzhin yin gyi gzhan ma yin pas/ 'khore rnams kyis kyang spyan ras sags/kyis bstan pa bzhin du slobs shig /spyan ras gzags kyis chos bstan pa 'di la/ deng de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa nga nyid rjes su yi rang b.ratsha— 108 —

zad phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyang dgyes pas rjes su yi rang ngo / /rtsa ba'i gsum pa mthar 'khor rnams kyis yi rang mngon par bstod pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces sogs te/ sangs rgyas kyis mthun 'gyur mdzad pa'i rkyen gyis/ shā ri'i bu ni bdag gis dris pa don dang ldan no zhes dang / spyan ras gzigs kyang bdag gis bsha/da pa la yang legs parabashad do snyam pa dang / 'khor gzhan rnams ni de bzhin gshegs pas de ltaragasungs pa la/ dga' zhing yid ches pas de'i rgyu mtshan gyis spyan ras gags kyis yang dag par bshad pa de la shin tu yi rang pas mngon par yid brton cing glo gtod par byed pa'i don no/ /lha ni nam mkha' la spyod pa dang/ mi ni sasteng na spyod pa dang / lha ma yin ni sa 'og na spyod pa dang / dri za ni de gsum char du spyod pa ste/ mgo tsam smos pas thams cad go ba'i phyir ro/ /thams cad dang ldan pa zhes pa la/ rigs thams cad dang ldan pa dang / kha dog sna tsho gos pa dang / dbyibs sna tshogs pa dang / longs spyod sna tshogs pa dang / yul sna tshogs pa la sogs pa 'khor gyi dkyil snyen ra de na thams cad 'dus pa'i tshul du yod ces spyir bstan nas lha la sogs pa khyad par du smos pa'o/ /de tsam gyis ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyi shu lnga pa shes rab snying por grags pa'i mdo 'di nyid kyi dngos bstan gyi don rnams phul du phyin par mdzad zin to/ /mdo 'di la rgya gar gyi 'grel par grags pa 'ga' re yod pa las/ gyoskad du/ bi ma la mi tra/ bod skad du/ dri med bzhas gnyen zhes bya ba/ rgyal po— 109 —

khri srong lde btsan gyi dus su bod du byon pa des mdzad pa'i rgya cher 'grel par grags pa 'di bzang shos su snang la/ phyogs 'dir byon pa chen po sngon rabasapa thams cad kyis kyang / 'grel pa 'di'i sgo nas 'chad nyan gyis gtan la'abebs par mdzad do/ /'dir tshangs pa'i 'byung gnas gtsug lag khang gnas pa'i/ dge slong dge 'dun rnams kyi zhal ngor ni/ shes rab pha rol phyin pa'i snying po yi/ /rgya cher bshad pa dri ma med pas byas/ /zhes 'byung ske chos ge r+sha bsam yas la sogs pa'i dge 'dun rnams kyi don du mdzad pa yin skad/'grel pa 'di la bshad tshul mi 'thad pa yang ci rigs par yod mod kyi/ spyiralegs bshad kyang mang zhing khyad par du 'phags pa'i yul du mdo lugs kyi bstan pa rnal ma yod pa'i skabs su byung ba'i/ sde snod 'dzin pa yang yin la bod kyi rgyal po byang chub sems dpas mchog tu bkur ba yin pa'i phyir/ 'grel pa 'di yang blta ba dang nyan pa la sogs pa'i sgo nas shes na legs so/ /'di'i 'chad tshul ni 'di ltar yod do/ /gleng bslang ba dang skabs dngani/ /bstan par rtogs pa 'dus pa dang / /gleng gzhi dris dang lan btab pa/ /de ni rnam pa bcu gcig dang / /mthun 'gyur rjes su yi rang dang/ rnatshapar brgyad bsdus pa yin/ /ces 'byung ste/ dang po gleng bslang ba ni 'di skad sogs/ gnyis pa skabs brtsom pa ni dus gcig na sogs/ gsum pa bstan par rtogs pa ni dge slong gi sogs/ bzhi pa gleng bzhi ni de'i tshe sogag lnga pa dris pa ni/ de nas sangs rgyas kyi mthus sogs/ drug pa la lan btab pa gi— 110—

de skad ces smras pa dang / zhes pa nas/ de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mol bslab par bya'o/ /zhes pa'i bar te 'di la nang tshan bcu gcig yod do/ /bdun pa mthun 'gyur ni/ de nas bcom ldan 'das sogs/ brgyad pa rjes su yi rang ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal pa sogs so/ /dri ba'i skabs ji ltar bslab par bya/ zhes pa la/ bsam pa dang /sbyor ba dang / mngon du bya ba dang / sgrub pa dang / rtogs pa'i rnam pas ji ltar bslab/ces lam lnga dang sbyar nas 'chad cing / zab mo spyod pa zhes pa la/ sbyor lam du mos pas spyod pa dang / de yang rang don/ gnyis don/ gzhan don gyi dbyeb sogs dang / sa drug la sgrub pa'i spyod pa stobaslab pa gsum la spyod pa dang/sa brgyad pa sogs la nges pa'i spyod pa sogs spros bshad mang du mdzad do/ /dris lan gyi don bcu gcig ni/ rtog bcas rtog med gzugs brnyan dang / /stong nyid mtshan med smon med gsum/ /sgom lam spyi dang spong ba che/ /bar chad med dang sems dpa' che/ /rtogs pa che rnams lam lngas bsdus/zhor la sher phyin sngags su bstan/ /ces bya'o/ /tshogs sbyor kyi lam du rtog pa dang bcas pa'i gzugs brnyan lhag mthong gi dmigs pa dngos su bstan cing /rtog pa med pa'i gzugs brnyan zhi gnas kyi dmigs pa ni/ shugs la bstan to/ /tshogs sbyor gnyis su zhi lhag zung 'brel du sgom dgos pa'i don la/gzugs brnyan rnam pa gnyis po de bstan to/ /de yang rang bzhin gyis lho pa parayang dag par blta'o/ /zhes pa yan chad do/ /de nas mthong lam gyi dmigs pa — 111 —

rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum yin la/ de la gzugs stong pa'o sogs kyis stonganyid dang / mtshan nyid med pa sogs kyis mtshan ma med pa dang bri ba med pa sogs kyis smon pa med pa ste/ dmigs rnam gsum po de goms pas mtshan nyid la sogs pa'i zhen pa bdun logs pa'i tha snyad mdzad do/ /sgo lam rgya dmigs rnam dngos ni/ de lta bas na stong pa nyid la gzugs med sogasaso/ /de'i 'bras bu spong ba che ba ni/ sems la sgrib pa med sogs te/ de gnyis sgom lam gyi dbang du byas pa'o/ /bar chad med pa'i lam dngos ni/ dusagasum du sogs so/ /de'i 'bras bu sems dpa' che ba ni bla na med pa zhesaso/ /rtog pa che ba ni yang dag par zhes pa la sogs pa'o/ /don tshan bcu gcig po ni de dag yin la/ de lta bas na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sngags zhes sogs so/ /bcu gcig la mi bgrong bar zhar byung sher phyin sngags su bstan pa zhes bya ste/ lam lnga sogs bshad tshul 'di dngos bstan tshigazin ma yin par/ sbas don mngon rtogs kyi rim pa yin la/ dngos po bgyod dngaspyor tshul mi 'dug kyang / mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi bshad sgros dang bstun nas 'chad par snang zhing / 'grel pa de na spyi khyab tu nye bar mkho ba'i bshad sgros kyang mang snang ngo / /blo gros zhan pas 'grel pa de mthong yang go dka' b.ragyur na/ lugs de ni zhib cing gsal la ma nor bar ar byang chub ye shes kyi 'grel pa na bkod 'dug pas der blta bar bya'o/ /da ni sbas don mngon rtogs kyi rim pa/ bdag gi rnam par rtog pa dang sbyar na/ dngos po brgyad kyi rim pa dang yang 'byor bar mthong ste/ de ltar yang— 1 12 —

rgyal tshab chen pos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan las/ shes rab pha rol phyin pa ni/ /dngos po brgyad kyis yang dag bshad/ /rnam kun mkhyen nyid lam shesanyid/ /de nas thams cad shes pa nyid/ /rnam kun mngon rdzogs rtogs pa dang /rtse mor phyin dang mthar gyis pa/ /skad cig gcig mngon rdzogs byangachub/ /chos kyi sku dang de rnams brgyad/ /ces gsungs pa ltar te/ 'dir dposapo brgyad ces pa la/ ge ngos po'i don ni/ dngos po dngos med ces pa lta bu'i skabs kyi dngos po la mi zer gyi/ brjod don tsam zhig la dngos po'i sgra las/pa'i skabs yin pas/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mdo'i brjod bya'i don yin pa'i ming ste/ don gyi gtso bo brgyad po 'di yin ces pa'i don no/ /spyirasher mdo tsam gyi brjod bya'i don gyi gtso bo mthar thug gi dbang du byas na/brgyad po'i nang nas kyang chos sku kho na yin mod kyi/ mdo gzhung la/ sde tshan dum bu brgyad du phye na/ brgyad kar don gyi gtso bor bya ste/ dper na lam shesakyi mdo'i brjod bya'i don gyi gtso bo lam shes nyid la bya dgos pa bzhin no/ /de yang mdo tshig de dag gis dngos su bstan pa'i brjod bya'i dbang du byas pa yin gyi/ gzhan du na/ lam shes kyang 'bras bu chor+sha/ sku we ya byed kyithabs yin pa'i phyir/ shugs bstan dang / brgyud nas ston pa'i dbang du byasan/ de dag gi yang don gyi gtso bo chos sku yin no/ /de la dngos po brgyad ni/rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang / lam thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang /gzhi thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang / rnam pa kun mngon par rdzogs par rtogasapa'i sbyor ba dang / rtse mor phyin pa'i sbyor ba dang / mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba dang /— 113 —

skad cig gcig gis mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa'i sbyor ba dang / 'brasabu shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa chos kyi sku rnams so/ /de dag kyang yul mkhyen pa gsum/ nyams len sbyor ba bzhi/ 'bras bu cho se kyi sku zhes gsum du yangabasdu bar bya zhing rde/ yang mkhyen pa gsum ni gtan la dbab bya yin pas mtshan nyid ces bya la/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba ni/ mtshan nyid dang mthun par/ nyamasasulen pa'i rim pa yin pas de'i sbyor ba dang / rtse mo'i sbyor ba ni sa lam rang rangaso so'i ye shes de nyid byang ba'i skabs yin pas sbyor ba rab tu son pa dang /mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba ni/ rang rang so so'i lam gyi goms pa de nyid brtan pa yang byed cing rtsal phyogs med du 'phel ba'i phyir/ go rim mi 'dra ba du walaslob pa yin pas rab tu son pa de'i go rim zhes bya la/ skad cig ma'i sbyor ba ni/ go rim de'am/ sbyor ba gsum po de thams cad kyi nus pa dus gcigatubasgril ba'i skabs yin pas/ go rim gyi mtha' 'am yang na sbyor ba thams cad kyi mtha' zhes bya'o/ /chos kyi sku ni lam thams cad kyi grub don rtsol med shugs 'byung gi tshul du gnas pas/ mtha' de'i rnam smin ces bya zho /des na sher phyin gyi mawo nyid/ sher phyin gyi sbyor ba/ sbyor ba rab tu go pa/go rmisagyi spyor ba/ mtha'i sbyor ba/ rnam smin mthar thug ste/ don tshan drug tu yanga'adus so/ /de ltar yang / ma.ā+oṃ ṣ+ka de yi sbyor ba dang / /de gra de yi go mi5dang / /de mtha' de yi rnam smin ni/ /don bsdus gzhan te rnam pa drug khulanirnam pa gsum po rgyu/ /spyor ba bzhi ldi bdag nyid can/ /chos sku 'phrin las 'bras bu ni/ /don bsdus gzhan te rnam pa gsum/ /zhes so/ /de la yul cesarte— 114—

bya ba ni/ sbyor ba bzhi po'i dmigs pa'i yul yin/ de yang mkhyen pa gsusamathob pa rnams kyis/ mkhyen gsum la dngos su ni dmigs mi thub la/ mtshan nyid 'di dang 'di lta bu dag ni rnam mkhyen no/ /zhes sgra don 'dres par bzung ste rnam mkhyen gyi mtshan nyid yang yang yid la dran pa tsam gyis ni de la dmigs par yang mi 'gyur bas/ 'dir mkhyen pa gsum gyi rtogs bya gang yin pa de/sbyor ba bzhi'i dmigs pa'i yul du 'jog pa yin te/ de'i phyir mkhyen gsukhoyang brgyud nas yul du bzhag go /rgyu zhes bya ba ni skyed byed kyi rgyu dang/ rgyu mtshan gnyis la skabs thob kyi 'jug shul so sor yod pa las/ 'dir ni gnyis ka ltar mi 'gal te/ gtso bor ni rnam pa dang lam dang gzhi gsuralaspros pa thams cad dang bral ba'i rnam pa de nyid dmigs pa'i yul dang rgyu mtshan du byas nas 'jog dgos pa'i phyir rgyu'i don rgyu mtshan du byas la/ dmigs yul de la dmigs nas bsgoms pas ye shes skye ba ni/ dmigs yul de ye shesade'i bskyed rgyu dngos min yang / bskyed rgyu dang rnam pa mtshungs pas skyed byed kyi rgyu'i tshul du bshad kyang rung ngo / /yang rnam pa gcig tu na/ rdziskad du/ sangasargyas las chos chos las 'phags pa'i tshogs/ /tsho gis las snying po ye shesakhams thob mthar/ /zhes gsungs pa'i dngos bstan ltar/ sangs rgyas byangasems sogs kyi thugs rgyud kyi mkhyen pa gsum gyis rgyu mthun pa'i chos bskyed cing / des gdul bya'i rgyud la sbyor gzhi sogs bskyed par byas kyang rudango / /de dag las mkhyen pa gsum ni/ ji skad du/ nyi khri lnga stong pa lag rosa'abyor thams cad shes pa nyid ni nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi yin — 115 —

no//rga cad mkhyen pa ni de bzhi na gshegs pa dgrang kyi yin no//rnam pa gums 'a mkhyen pa na/kyi 'i yed pa dgra rngu ri pa yang dag parapo'i nga pa' dzis sa rdzo rnams she yan nā//zhes gsungs shang /'a pa bstan 'a mngan par rtags pa' rgyan las kyang /thub pa' kyi kun ༷'a da ni de//o dang /bya~X smu spre do / smos zo' lte she5'i/lasashas nyad na 'a she// dang /nyan sa sto/ la byegs mthang ba 'ad/de 'a kun shes nyad du 'dad//ces 'byung ba sags sa/'di ge sde mu dge ru ye 'a na rmyum mkhyen dang /byang chub 'a dpaX ༵kris sa 'ar she snye/na lam shas dang /nyan rang 'pha 1 'ari/sa pa' rgyud re zhi// sa shas na gzha sha~Xsakyang sa bshad du bya la/༷ la 'ad sa na/rnam mkhyen gang yan lamardephyin lam skye/༵ma shes ye yan mi sri shes yan te/shes bya dzisaX rngu / phyan lam da du ma rtags pa da la/lam gsum ka rtags phyan gta zag gi bdag med ma rtogs pa mi srid pas/rten gyi gang zag su'i rgyud la yod de 7 0ri0ri glu sku zu / rdo bye rta pa rdekyang wo sni/lam da dzi med du spris dro yan phyan 'ad lam 'a na /kying zig bdag mad 'a pa yan phyan chad sems dpa'i rgyad kyil ma sa//'a kyang tshur tshur swā 'a ma khyab ste/ra gi 'ad rgyud lamarde' na/༵ spun ma dzo dzi /nyan rang /zha shes kyang ma byen ga ༷ rdeXspya rde' ma 'a kyi//zhes 'a ra//la la 'a na/mkhyen pa 3sngi5pa nga ba gcag pa ༵// yed gcag la 'a/zhi skye med du po khri rdo/rdebasha/da pa ra ra//des na sangs rgyas rdos lam dang gzha skye med du

kyang de rnam mkhyen kho na yin gyi gzhan ma yin no/ /zhes sems par byed do/ /gzhan dag ni yon tan yar ldan yin pas/ nyan rang ni gzhi shes ge rtsegardepu dang ldan la/ byang sems ni de'i steng du lam shes dang yang ldan cing/ sangasargyas ni mkhyen pa gsum ka dang ldan pas/ rgyud gcig la gsum mam gnyisa'ajug pa ni yod kyang / gsum po dngos po ni tha dad yin no zhes smra zho /de dgalas mang po zhig ni/ sangs rgyas kyi rnam mkhyen byang sems kyi lam shes/ nyan rang gi gzhi shes rnams mtshan nyid pa dngos yin la/ byang sems kyis gang zag gi bdag med mthong ba dang / sangs rgyas kyis lam dang gzhi skye med du gzigs pa ni/ de dang de btags pa ba yin no/ /zhes rgyu mtshan du mdang bcas te brjod pa dang / kha cig ni mkhyen pa gsum ka yang shes rab kyi pha rolatu phyin pa yin pas/ sangs rgyas kyi gsum kar mtshan nyid pa yin pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i lam dang gzhi shes pa mtshan nyid pa yin la/ nyan rangagogazhi shes ni/ spros pa phyogs gcig tsam bkag pa las/ gzhan spros bral gyi rnam pa can ma yin pas btags pa ba'o/ /zhes rgyu mtshan du ma dang bcas te'abri bar byed do/ /gzhan la la dag ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang/sangs rgyas kho na'i rgyud la yod do zhes dang / kha cig ni rnam mkhyen yang rnam pa gnyis te rgyu dang 'bras bu'o/ /rgyu'i rnam mkhyen ni/ byang chub sems dpa' khona'i rgyud la yod de/ skabs dang po'i rnam mkhyen yang 'di kho na yin la semasabaskyed sogs bcu po yang rnam mkhyen nyid yin pa dang / 'bras bu'i rnam mkhyen ni chos sku'o zhes zer ba dang / kha cig ni sems bskyed sogs chos bcu po — 117—

dngos po brgyad kyi rnam mkhyen ma yin te/ mtshon byed kyi chos sam dmigs/pa'i yul yin no/ /zhes 'dod pa dang / gzhan kha cig ni mdo dang rgyan gyi mchod brjod dang / bstan bces dngos kyi mdor bstan rgyas bshad sogs lamakhyen gsum gyi 'jog mtshams mi 'dra ba re re yin no zes blun gtam du smra ba sogs/ bstan pa lnga brgya tha ma la/ rgya bod gnyis kar du 'di'i lag len dngasgrub dka' ni shin tu phra ba bshad pa tsam zhig ni ha cang dar tshes pas/ rnam pa du mar 'chol bas yin la/ phyogos re nas bltas na/ thams cad la 'gal ba cher med pa ltar snang zhing / phyogs cig shos nas bltas na/ re re zhing skyon du ma 'jug par lta yang snang bas zhib tu dpyad dgos kyang / re zhig 'dir rgyamibaskyed do/ /de la dngos po dang po rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa ni/ mdo lasabacom ldan 'das ci'i slad du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pe nyid de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi lags/ rab 'byor rnam pa gang dag dang / rtags gang dag dang/ mtshan mgang dag gi chos rnams rab tu brjod pa'i/ rnam pa de dag dang / rtags de dgadang / mtshan ma de dag de bzhin gshe/gas pas thugs su chud de/ de'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi ni/rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ces bya'o/ /zhes gsungs te/ de la rnam pa ni ngo bo dang / rtags ni 'bras bu dang / mtshan ma ni rgyu'i don yin pag ma lusashing lus pa med pa'i shes bya thams cad kyi rang rang so so'i ngo bo rnams dang /so so rnams kyi 'bras bu rnams dang / de dang de'i rgyu rkyen thams cad de/ bskyed — 118 —

bya skyed byed kyi rgyu 'bras dang / rnam par gzhag bya 'jog byed kyi rgyu 'bus thams cad do/ /de 'dra de rnams ye shes gcig gis cig myong mkhyen pas rnatshapa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid do/ /de yang ji lta ba'i mkhyen tshul gyis ni chosathams cad kyi rgyu 'bras ngo bo gsum spros bral du mkhyen cing / ji snyed gzigasapa'i ye shes kyis ni/ shes bya thams cad kyi ngo bo rgyu 'bras kyi rnam 'gyur thams cad kyang mkhyen pa yin no/ /de yang rnam pa thams cad rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal bar gzigs pa yin la/ rnam pa skye med ces sam/ rnam pa rang bo zhon med pa zhes 'chad pa yang rang bzhin 'od gsal dang don gcig pas/ rnatshagrangs su bshad na mi 'ga' yang brjod tshul legs po kho nar yang mi 'dug pas/ skye med dang rang bzhin med ces pa'i bzlas brjod kho na la/ bzang porazhen pa yang mi mjes so/ /sangs rgyas kyi ye shes rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pas ma dag pa'i rnam brtags mtshan ma gsum po dngos su gzigs pa ni ma yin te/chos can kun rdzob pa'i snang ba thams cad gdod nas ma grub pa'i phyir/ dzinasatshul la ma grub pa de nyid gzigs na/ ye she 'khrul bar thal ba'i phyiraro/ /gang yod pa mi mthong ba dang / med pa mthong ba ni 'grul zhing rmos/pa khon yin no/ /des na ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa gnyas ka shes bya thams cad kyi gnas tshul rtag brtan zhi ba g.yung drung gi ye shes bde ba dam pa'i ngo bor gnas pa gzigs pa gzhir bzhag pa las/ de nyid la dngos po dngos med yul yul can/ 'khor ba dang / lam dang / 'bras bu gsar thos sog༅'jigarten pa dang rnal 'byor pa rnams la dngos su snang ba dang / dngos su mi snang— 119—

yang / blos bzhag pa'i chos gang yang yod ma myong ba zhi ba'i mtshan nyid de/ snangamakhan dang 'jog mkhan gyi shes pa kun nas nyon mongs pa thams cad kyang gdod nas med pa'i phyir rnam par dag pa/ rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal ba mnyamanyid yin par rtogs pa de ni ji ltar ba mkhyen tshul yin la/ rang bzhin 'od gsal gyi sems nyid de/ don dam pa'i rnam pa thams cad pa yin pa'i phyir/shes bya thams cad kyi rnam pa don dam pa de/ kun rdzob kyi shes bya thams cad kyi yang gnas lugs dang chos nyid du yod cing de ltar yod pa mkhyen pa ni ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i ye shes so/ /don dam srid gsum dngos su gzigs kyang de kun rdzob kyi snang ba ma yin cing / kun rdzob srid gsum dngos su ma gzigs kyang/sems can rnams la de snang ba dang / de rnams kyi 'khrul ngor bde sdug sogasa'abyung ba mkhyen no/ /ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa'i rtogs tshul gnyis kar rang rigagi tshul gyis mkhyen pa yin pas/ don dam pa'i rnam brtags mtshan ma rnams/rang bzhin 'od gsal nyid yin la/ don dam pa'i rnam brtags mtshan wagasum mkhyen pa dang / 'od gsal de nyid rnam pa thams cad pa yin pa don gcig la 'du'o/ /de ltar yang rgyal tshab chen pos/ 'gro ba zhi ba'i chos nyid du/ /rtogs phyir ji ltar nyid de yang / /rang bzhin kyis ni yongs dgaphyir/ /nyon mongs gdod nas zad phyir ro/ khres bya mthar thug rtogs pa'i blos/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i chos nyid ni/ /sems can thams cad la yod par/ /mthong phyir ji snyed yod pa nyid/ /ces ji lta ji snyed kyi rtogs tshuwa de ltar yin par gsungs la/ kha cig sangs rgyas kyis ma dag pa'i snang ba thams— 120 —

cad gzigs kyang / bden 'dzin med pas ma 'khrul ba yin no skad zer ba ni/skyes bu 'di ni chom pos bzung bas cho nges 'debs mod kyi/ nor 'phrog rgyu med pas sdug bsngal med do zhes zer ba dang / sgyu ma'i cha sgyus shes pa'i mi'adis ni/ sgyu ma sprul pa'i khang pa mthong mod kyi/ sgyu mar shes pa'i phyirama'akhrul lo/ /zhes zer ba dang 'dra ste/ cho nges 'debs pa nyid sdug bsngal thob pa'i rtags yin pa dang / sgyu ma'i khang bzang mthong ba nyid dbang po bslad pa'i 'khrul ba yin na/ 'khrul ba'i ngos 'dzin blos bcom ma gzhan zhig gsar du rnam par bzhag nas/ de med pas 'khrul ba med do zhes brjod kyang mi mdzesapa ltar/ gang mi rtag pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / gzugs sogs/su snang ba de nyid 'khrul ba yin pas/ de la bden par mi 'dzin no zhes smras pas ci zhinabya/ de ltar na sangs rgyas kyi ye shes de ni/ shes bya thams cad mkhyen pa'i phyirarnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid yin no/ /spros pa thams cad nye bar zhi ba'i ye shes yin pas shes rab dang / chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs mthar thugapa'i phyir/ pha rol tu phyin pa yin pas na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /dngos po gnyis pa lam thams cad shes pa nyid ni/ mdo las bcotshaldan 'das ci'i slad du lam gyi rnam pa 'tshol ba nyid byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi lags/ rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi ni nyan thos kyi lam gang yin pa dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi lam gang yin pa dang / sangs rgyas/kyi lam gang yin pa'i lam thams cad bskyed par bya zhing / lam thams cad shes par bya'o/ /de dag kyang / yongs su rdzogs par bya zhing / de dag ni lam— 121 —

gyi bya ba yang bya la/ smon lam yongs su rdzogs par ma byas pa dang / sems can yongs su smin par ma byas pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su ma sbyangs par/de dag gis yang dag pa'i mtha' mngon sum du ni mi bya'o/ /de'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis ni/ lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid ces bya go /zhesagasungs te/ 'di la phal che ba dag lam gsum skye med du rtogs pa dang/ lam gsum rang bzhin med par rtogs pa zhes zer zhing / de'i skye med dang rangabazhin med pa ni/ sher phyin yin par ston pa'i mtshan nyid kyi zur du bsamasapa'o/ /de ltar yang sto ba ni yin mod kyi/ sher phyin gyi mawo nyid de 'drakhonar bzung dgos pa yang ma yin no/ /de lta mod kyi/ dper na ga gsogasaphung po dmigs pa'i rten du bzhag nas/ de bden med du sgom pa'am/ snangachade'i rnam pa bden med du shar ba lta bur/ 'dir yang dmigs yul theg pa gsum gyi lam gyi mtshan nyid blo la nges par byas nas/ de'i 'dra'i mtshan nyid kyi rnam pa yid yul du shar ba de la dmigs di nas 'a rang bzhin med do snyam sgom pa'am/ sa lam so rbo'i mnyam gzhag rjes thob kyi nyams myong shar ba rnams sgyu ma ltar rang bzhin med pa'i don sgom pa tsam yang gnas skabs 'di'i lam skye med kyi go don min no/ /'o na ci zhe na/ lam gyi rnam pa skye med ces pa/skye med rnam pa'i lam zhes pa'i don du 'gyur te/ rang rgyud kyi mnyam gzhag gam rjes thob kyi lam gang yin pa de yang / skye 'gag gnas gsum la sogs pa spros pa thams cad rang sar zhi ba'i rnam pa'am/ 'ga' zhig dngos su spros pa'i rnam pa tsam snang du chug kyang / mnyam gzhag spros med kyi shugs kyis zin pag— 122 —

spros pa'i mtshan ma stobs bri nas spros med dang 'dra rung du gyur pa ni/ skye med rnam pa'i lam yin la/ de rtogs tshul lam/ shes tshul ni/ mnyam gzhag/larang rig kho na dang / rjes thob la gnyis ka'o/ /des na byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mnyam gzhag rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes/ chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa spros bral gyi rnam pa can de ni/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sgrub par byed pa'i lam dngos yin cing / nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi rgyud kyi gang zagad+mogi bdag med pa rtogs pa la sogs pa de dag nyid kyi/ 'khrul med kyi ye shesagang yin pa de dang / rtogs tshul gang yin pa dang / yon tan gang yin pa dngaphan yon gang yin pa ji lta ba de 'dra re/ shor byung gi yon to du ma'i lhag dngabacas par/ de la tshang bas na theg pa gsum myong gyi lam zhes bya zhing/ de nyid rang rig pas shes pa'i phyir lam shes so/ /rdzogs smin sbyang gsum ma kyi byas bar du/ yang dag pa'i mtha' mngon du mi byed pa'i las can dang/ skabasagazhan du nyon mongs ched du mi spong ba'i las can du bshad pa sogs ni/ byangachub sems pa'i gnas skabs nyid kyi dbang du byas pa'i lam shes la khyad par de dag tshang ba yin kyang / lam shes su 'jog byed la de ltar dgos pa ni mayin no/ /sangs rgyas ni 'bras bu mthar thug pa yin pas/ rnam mkhyen kyi skabs su rnam brtags mtshan ma gsum kar bsha/da pa yin la/ byang sems kyi 'bras bu mtha' dag mngon du ma byas pas lam tsam zhig kho na smos pa yin no/ /dngos po gsum pa gzhi shes ni/ mdo las/ bcom ldan 'das ci'i — 123 —

slad du thams cad 'tshal ba nyid nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi lags/rab 'byor thams cad ni phyi dang nang gi chos rnams ji snyed pa tsam yin la/ de dag kyang nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams kyis shes kyi/ lam thams cad kyis kyang ma yin la/ rnam pa thams cad du yang ma yin pas/ de'i phyir nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi ni/ thams cad shes pa nyid ces bya'o zhesaso/ /'dir gzhi phyi nang gi chos rnams shes pa zhes pa las shes tshul rdzi ltarayin mi gsal yang / nyan rang gi rtogs pa yin pa'i phyir na/ gang zagagobadag med pa'i rtogs tshul yin dgos te/ mdo las/ phung po gang zag bdagamed par/ /rab tu rnam phye mthong gyur cing / chos kyi dngos yod ma bzhigapas/ /nyan thos de dag mngon rtogs 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pas go /de ltabs na/ nyan rang 'phags pa chos kyi bdag med mngon sum du ma rtogs te de'i phyir chos kyi bdag 'dzin spangs pa yang ma yin no/ /'on kyang gang zag gobadag med nyid rtogs pa'i shugs kyis/ dngos por 'dzin yang cung zad srab par gyur pa ni yin la/ de dag gi mnyam gzhag na chos bdag gi snang ba tshalog kyang / chos kyi bdag 'dzin mngon gyur pa yang med pas/ de 'phya) mnya5gzhag de dag kyang chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i ye shes dang 'dzin stangs 'gal ba ma yin pas/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang cung zad rjesasumathun pa ni yin no/ /des na nyan rang 'phags pa'i ye shes de ni/ bzhi phyi nangagi chos phung khams skye mched thams cad la/ ji ltar rigs par mi rtag pa lasogs pa rnam pa'i shes pa bcu drug po de dag kun 'jug pa yin kyang / rnatsha— 124 —

pa'i gtso bo yin pa dang / spros bral dang cha shas mthun pa'i ldog pa nye b.rabazung nas/ bdag med par ni shes la/ de shes pas nyan rang gi lam shes pa tsam du ni 'gyur yang spros pa dang bral bar ni ma shes pas/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i rtogs tshul gyis ni/ lam de gnyis kyang ma shes la/ khyad paradu lam gyi gtso bo theg chen gyi lam ni gtan nas kyang ma shes pa'i phyir/ nyan rang gi ye shes de lam shes par mi 'gyur zhing / ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa thamasacad mi shes pas na/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid lta ga la thig ste/ de'i phyir gzhi kho na shes pas gzhi shes zhes bya'o/ /'on kyang 'di ni nyan ranganigazhi shes zhes bya zhing / mi mthun phyogs kyi gzhi shes kyi nang du gtogs pa tsam yin la/ gnyen po'i gzhi shes ni/ mkhyen gsum gyis zlas phye ba'i gzhi shesadangos sam btags pa ba gang du bzhag na legs shes dpyod ldan rnams kyis rnam par dpyod cig dang / gzhi shes kyi skabs kyi mdo dang bstan bcos kyi/gzhung dngos bstan gyi brjod bya'i ( 〈rdza〉 gtso bo ) gzhi shes ni gnyen po'i gzhi shes 'di kho na yin la/ gzhung gi dngos bstan ltar na/mi mthun phyogs kyi gzhi shes kyang nyan rang gi de gtso mi che ste/ gtso bor byang chub semasadapa' so so skye bo dmigs pa'i lta ba can rnams yin no/ /gnyen po bzhi shesade yang gang zhe na/ mnyam gzhag rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes spros pa thamasacad spangs pa de la/ bdag dang byed po dang / rtag dngos dpa/myong tshor bde ba sogs gang yang gdod nas ma dmigs par rtag pa'i cha gcig 'dug pa de nyid/ nyan rang gi lam shes pa'i lam shes yin la/ gnyen po gzhi shes kyang— 125 —

yin no/ /yang bdag tu 'dzin pa'i bag chags drung nas 'byin pa'i phyir/ gangazag gi bdag med pa ched gtad bsgoms pa na/ bdag ni rang bzhin gyis/med par mthong zhing / lhag ma gzhan dngos po dang dngos po med pa'i spros pa rnamasakyang shor la rang bzhin med par rtogs nas/ spros pa dang mtshan ma thams cad zhig pa'i rnam pa can te/ spros bral rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi sdong po bdag da pa'i rtsa ba can de ni gnyen po'i gzhi shes nyid yin no/ /bdag 'dzin gyi bgachags drung nas 'byin pa la/ spyi khyab kyi spros bral de kho na rtogs pas chogagi /gang zag med pa la gtso bor dmigs pas/ tsi zhig bya snyam na/ ma yin te dmigs pa rnams kyi nus pa ni tha dad pa yin pas/ stong nyid kho nas chags sdang la sogs pa yang bzlog pa yin mod kyang mi sdug pa'i ting nge 'dzin spros bral gyi rnam pa can gyis 'dod chags kyi bag chags lhag par bzlog pa dang /byams pa'i sems spros bral gyi rnam pa can gyis zhe sdang gi bag chag/sa lhag par bzlog pa bzhin no/ /rigs pas kyang 'thad de/ mi sdug pa dang/ byamasapa dang / bdag med pa de dag kyang de dang de mngon gyur 'phral du bzlog pa'i nus pa can ni yin la/ spyi'i gnyen po stong nyid de yang ma tshang ba med parabasgoms pa'i phyir/ gcig pu kho na las gnyis kar 'dzom pa stobs che ba rmosam dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /rang rgyal gyis bzung ba chos kyi bdag med mthon sukhortogs sam ma rtogs zhe na/ ma rtogs zhes bya'o/ /'o na ji skad du/ gzung don rtog pa spong phyir dang / /'dzin pa mi spong phyir dang ni/ /brten gyi bso ru lta bu'i lam/ /yang dag bsdus pa shes par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ma yin nam/ rtsen/— 126—

rang rgyal rnams ni rten 'brel yun ring du goms pa las/ 'jig rten ma rigapa'i rkyen can du shes pas na/ de'i shugs kyis gzung ba'i rnam rtog shin tunyams smad pa yin pas/ de lta bu'i rtogs pa de yang byang chub sems dpa'i lam shes kyi rtogs rigs kyi nang du 'dus te/ de yang byang chub sems dpa' skabs 'ga' zhig tu chos thams cad sems kyi snang ba tsam du rtogs pag ngabadag dang phyi rol kyi don gdod nas ma grub ( 〈dzaX〉 rtse par )rtogs shing / de nyid kyang spros pa thams cad dang gdod nas bral ba'i rnam pa can yin mod kyi/'dzin pa la ched gtad shugs phyung nas stong par bsgom pa med pas/ gzupadon gyi rtogs pa spong / 'dzin pa'i rtog pa mi spong zhes tha snyad mdzad pa yin gyi/'dzin pa'i mngon zhen dang bcas pa ni ma yin no/ /de lta bu'i ye shes des/rang rgyal gyi rtogs pa gang yin pa de/ rigs mthun gyi tshul gyis bsdus pa yin pas rang rgyal gyi lam gyi ming gis btags pa tsam mo/ /de ltar bshad zin pa'i mkhyen pa gsum po de ni/ lam gyi bden pa'i dbang du byas la/ de bos po brgyad kyi skabs 'dir gtso bo yang lam bden 'di yin mod/ spyir chos nyid don dam pa'i ye shes bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po ni/ sher phyin mthar thugapa yang yin la/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang / lam shes pa nyid dang/gzhi thams cad shes pa nyid de/ 'di ni don dam 'gog pa'i bden pa yin cing / sher phyin gyi mdo dang gzhung gi sbas don mthar thug gi snying po yin parashes par bya'o/ /de ltar mkhyen pa gsum gyi ngo bo ni de 'dra yin la/ lam gyi bden pas bsdus pa'i mkhyen gsum gyi rtogs bya'am/ /gnas lugs ce khri/kyi — 127—

dbyings spros bral gyi rig pa de ni bdag med gnyis sam/ rnam pa skye med/lam skye med gzhi skye med/ ces sogs tha snyad du mas bsnyad de/ thos bsam gyis gtan la 'bebs pa'i yul dang / sbyor ba rnams kyi bsgom bya dmigasapa'i yul yang yin no/ /dngos po bzhi pa rnam rdzogs sbyor ba ni/ gzhi dang lasadang 'bras bu'i chos rnams/ rang bzhin gdod nas stong pa nyid du mtshupa༅kyang / so rbo'i mtshan nyid rnam pa mi 'dra ba rnams ma 'dres shing ma 'dzengs parablos rtogs nas/ thams cad spros pa dang bral bas ro snyoms shing/ semasadangos po gang la yang mi gnas par yid la mi byed pa'i tshul du bsgom mo/ /de la mi rtag pa lta bu'i gsal snang bsgrubs te spros bral du bsre nus pa nas/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba tsam rgyud la skye ba'i 'go brtsams pa yin la/ rnam pa gzhan thams cad kyang re re bzhin rim pas bsgrubs shing spros bral gyi ngor rim gyis skye la/ mthar shes pa skad cig gcig la rnam pa thams cad dus mnyam du shar bar gyur pa na/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba mthar phyin pa yin te tshogs lam nas rgyun mtha'i ye shes kyi bar du 'di yod par 'dod pa ltar 'thad la/ 'di lamakhyen gsum gyi rnam pa bsdus sgom gyi sbyor ba zhes zer te/ mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa ni gong du smos pa ltar/ lam gyi bden pa'i dmigs yul rtogs bya chos dbyingasade'i rnam pa yin cing / dngos gnas la rnam pa'i grangs tshad bzung bar mi nusakyang / don gyi gtso bo rnams bsdus pa'i phyir dang / gdul bya nye ba'i bsam pa la dgongs nas/ rnam pa brgya bdun bcu rtsa gsum zhes grags go /bsdusasgom gyi go don ni/ dper na 'dus byas mi rtag par yid la byas shing/ de yang— 128 —

rang bzhin med pa la bslabs pas/ gsal snang thob pa na/ zan bcas/sdugabasngal gyi rnam pa yid la byed cing / de rang bzhin med pa la gsal snang sgrub bo/ /de yang thob pa na/ mi rtag sdug bsngal gnyis ka dus gcig la yid labyed cing / rang bzhin med par gsal snang yang dus mnyam du sgrubs pas/mnyam gzhag skad cig ma gcig po de la shes pa gcig po des/ 'dus byasakyisnang ba thams cad mi rtag pa'i rnam pa can du yang shes/ zag bcas kyi snang ba thams cad sdug bsngal gyi rnam pa can du yang shes/ gzhi 'dus byas dang zagabacas gnyis dang mtshan nyid mi rtag pa dang sdug bsngal rnams kyang snang ba tsam ma gtogs/ rang bzhin gyis stong par mthong ba na/ mi rtag pa dang sdug bsngalagyi rnam pa phyogs gcig tu bsdus te sgom pa yin pas/ bsdus bsgom zhes/bya'o/ /mi rtag pa dang sdug bsngal gyi rnam pa ma 'gags pa dgos te/ de med na bsdus te sgom par mi 'gyur zhing / rnam pa'i rnam grangs mang po bshad pa rnamasakyang don med du 'gyur bas so/ /snang cha de'i steng du spros pa dang bral b.ra'ajog ma shes na yang / mi rtag sdug bsngal gyi rnam pa tsam gyis sher phyin sgo5par mi 'gyur zhing / gnas lugs la reg par mi 'gyur bas/ spyi dang khyad par gyi rnam pa thams cad sgom dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan de ltar yin no/ /'dir sbyor ba zhes pa ni nyams len sgom pa'i rnal 'byor yin te/ de ltar na 'di dag ni gzhan rnams la yang rigs 'gre'o/ /dngos po lnga pa rtse mo'i sbyor ba ni/ bsdusasgom rab tu gyur pa zhes bya ste/ rab tu gyur pa'i go don shin tu byang ba dang gonga'aphel du gyur pa ste/ de la rnam rdzogs ni/ rnam pa gnyis kyi bsdus sgo5nas— 129 —

rnam pa thams cad kyi bar du/ bsdus sgom ma thob pa thob par byed pa dang /thob pa mi nyams par byed pa yin cing / rtse sbyor 'di ni/ rnam pa gnyis nasarnam pa thams cad pa'i bar du so sor sbyar te/ bsdus sgom de dang de thob cingam nyams par sngar nas byas pa de/ shin tu byang bas shugs 'byung la 'ju ga pa'i phyir dang / skabs de dang de'i yon tan rnams sgrub pa'i phyir dang / mi rtag pa ltabu gcig la yang rtogs tshul mi 'dra ba du ma'i sgo nas/ shes rab kyi snangabaspel ba'i phyir sgom pa yin no/ /de ltar bsgoms pas gnas skabs de dang de dag tu de 'dra mngon du gyur pa na rtse mo'i sbyor ba thob pa zhes bya ste/ sbyor la5drod nas rgyun mtha'i ye shes kyi bar du yod do/ /dngos po drug pa mtharasapa'i sbyor ba ni/ bsdus sgom de nyid ma nyams bzhin du rim pa mi 'dra ba sna tshogs la bslabs pas/ 'phel ba'i rgyun de nyid byang zhing shin tu brtan parabyed pa ste/ dper na sngar gyi bsdus sgom de nyid/ chu tshod cig tu sgom par byed na/ chu srang bzhi lhag tsam zhig sems spros bral gyi snang cha mi rtag sdug bsngalasogs su cig car shar ba de/ de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can la snying rjesaspyin pa gtong ba'i sems pas mgo bsdus te sgrom pa dang / de rjes rgyun de tsawazhig /tshul khrims spong sems kyis mgo bsdus te sgom pa sogs/ phar phyin drug dang / rjes dran drug dang / shos med ngo bo nyid de bcu ga a la sbyararo/ /de la goms nas dbugs bcu gsum gyi ring la chos bcu gsum sbyar te sgom pa lta bu dang / rig 〈j-i〉rim )pas dus mtha'i skad cig ma bcu gsum la sbyar ba lta bu dang / mthar mtha' med pa'i bar du sbyar te/ 'di ni sbyor ba snga— 130—

ma gnyis kyi rtsa sbyong ba yin la sbyor ba snga ma gnyis ni rnam pa mi 'dra ba du ma gcig tu bsdus te sgom pa yin la/ 'di ni bsdus zin de 'dra yongs rdzogasarere bzhin/ skad cig re rer rnam pa mi 'dra ba du mar 'char ba la slob pa yin pas/ rnam pa so sor phye ste sgom pa yin no/ /'o na phye ba'i phyir rnam pa nyung ngu song ba yin nam snyam na min te/ snga ma rnams las kyang ches mang bar 'gyurardero/ /dper na shes pa gcig la rnam pa bcu drug dus mnyam du 'char ba bsgrubs zin pa de/ slar yang rnam pa bcu drug po so so ma nyams bzhin du/thams cad mi rtag pa'i rnam pa gcig tu 'char ba dang / thams cad sdug bsngal gyi rnam pa gcig tu 'char ba dang / thams cad stong pa gcig tu 'chang ba lasogs skad cig re re bzhin du 'phos shing sgom pa yin te/ sngar gyi rnam pa mngapo de deg kyang re re bzhin rnam pa gnyis sbrag tu bslabs par 'gyur la/ sngararnam pa mang po de dag stong nyid tsam gyis khyab byed du byed pa las gzhan med na yang / 'dir rnam pa thams cad la mi rtag pa'i rnam pas khyab pa dang/ rnam pa thams cad la sdug bsngal gyi rnam pas khyab pa sogs/ rnam pa thams cad larere bzhin rnam pa thams cad kyas khyab par bsgrubs pa'i phyir ro/ /'on kyangaskabs 'dir/ bsdus sgom gyi rnam pa rnams sngar dus mnyam du grub zin pa'irgyun de ka yin kyang rgyas 'debs byed rnams dus mnyam du ma grub pag snga phyi phreng chags su byed dgos pa'i phyir/ mthar gyis rim gyis sgrub pa zhes bya skechos gcig bsgoms pas chos thams cad bsgom pa dang / skad cig gcigalayang ting nge 'dzin du ma la ldang 'jug nus par 'gyur ba'i rgyu bla na med pa ste/— 131 —

'di'i sa mtshams la 'dod tshul mi 'dra ba mang yang / sbyor lam nas rgyun mtha'i snga logs kyi bar du yod do zhes gsungs pa ltar na/ bdag gi rnam par rton pa ni sbyor lam yang bzod pa la bya dgos par sems so/ /'dir chos bcu gsu5nga shad pa ni mchon pa tsam ste/ chos kyi rnam pa mtha' yas pa mtha' dag go /de ltar na sbyor ba gsum po de dang / snga ma snga ma la brten nas phyi ma phyi ma skye zhing/phan tshun spel ba'i tshul du rgyud la skye ba yin te/ dper na rnam pa nyi shu rtsa bdun gyi rnam rdzogs sbyor ba'i bsdus sgom thob pa na/ rnam pa nyer bdun po de rnamasanyid kyi rtse mo'i sbyor bas byang zhing 'phel ba la slob par byed do/ /de nas nyerabadun po de rnams re re bzhin nyer bdun po de dag thams cad du 'char ba'i phyir/ nyer bdun po la rnam pa re re bzhin gyis rgyas 'debs pa'i mtharasapa'i sbyor ba sgom dgos te/ des rnam pa mang nyung thams cad la rigs 'gre'o//'on kyang sbyor ba gsum po de thog mar thob pa'i sa mtshams ni mi 'dra ste/bsdus sgom ni tshogs lam na yang yod cing bsdus sgom la byang zhing 'phel ba ni/de na med pa'i phyir/ tshogs lam na rnam rdzogs yod kyi rtse mo med do/ /byang zhinga'aphel ba sbyor lam drod rtse gnyis nas yod kyang / rnam pa mang pos rnam pa mngapo la rgyas thebs pa de na med pas/ rtse sbyor yod kyang mthar gyis pa med do/ /bzod pa nas ni rgyas thebs tshul de yod pa'i phyir mthar gyis pa yang yod de/ de nas brtsams te gsum ka spel mar 'byung ngo / /rtse sbyor mthob pa'i sngon du mthar gyis pa yod par 'dod pa mi 'thad de/ de ni rtse sbyor gyi bsdus sgoma'aphel ba'i rgyun de nyid la/ rim sgom du byed pa nyid yin pa'i phyir ro/ kha cig— 132 —

sa bdun pa man chad mkhyen gsum gyi mngon rtogs dang / brgyad pa yan chad laspyor bzhi'i mngon rtogs yod par 'dod cing / de las kyang kha cig de dag re re la yang sbyor mthong sgom gsum gyi dbye ba sogs byed pa ni 'thad par ma mthong la bka' gdams pa 'ga' zhig na re/ 'phags seng gis mngon rtogs kyi don rnams lam mthon po kho na yang yang sbyor ba ni/ rang re da lta'i gang zag rnamasal sku drin chung ste/ 'di thams cad la da lta nyid nas nyams su blang rgyu dgosagasung ba yang / rjes mthun gyi dbang du byas na bden pas/ las dang po pa nyid nas dngos po brgyad kar gyi rgyu tshogs la bslab du yod do/ /gzhan sbyor ba dang mngon rtogs kyi dbye ba ltar na/ rnam rdzogs sogs sbyor ba gsum po 'o dol/so skye'i gnas skabs na ni sbyor ba tsam yin la/ 'phags pa'i lam gyi de dang deni mngon rtogs kyang yin no/ /dngos po bdun pa skad cig ma'i spyor ba ni/spros pa dang bral ba/ rab tu zhi ba/ rab tu dben pa'i ye shes skad cig mgacig gis ji ltar ji snyed gyi chos thams cad kyang cig car shes la/ de'i rgyu mtshan gyis 'di ni lam gyis bsdus pa'i ye shes dang yon tan dang dge ba'i chos thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur cing / 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi sas 'i bsdus pa chos rnams kyi snang cha thams cad gzugs brnyan gyi tshul du shar bas ni/ chos thams cad skad cig gcig gis rtogs nus pa'i phyir dang / sangs kyi rgyas byangachub de ma thag tu thob nus pa'i phyir/ skad cig gcig gis mngon par rdzogasapar byang chub pa zhes bya'o/ /mngon rtogs 'di ni rgyun mtha'i skabs kho na yin kyang / bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gnas la dbang sgyur ba yin pas na/ skad cig — 133 —

la bskal par ston pa sogs 'byung ba'i phyir/ dus yun ring thung 'di tsa mo zhesabasam par mi nus so/ /mthar gyis pa'i skabs su/ phan tshun yang yang rgyasabatab pa'i nus pa rnams 'dir shin tu smin pas/ dge chos gcig la dmigasardepas dge chos gzhan ma lus pa yang cig char 'byung ba yin pas na/ mtharagyis pa yongs su gyur nas/ skad cig mar song ba yin te/ skabs 'dir rtag pa mthar bzung ste mthar chags su bsgom pa zhig gal te srid du chug kyang /mthar chags su mi yong bar kun dus su 'byung ba yin no/ /de yang shin tudabang 'byor bas gal te 'dod na ni/ mthar chags su 'byung ba yang srid mod kyi/ skad cig ma grub nas mthar chags bsgoms pa la dgos pa med pa'i phyira'adod par mi byed do/ /de la mthar chags rkyang par bsgoms pa'i nus go yongs su rdzogs pa ni/ mthar gyis pa'i mngon rtogs legs par thob zin pa yin la/ de nas rgyas 'debs nyis sbrag tu byed de/ rnam pa thams cad la sbyin pa dang tshul khrims gnyis kyis rgyas 'debs pa/ snga phyi rim can ma yin paradus mnyam du byed do/ /de ltar nyis sbrag dus mnyam du rgyas thebs pa nasabartsams te/ rnam pa thams cad du rgyas 'debs mtha' med pa'i bar du sbyor ba ni/ skad cig ma'i sbyor ba tsam yin te/ 'di ni rgyun mtha' sngon rol nas yod cing / skad cig ma'i mngon rtogs ni ma yin no/ /rgyas 'debs de yang lhun grub kyi tshul gyis 'byung dgos te/ 'bad rtsol can yin na ni skad cig ma'i thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyur mi 'gyur bas/ mi g.yo ba'i sa yan chad la ci rigs pa yod par shes par bya'o/ /dngos po bgyod pa chos sku ni/ ma lus shing lus pa — 134—

med pa'i chong/ sam shes bya thams cad kyi rang gzugs sam gnas lugs sam/sdod lugs yin pa'i phyir/ chos kun gyi lus sam sku'o/ /yang stobs dang mi'ajigs pa la sogs pa/ yon tan dang dge ces5 ma lus pa thams cad/ gcig tu 'dus pa'i spyi gzugs yin pa'i phyir yang chos kyi sku zhes bya'o/ /de yang don ni sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad mnyam pa nyid ye shes kyi rgya mtsho chen po de yin te/ de yang dag pa gnyis ldan no/ /dgapa gnyis ldan dang / rang bzhin gyis dag pa gcig pu pa zhes pa yang/ro bo sosor med cing mtshan gzhi'i ngos 'dzin yang tha dad du ma grub ste/ ye shes kyi rgya mtsho lta bu'i chos dbyings de nyid las/ gzhan ngas bzung du med pa'i phyiraro/ /'on kyang rnam gzhag gnyis po de ni/ rten gyi rgyud rigs mi 'drab gnyisal/ chos dbyings de de dang der song tshul tha dad pa yin te/ cho so sku de larangagi ngo bos ni glo bur gyi dri ma yang med mod kyi/ sems can rnams nyid slo buragyi dri mas bsgribs pa'i phyir/ chos dbyings de sems can rnams la rang bzhin rnam dag kho nar song / sangs rgyas rnams ni rang rgyud la glo bur gyi dri mdagapa'i phyir/ chos sku de yang sangs rgyas la ni dag pa gnyis ldan du song bsan/sangs rgyas kyis chos dbyings dag pa gnyis ldan thob ces bya ba de yang /chosadabyings la dag pa gnyis ldan yin min gyi cha gnyis yod pa zhig lag yin pa'i phyogs de thob pa'i don ma yin gyi/ sangs rgyas kyi rgyud kyis chos dbyingasayongs rdzogs de dag pa gnyis ldan gyi tshul gyis thob pa la/ dag pa gnyis ldan thob ces bsgrags pa yin no/ /dper na khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin ni/— 135 —
