slong ba po rnams la zas gos kho na'i sbyin bdag yin gyi/ sangs rgyas 'khoradang bcas pa'i ni yod byad thams cad kyi sbyin bdag yin no zhes brjod na/khyim bdag gnyis ni med la/ zas gos kho na'i sbyin bdag dang yod byad thams cad kyi sbyin bdag mtshan nyid spyi ldog 'gal yang / sbyin yul so so la bltosanas mi 'gal ba bzhin no/ /chos sku 'di dang / gong gi mkhyen gsum/'gogabaden ngo bo gcig cing / rnam mkhyen lam bden yang 'di'i khongs su bsdu ba yin mod kyi/ mkhyen gsum gyi skabs de dag tu ni/ da lta ma thob pa thob bya'i yul du bya ba dang / dmigs pa'i yul du byas nas bshad la/ dza dor ni 'brasabu de mngon du byed pa'i dbang du byas nas bshad pas/ don gyi 'chad tshul 'khobo bzlos par mi 'gyur ro/ /de yang mngon rtogs brgyad sgrig pa'i dbang du byas na bzlos spong dgos la/ gzhan du na mdo'i dngos bstan dang rgyas bshad la bzlos pa'i dogs pa yang med do/ /de ltar na dngos po brgyad kyi ngos 'dzin gsal 'dus su bshad zin to/ /cung zad rgyas par bshad pa la/ sher phyin 'bum pa la sogs pa medorgyas pa rnams kyi dbang du mdzad nas/ don gyi gtso bo bdun bcu dang shin turgyas bshad la yan lag gi rnam grangs mtha' yas pa yod kyang / mdo 'dir ni rnam mkhyen mtshon byed kyi chos bdun dang lam shes dang / gzhi shes kyi ro bo tsam dang / rnam kun gyi rnam pa dang / sbyor ba dang / rtse mor phyin pa'i spang bya spong ba'i gnyen po'i tshul tsam dang / mthar gyis pa'i ngo bo dang / skad cig ma'i ngo bo dang / chos sku'i don tshan bzhi po rnams te/ don gyi rnam grangs bco brgya dam/— 136 —

rtse sbyor gyi mthong sgom gnyis ka'i yang ngo bo cung zad gsal bas/ bcu dgurabyas kyang rung ngo / /de la rnam mkhyen mtshon byed kyi chos zhes pa'i go don 'brasabu rnam mkhyen de thob byed kyi rgyu lam gyi rim pa yin pa'i don yin gyi/ rnamamakhyen gyi rtogs bya'i yul bcu yin par 'chad pa mi legs la/ sems bskyed la sogs pa 'di dag la/ rnam mkhyen gyi sgra sbyor ba ni de bas kyang shin tumi'athad de/ rnam mkhyen gyi sgra bshad rgyu tsam yod du chug kyang / nyan thos kyi thegapa dang / pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa dang / sngags kyi theg pa rnams/las/ rnawapa thams cad mkhyen pa ni rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi ye shes kho na la gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnas skabs thams cad du shin tu grags pa dang ha cang 'gal ches/pas so/ /dper na sangs rgyas la lha tshe ring po'i sgra bshad du yod kyang / de ltar tha snyad sbyar na shin tu mi mdzes pa bzhin no/ /mtshon byed kyi chos de dag kyangadziskad du/ sems bskyed pa dang gdams ngag dang / /nges 'byed yan lag rnamabazhi dang / /sgrub pa yi ni rten gyur pa/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin dang / /dmigs pa dag dang ched dang ni/ /go cha 'jug pa'i bya ba dang/ /rdzos ni nges par 'byung bcus rnams/ /thub pa'i rnam kun mkhyen pa nyid/ khes/gsungs na/ sems bskyed ni/ gzhan don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob para'adod pa la ngos 'dzin pa ni spyir btangs tsam yin la/ de tsam zhig ni smon pa sems bskyed tsam yang yin no/ /de yang spyod pa pha rol tu phyin pa drug dnga'abrel na ni/ 'ju/ga pa sems bskyed zhes bya ste/ gang 'ju ga pa yod pa de lasmon sems kyang yod do/ /sems bskyed tsam ni de ltar yin kyang/ shes rab kyi — 137 —

pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgrub pa sems bskyed du 'gyur bal/ spros bral gyi ltab sngon du song ba dgos shing de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can la stong nyid la brten nas snying rje 'a lcag des kun nas bslangs te sems bskyed pa yin pagadangos gzhi'i dus su yang dngos sam rjas mthun tsi 'dra yang 'khor gsum rnam par mi rtog pa'i stong nyid kyis zin pa zhig dgos pa yin no/ /de'i tshe semasabaskyed dang sems bskyed kyi spyod pa thams cad kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i lam du 'gyur ro/ /de yang las dang po pa nas/ sangs rgyas mthob gyi b.radu sems bskyed kyi mtshan nyid dang ldan pa yin la/ sangs rgyas kyi sar ni de'i rigs rgyun dmigs pa med pa'i/ snying rjes chen po ni yod kyang/ sems bskyed kyi mtshan nyid ni log pa yin cing / tshogs sbyor gyi lam du ni sems bskyed de yang sher phyin gyi sgrub pa kho na yin gyi sher phyin dngos ma yin la/ mthong la5thob nas ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sems bskyed dngos yin par shes par bya'o/ /ga dmasang ga ni/ slob dpon byang chub sems dpa' zhig gis/slob ma byang chub tu sems bskyed pa gang la/ shes rab kyi pha rol phyin pa'i chosabastan pa'i ngag tshig gis rkyen byas te/ de'i rgyud la sher phyin gyi dbang du byasapa'i/ mnyam gzhag gi lam dngos rgyud la skyes pa'am/ sngar skyes la bogs phyin pa'am/ nyes skyon gyi gegs sel bar gyur pa'i gnas skabs de ni 'i derabastan gdams ngag gi lam zhes bya'o/ /ga dmasang ga khyad par can ni chosastergyun gyi ting nge 'dzin thob nas/ de bzhin gshegs pas mngon sum du 'domasapa la bya ste/ ga dmasang ga ces bya ba dngos bstan ltar na/ 'doms pa'i ngag— 138 —

tshig la zer yang / 'bras bu la rgyu'i ming gis btags nas/ de'i de ngosakyi grub 'bras slob ma'i rgyud la skyes pa la bya'o/ /nges 'byed yan lag ni/ skabs 'dir theg chen sbyor lam ste/ nges pa ni chos nyid dang de 'byed pa ni mthong lam yin pas/ de'i yan lag ste rgyu tsho gos ni de yin pa'i phyir ro/ /sbyor lam de chos nyid la gsal snang ni thob pa yin cing / mi rtog pa'i tshul gyis chos nyid cung zad rang gis rig pa yang yin la/ rnal 'byor pa'i mngon sum gyis rtogs pa ni ma yin pa dang / gzung 'dzin gyi rnam rtog glo bur pa rnams rim gyis 'gag par 'gyur ba yin pa dang / gangamangon 'gyur ba ma 'gags pa'i rtog pa de dang de yang / mnyam gzhag tu mi 'byung mod kyi/ rjes thob tu de dag 'byung zhing / de dag ma spangs pa'i stobasakyis mnyam gzhag kyang cung zad mi gsal ba yin no/ /sbyor lem gyi ye shesa'adi kun yang mi rtog pa spros bral gyi rnam pa can yin pas/ bar bar na rnatshapar rtog pa'i 'dzin pa cung zad 'dres pa yod kyang rang gi ngo bo rtog pa nam yang ma yin cing / chos nyid cung zad tsam gsal la cung zad tsam mi gsal ba ni/dper na seng ras kyis gdong g.yogs te dngos po la bltas pa bzhin no/ /de ltar sems bskyed cing gdams ngag mnos nas pha rol tu phyin pa'i don bsgoms ( 〈dzi〉 rgi pa ) las/ ces 'byed yan lag rgyud la skyes te/ tshogs sbyor gyi lam chod par 'gyur bas rim pa de bzhin du bstan la/spyir sems bskyed nyid dam ga dmasang ga nyid kyi nang du lam thams cad 'du ba yin pas go rim med kyang / go rim 'di dang por sems bskyed pa dang/ dang — 139 —

por gdams ngag mnos pa'i dbang du byas pa yin no/ /de ltar na tshogs sbyor ni/ spyir rnam mkhyen gyi sgrub pa tsam yin kyang / khyad par can ni ma yin la/sgrub pa khyad par can rnams ni 'phags pa'i lam yin pas/ lam de ge tsoborabazhag pa'i dbang du byas nas/ ji ltar sgrub pa nyams su len pa thams cad kyi rten nam rgyu ni chos dbyings yin la/ chos dbyings de yang spros pa dang bral zhingarnam pa thams cad pa'o/ /de ni rang gi ngo bo'i steng nas kun rdzob kyi chos gangagis kyang ma gos mod/ rnal 'byor can gyi blo la 'char tshul gyi dbang du byasanas/ tshogs lam gyi rten chos dbyings dang / sbyor lam gyi rten chos dbyingasasogs lam lnga dang sa bcu'i rten gyi 'jug tshul byed do/ /chos dbyings de nyeralen gyi rgyu dgos min kyang / /'dra ba'i sgo nas sgrub pa'i nyer len gyi tha snyad 'jog go /chos dbyings de rang bzhin gnas rigs yin la/ thar pa'i rgyu dgochos 'phel ba'i rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs kyang de la brten te zhugs pa'i phyir/ de dang 'brel pa can yin pa'i rnam gzhag kyang byas so/ /sgrub pa'i dmigs pa tsam ni chos thams cad yin la/ dmigs pa'i gtso bo ni chos thams cad kyi chos nyid de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po yin pas/don dam pa'i stong nyid de rten dang dmigs pa gnyis kar du rung ngo / /ho du bya ba ni sgrub pa byed pa'i skabs kyi 'dod don te/ 'di la rgya bod phal cher sangasargyas kyi sas bsdus pa'i spangs rtogs 'phrin las gsum mam sku bzhi'am/mkhyen gsum sogs chen po gsum dang sbyor ba zhig snang yang / de'i thad kyi mdo dang mi mthun la/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sgra bshad — 140 —

'a 'a rgyas la sbyor ba yang /'a rdzu las 'das na bshad pa yin paga'ad na sa chub sems 'ang nyad kya spyad pa sa no pa' tshe/'phral sa dgos pa' 'dod don yan gya/chang ge ga ched kyi byab khon ma yan no//mdo las/byang chub sems dpa' sgra bshad — dbang du mdzad nagasems dpa' dang sems dpa' chen po'i sgra bshad kyis sems chen po dang /byang ba'i sgra bshad kyis spong ba chen po dang /chub pa'i mu bshad kyis rtog༅pa chen po bstan te/mdo rgyas pa na/bcom ldan 'das kyas sems chen po dang/shā ri'i bus spong ba r+pā po dang /rab 'byor gyis rtogs pa wo po rnamasagasungs la/yon tan rin po che bsdud pa las/rtsi phyir de ni sems dpa' tshezhes bya zhe na//sems can tshogs rnams mang po'i mchog tu gyur pa dang/sems can khams kyi lta rnams chen po gcod pa ste//de phyir 'di ni semasardedapa' che zhus rab brjod de//gtong ba che dang blo che ba dang mthu 'a//rgyalab rnams kya theg chen mchog la zhugs pa dang //go cha chen po bsgos shang bdud kyi rgyu 'dul ba//de yi phyir na sems dpa' che zhes brjod pa yin/khes/gsungs te/'jig rten 'a rnams dang /mu she thos dang rang sngel dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kya/yon tan gya tshogs rnams las ja ltar 'os 'osasu skad cig re re bzhin ma thob pa rnams thob par byed/thob pa rnams spewabar byed pa'i 'ju / ga pa sems bskyed dang ldan pas sems can gzhan thams cad kyi gtso bo dang mchog tu gyur pa ni sems chen po'o//bdag nyid kyisagazhan la chos bstan pas/de rnams za bdag lta dang mthar lta la sogs/pa lta

smos kyang ci dgos/ lam dang 'bras bu la 'dzin pa'i dmigs pa'i lta ba thams cad kyang spong bar byed pa ni spong ba chen po dang / sbyin pa chen po lasogs pa gzhan la med pa'i khyad chos dpag tu med pa mnga' ba rnams la yang /chos dbyings kyi rang bzhin rtogs pa'i stobs kyis ma chags pa ni rtogs pa chen po ste/ ri rab la mngon par dmigs na n+ya gro dha'i sdong po la che ba'i blo miskye ba bzhin no/ /'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi spyod pa gang spyod kyang / 'phral 'phral du ched gtad sbyor dgos pas/ ched du bya ba zhes bya ste/'phral 'phral du byed dgos rgyu'i don no/ /sgrub pa dngos ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug kar sher phyin gyis zin parabyas nas lag len du 'debs pa yin te/ kha cig ngo bo phyin drug yin kyang sgrub pa'i ldog cha nas/ brtson 'grus na pas/ sgrub pa'i ngo bo ni brtson 'grusasozhes phal cher zer na/ de tsam zhig don la zhugs su ni rung yang/ bshad pa'i nus pa bzang po ni min no/ khres rab snying po'i mdo 'dir sgrub pa bzhi'i dbye ba ma gsungs pas skabs 'dir mi 'chad la/ mdor na bdag nyid kyi yon tan rdzogs par byed pa'i sgrub pa dang / gzhan smin cing grol bar byed pa'i sgrub pa gnyis su ma 'dus pa med de/ rgyas par byang chub sems dpa'i sa las rtogasapar bya'o/ /da ni lam shes pa nyid la mthong lam dang sgom lam gnyis su dbyerayod kyang / dmigs rnams kyi sgo nas mi 'dra ba med de/ mthong la༅gyis ji ltar mthong ba'i don de nyid sgom lam gyis goms par byed pa'i phyir ro/ /sgosalam lam shes de yang ji lta bu snyam na/ ji skad du/ de yi ngo bo nyid mchog— 142 —

nyid/ /kun la mngon par 'du mi byed/ /chos rnams dmigs su med parani/ /gtod bar byed pa don chen nyid/ /ces gsungs te/ mdo las kyang / sher phyin ni shin tu rnam par dag pa'i slad du snang bar bgyid pa'o/ /zhes sogasadang / sgrub pa med pa'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgrub parabya'o/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar/ mun pa lta bu'i gzung 'dzin gyi snang ba sangs shing / ye shes kyi snang ba rgyas pa'i chos dbyings rnam pa kun ldan lamanyam par 'jog pa ni/ sgom lam mnyam gzhag de'i ngo bo nyid yin la/ de ni dge chos rnams thams cad kyi mchog yin cing / gzugs sogs kun rdzob kun la sgrub pa mngon par 'du mi byed cing thob par yang mi byed la/ chos de rnamasadamigs pa med pa'i dbyings su gtad pas/ don dam gyi dbyings der thiwapar byed pa'i khyad chos dang ldan pa ste/ 'di ni mnyam gzhag sgrub pa sgom lamazhes bya zhing / rjes thob tu mos pa dang / bsngob dang rjes su yi rang gsum laslob dgos pa de ni mtshon byed de/ thabs mkhas kyi sgo thams cad la yangabaslab par bya'o/ /rnam dag sgom lam zhes bya ba ni/ nyer lnga pa'i mdo 'dir dngos su med kyang 'phro don tsam du zhor la 'phangs pa'ang yin te/ sgom lam gyis thos pa'i rnam dag gi ming ngo / /de yang ji skad du/ 'bras bu dag pa gzugs la sogagardedag pa nyid de gang gi phyir/ /de gnyis tha dad ma yin cing / /dpyad du med pasadag par brjod/ /ces gsungs te 'bras bu'i dag pa dang / rang bzhin gyi dgapa dbye ba med pa de nyid/ ji ltar rigs pa thob pa'i don no/ /de lta bu'i mthong— 143 —

lam dang sgom lam gyi ye shes rgyud la skyes pa na/ mdo rgyas pa las 'byung ba ltar phan yon sna tshogs pa rnams kyang 'byung ba yin no/ /gzhi shes kyi rang bzhin ni gong du bshad zin la/ nyan rang gi rgyud kyi gzhi shes sam byang chub sems dpa'i rgyud kyi yang / thabs mkhas dang mi ldan pa de ni/ chos kyi dbyings la thag ring pa yin cing / thabs mkhas dang ldan pa ni nye ba'o/ /'on kyang byang sems 'phags pa ni thabs la mi mkhas pa mi srid cing / so so skye bo'i de ni gzhi shes min pas/ theg chen pa la chos dbyingasalathag ring pa'i gzhi shes med do snyam na/ gzhi shes kyi sgrub pa la gzhi shesasubatags pa yin pas/ so so skye bo la yod do/ /mi mthun phyogs kyi gzhi shesazer ba ni/ theg pa chen po rtogs pa 'gyur ba la mi mthun phyogs kyi khyad parazhig gi ming ste/ nyan rang gi gzhi shes kyang de'i nang tshan yin mod kyi/ gastobor byang chub sems dpa' rnams nyid/ gang zag go bdag med pa sgom pa'i tshe/dngos por 'dzin pa dang stong par 'dzin pa skye na de'i ming yin te/ ji skad du/gzugs sogs phung po stong nyid dang / /dus gsum rtogs pa'i chos rnamasadang / /sbyin sogs byang chub phyogs rnams la/ /spyod pa'i 'du shes mi mthun phyogs/ /zhes so/ /gnyen po'i gzhi shes ni/ byang chub sems dpa' gang zagagi bdag med pa sgom pa'i tshe yang / sangs rgyas la mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i yid byed dam chags pa phra mos kyang ma gos par byed dgos na/ gzhan la 'dzin cing chags pa 'gog pa lta smos kyang ci dgos pas/ gang zag gi bdag med sgom pa de yang / sems can nam phung po'i rnam pa ma log pa de 'dra ma yin par/— 144—

spros pa sa 'a cad dang bral ba~X nga rug she gyis 'od gsal ba'i mi nga mi can no//de' phyar bkro med des zan she lho) pa yang 'khor sbyin ma shesapa la rang gnas shang gzhan yang 'gad pa'//de ltar yang /—na las ba/sa pa ngar 'dzin med//gzhan dag de la 'ju : ka pa dang //de ni chag/sa pa'i mtha' ge tsha ra phyo ge‘rde de :re/ lha rtse khri sgro/rdemu ge rtse pas//'a sdu sags rge ge ge ge rga mi dge pa phra//mos rang bzhi ba / khrig/ 'a//dben pa'i phyir na de za~X nyad//chos/rnams rang bzhan ba / khog pa pa nga ba'i zhagacigarasno/zhes sto/sa pa spong ༵ na//ces gsungs te/rang ba ga pa rang bzhan she she brda gag pas de bzhi paX//sashernam rdzags sbyar ba 'a rnam dro spyo bya sna she/lo 'a 'a dam pa she thams 'a ra sprel gyi pa las/ste deng 'a kya rdzu ral tu phyan / gos ge rtse mugras na/yul gam/ /ying sang mib rnam grags pa ༷mags tsherdeyul yan rngis/rnam kun dngas ma na la/dgas snaX de rnams la rnam pa de pas/tshe long la gzugs 'a shar pa lta~Xrang shas pa yang /rnam pa dag dag stug bye / nga / par sha/ ba na/yul snran rnam pa ste/cig bo sdel bsan gra3sa pa na rngas rdzo/de na rnam 'a mi no nyad bde ngo bo ༵ga go/da la bstan bcas dang mad rgyas pa 'a/'ar tshod dod dodage ge ge cha~Xpa nyara~X//rdes /lam shes la bden bzha' rnam pa sa drug mkhye dngan rnga /she 'a lasprapa' rnam pa spyo bslo/ za myo bcu bshad spya las/ma per pa ba : //spru dmigs5pas / rnams bden ba rnam par 'du snas sa//de yang bden pa ba la da ༵sto/kun rdzob sgyu ma tsam gyi rgyu 'bras rten ༵brel 'gag pa pho kyang /rang ba

spros pa thams cad dang bral bas khyad par du byas pa nyid las nga bdag ma dmigs pa ni/ gzhi shes kyi rnam pa dang / bden bzhis bsdus pa'i kun rdzob kyi chos thams cad rten 'brel sgyu ma lta bu la/ don dam par ci yang ma yin pa nam mkha' lta bu ste spros bral dang / rang gi nyams su star ba'i dge chos thams/cad kyang / spros pa dang bral ba'i rang bzhin nyid du gnas pa ni/ lam shes kyi rnam pa dang / don dam pa'i dbyings de ni nam mkha' ltar spros pa thams cad dang bral zhing / spros bral de nyid rnam pa thams cad par gdod nas shar ba dang / khyad par du yang byang phyogs dang phar phyin dang stobs bcu sogs dgoces thams cad kyi rnam par gnas pa ni rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa yin no/ /rnam pa de lta bu tshang bar byas nas ji ltar sgom pa'i tshul ni/ sbyor ba ste de yang mi gnas pa'i sbyor ba zhes bya la/ dngos po dang mtshan ma dang dmigs pa gang la yangamiganas pa'i phyir ro/ /des na chos gang dag skyes pa dang / byung ba dang / 'byung ba dang / gnas pa dang / 'phel ba dang yod pa sogs su mi 'dzin cing/ de dgal sems mi gnas la/ 'gags pa dang / mi 'byung ba dang / ma byung bdang/ma phrad pa dang / ma tsho gigs pa dang / 'gribs pa dang / med pa so gos/la yangasems mi gnas te/ gang la yang mi gnas/ gar yang mi 'gro/ col yangami'agog gang du yang mi 'gyur ba'i tshul gyis mnyam par 'jig pa nyid yin te/rtsol ba med pa'i phyir khyad chos mi spyor ba'i sbyor ba sogs kyang de la ḍā ba yin pas/ sbyor ba ni nyi shu'am lnga la sogs par grags kyang gcig kho na yinano/ /de ltar yang gzugs la sogs la mi gnas phyir/ de la spyor ba bkag— 146—

pa'i phyir/ zhes so/ /mdo 'di las dngos su mi gnas pa'i sbyor ba khon bstan to/ /rtse mo'i sbyor ba dngos ni/ mthong sgom bar chad med rtse gsum po yin na/de rnams kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i rnam pa kho nar gcig pas/dmigs rnam mi 'dra ba'i tshul du med mod/ 'on kyang / spang bya spong tshuladangayon tan mngon par sgrub pa'i khyad par ni shin tu che la/ de la spang bya gzunga'adzin gyi rtogs pa bzhi ni/ gzung bya'i snang ba la brten nas kun nas nyon mongs kyi rnam rtog skye ba 'dod chags zhe sdang la sogs pa dang / de dgagoganasang na len la brten pa'i rnam rtog ni gzhi kun nas nyon mongs kyi rnam rtog gam gzung rtog ste dang po'o/ /gzung ba'i snang ba la brten nas skyes pa'i dad pa la sogs pa dge chos kyi rnam par rtog pa dngos por mngon par zhen pa'i mtshan nyid du 'dug pa de ni/ gnyen po gzung rtog ces bya ba yin no/ /phyi rol gzung ba'i snang ba la mngos su ma dmigs kyang / sems kyi rgyud tsa moladamigs nas/ bdag gam chos rdzas yod du 'dzin pa ni/ rdzas 'dzin rtogapazhes bya la/ sems kyi rgyud la da rigs nas/ gang zag gam cho se btags/yod tsam du 'dzin pa ni/ btags 'dzin rtog pa zhes bya'o/ /rnam rtog de dgalasamangon 'gyur ba ni spyor lam bzhis rim gyis sprong ba yin la/ de rnams kyi nanganas chos nyid kyi ngo bo tsam mthong ba la sgrib pa mthong bas spang bar bya ba gang yin pa de dag ni mthong lam rtse sbyor gyis sa bon drung 'byin par byed cing /chos nyid kyi khyad par mthong ba la bar du gcod par byed pa sgom spangs su gtogs pa gang yin pa de ni sgom lam rtse spyor rim can du byung ba rnams kyis— 147—

rim gyis spong bar byed de/ sgom spang gi nang tshan gzhi kun nas nyon mongs kyi rnam rtog ces bya ba rnams ni/ bag la nyal gyi nyon sgrib la brten nas gnasapa'i rnam rtog yin cing / sa brgyad pa yan cad la ni de dag kyang mtshan ma med pa'i rnam rtog kho nar shes par bya'o/ /spang bya rnam rtog rang gi yul snang ba dngabacas pa ni/ gdod ma nas ma grub cing / med bzhin du snang pa yin pa ladeltar rtogs pa ni spangs pa'i don yin te/ de skad du/ 'gog pa med pa'i rangabazhin la/ /mthong zhes bya ba'i lam gyis ni/ /ci zhig nyams shing ci zhig thob/ /rnam par rtog rigs ci zhig zad/ /skye med rnam pa ci cig thob/ /gzhan gyi chos rnams kyang yod la/ /shes bya la yang ston pa yi/ /sgrib pa zad parabarjod pa gang / /de la kho bos mtshar du brtsis/ /'di la bsal bya tsi yangamed/ /bzhag par bya ba cung zad med/ /yang dag nyid la yang dag blta/ /yangadag mthong na rnam par grol/ /ces gsungs pa yin no/ /mthong bas spang b.rabya ba rnams ni/ dus gcig tu spong ba yin la/ sgom pas spang bar bya ba rnamasani rim gyis spong zhing yon tan yang rim gyis gang bar 'gyur te/ ji skad du/yams nad 'di rnams zad nas na/ /yun rings lon nas dbugs phyin ltar/ /rnam pa kun tu 'gro ba yi/ /bde sgrub yon tan phun tshog༅kun/ /rgya mtsho che la chu bo bzhin/ /'bras bu mchoge gis dpa' ba yi/ /sems/dpa' chen po de la ni/ /rnam pa kun tu bsten par byed/ /ces 'byung ngo / /mthar gyis pas mthar chags su sgom pas ni/ rang rang gi ngo skal gyi spang bya phyin ci log gi bag chags phra mo rnams rim gyis sbyong bar byed do/ /skad cig ma ni de ltar bag— 148 —

chags byang ba'i 'bras bu yin te/ sangs rgyas kyi ye shes dang phal cher 'drab/skad cig gnyis par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par byed pa'i lam/ bar chad med pa'i sbyor ba dang / rdorje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin ces bya ba/ ma rig bgachags kyi sa rtsa ba nas 'joms par byed pa de yin no/ /'bras bu chos 'a mngon par rtogs pa la/ sku gsum dang 'phrin las te bzhi'o/ /de la ngo bo nyid sku ni/ chos dbyings shin tu dri ma med pa dag pa gnyis ldan de/ legs pa'i yon tan gyi chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin dang / ngo bo dang / rnam par 'dugapa'o/ /de ltar yang / thub pa'i ngo bo nyid sku ni/ /zag pa med pa'i chos gangadag /thob gyur rnam kun rnam dag pa/ /de dag rang bzhin mtshan nyid can/ /ces gsungs pa te/ legs pa'i yon tan gyi chos de dag tha pas cad kyang / don dam gdod ma yin pas rang bzhin gyi ngo bor gnas kyi/ kun rdzob rnam 'gyur gyi tshul gyis ma yin no/ /'dir zag pa med pa'i chos zhes pa'i rgyasabashad la/ byang chub phyogs mthun sogs zag med kyi sde tshan nyer gcig gsungs pa yin pas/ gzhung gi gnas skabs de gnyis ngo bo nyid sku dang/rtogs pa ye shes chos sku zhes/ don tshan so sor 'byed pa ni mdo dang bstan bcos kyi dgongs pa ma yin no/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku ni/ 4zha dpe mtha' yas pas nye bar brgyan pa'i ye shes kyi sku/ chos kyi 'khor lo ma lus pa cig char bskor ba po yin la/ sprul pa'i sku ni 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' yasapar/ sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa rgyun mi 'chad bar 'byung ba rnams te/ mdzad pa bcu gnyis ston pa sogs la mchog gi sprul pa'i sku zhes yongs su grags so/— 149—

'dir ni de tsam zhig rnam par gzhag mod kyi/ sku gsum gyi rang bzhin ni sngarabashad zin pa ltar ro/ /'phrin las ni/ sems can thams cad la 'jug ste/rang gi skal ba dang 'tsham par/ mngon par mthong ba'i bde ba dang/ces paralegs pa'i phan pa la 'god cing / mthar thug gi 'phrin las ni sangs rgyasarterang nyid kyi go 'phang la 'god pa'o/ /'o na mawo dpe la sogs pa'i phro to ni longs sprul gyi skabs su 4gad cing / ngo bo nyid sku'am chos sku'i yon to gyi skabs su med pas/ rang bzhin gyi mtshan nyid can gyi yon tan min la/demayin pa'i phyir rang bzhin gyi grub pa'i bde gshegs snying po la/ mtshan dpe yod par 'dod pa shin tu mi 'thad do snyam pa dang / rgyud bla ma las kyang/ gzugs/sku la mtshan gyi yon tan so gnyis dang / chos sku la stobs sogs so gnyisabashad pas kyang ngo snyam na/ yon tan gyi sde tshan 'di rnams ni/ju yang dag pa'i ngag dang / yang dag pa'i las kyi mtha' dang / yang dag pa'i 'tsho bdang/ de bzhin du skye ba la dbang ba dang / so so yang dag pa rig pa bzhi dang/ mi'ajigs pa bzhi dang / sku dang gsung gi spyod lam bsrung ba mi mnga' ba dang/lha'i mig dang / rna ba dang / sku la 'khrul ba mi mnga' ba dang / gsung cacomimanga' ba la sogs pa'i yon tan de dag kyang sku'i snang ba dang gsung gi snang ba med na khungs stongs par 'gyur la/ zad par dang zil gnon la sogs pa yang / sku dang 'brel pa las 'byung gi sku dang gsung gi snang ba med pa'i rig pa rnam pa rnam med la ci zhig 'byung ste/ de dag gi spyod yul mthong ba po med pa'i phyir ro/ /sku'i spyod lam bsrung ba mi mnga' ba dang / sku la 'khrul ba mi mnga' ba — 150—

de dag chos sku'i yon tan yin phyin/ 'khrul ba med rgyu'i sku de dang/ bsrung ba med rgyu'i sku'i spyod lam de/ zhal phyag rnam pa'i gzugs brnyan can mtshan dpe can gyi sku la mi 'jog na/ mtshan dpe sogs gang yang med pa'i sku gzugasa'ajim pa'i gong bu 'dra ba zhig yod dam ci/ ci ste chos kyi sku la sku lus med na ni/ de la 'khrul ba yod med kyi dpyad gzhi stongs te/ gzhan du na/ri bongagorwa la gas chag med pa yang ci'i phyir chos sku'i yon tan du mi 'jog sku de gzugs sku kho na yin na ni/ yon tan de dag kyang de nyid kyi spyod lam la sogs pa'i yon tan yin par 'gyur gyi chos sku'i ci'i phyir yin chos sku'i nus mthu las gyur pas so snyam na ni/ mtshan dpe yang ci'i phyir chos sku'i mthu lasatshabyung / des na gang dag sangs rgyas ci med cang med du 'dod pa dang/ sangs rgyas bya ba kha mig gcig med kyi/ mi skya'i skabs kyi rig pa hol thom tsheb 'di ka chos sku zad ma yin cing / 'thab brtsod dang zhabrug long dang / nyo tshong dang/zhing las dang / zas gos dang / 'khrig pa'i longs spyod sogs don du gnyerab/ nyon mongs dang rnam rtog gi lang long 'di ka chos sku'i rang 'od yin la/spyin sogs dang lha sgom pa la sogs pa gnas lugs las gol ba yin pas sgom du mi rung ngo / /zhes skad gsangs mthon pos lta ba mtho mtho mor sgrog pa de ni/ mtshan dpe can gyi sku dang / gsung chos kyi sgra dbyangs dang/ thugs shesabya thams cad rig pa'i ye shes dang 'phrin las blang dor gyi gnas rnams/ rnatshartog tsam dang blos byas tsam yin no zhes mchog rnams g.yas chung ngu phab cing /nyon mongs rang ga ma yar bstod nas sangs rgyas yin par thag gcod pa ste/— 151 —

dge chos sun 'byin cing / mi dge ba'i zhabs tog byed pa'i bla ma skyes chen bye ba khrag khrig byung ba 'di rnams ni/ gzhan 'phrul bdag po'i gcan pa kho naranges so/ /yang 'di skad ces/ yon tan de dag ni chos sku dngos ma yin gyi/chos sku'i nus pa la brten nas byung ba yin pa'i phyir 'dir smos so zhes pa 'di ni bden dgos te/ gzhan du na zad par la sogs pa 'khrul shes yin pa'i phyir chos sku dngos te ga la yin ce na/ chos kyi sku'i yon tan kyi sku dang/ gsungadang / zhing khams dang / mtshan dpe dang / zad par zil gnon la sogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi spyod yul rnams kyang 'khrul ba ma yin te yang dag pa'i ye shes nyag cig go /gdul bya gzhan snang du/ sa chu la sogs pa ston pa yang/ kun rdzob bden pa la bltos te ni 'khrul snang du mi 'jog ste/ so so skye bo rnams kyi las ngan gyi 'bras bu ni ma 'khru/la la/ 'phags pa rnams kyi ye shes kyi spyod yul ni 'khrul lo zhes bya ba ni/ 'khrul ma 'khrul gyi dbye ba go log tu gyur pa'i phyir ro/ /ci ste las snang 'di kun rdzob tu bden na ni/ gdul blo'i don du 'gyur ba'i tshe/ ri dang chu la sogs pa 'gro ba spyi mthun gyi snang ngor brtan paraganas pa yang mthong bas de dag bden cing gzhan dag mi bden no/ /zhes dbyeb ci'i phyir nus/ de lta bas na rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa la dad pa mi 'dor ba shin tu gal che'o/ khren tu spros pas chog go /da ni mngon par rtogs pa'i don de dag nyid/ shes rab kyi pha rol phyin pa'i snying po'i mdo 'di nyid kyi tshig dang rim pa bzhin du sbyar bar bye rdo /de yang de nas sangs rgyas kyi mthus zhes pa nas/ gang ba med pa'o zhes pa'i bar— 152 —

gyis rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid bstan pa yin te/ dri ba dri lan kyi skabasasu shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo spyad pa spyod par 'dod pa/ zhes pasasems bskyed dang / ji ltar bslab pa zhes dris pa la 'di ltar rnam par bltabar bya ste/ zhes gdams pas ni/ gdams ngag bstan pa dang/ rang bzhin gyis stong par yang dag par rjes su blta'o/ /zhes pas ni sbyor lam gyi dmigs rnam bstan pas nges 'byed cha mthun no/ /de ltar yang / dmigs pa mi rtagalasogs pa/ /bden pa'i rten can de yi ni/ /rnam pa mngon zhen la sogs 'gogaces gsungs so/ /gzugs stong pa'o zhes pa la sogs pas sgrub pa'i rten chosardedabyings bstan to/ /de lta bas na chos thams cad stong pa nyid de sogs kyisasgrub pa'i dmigs pa dang / mtshan nyid med pa sogs kyis spong ba chen po lasogs pa ched du bya ba chen po gsum bstan to/ /bri ba med cing gang ba med pa zhes pas/ spang bya sgrib pa rang bzhin gyis ma dmigs shing / thob bya lam dang yon tan thams cad kyang sgyu ma lta bur shes nas/ bri gang bsal bzhag med par rtogs kyang tshogs gnyis rlabs po che rgyun mi 'chad par spyod pa'i sgrub pa bstan pa yin te/ 'dir sgrub pa'i ngo bo tsam zhig bstan pas/ dbye ba go cha'i sgrub pa/ 'jug pa'i sgrub pa/ tsho gis kyi sgrub pa/ ces 'byung skrub pa'i khyad pararnams shugs la bstan pa yin no/ /de ltar na rnam mkhyen mtshon byed kyi chosardebacu po bstan pas mtshon bya rnam mkhyen bstan pa yin la/ der ma zad zab mo'i mtshan nyid rnam pa brgyad dang ldan pa'i sher phyin bstan pa kho nas kyang don dam pa'i rnam mkhyen chos kyi sku nyid gsal bar bstan pa yin no/ /stong pa nyid la— 153 —

gzugs med ces pa la sogs pas phung po dang skye mched dang khams rnams rang bzhin med par bstan pa 'dis ni/ lam shes kyi dmigs pa'i yul gas pa bar bstan pas/ de ltar rtogs pa'i lam shes nyid nges par bstan pa yin la/dbye ba'i tshig mi gsal yang mthong lam dang / sgrub pa sgom lam gnyis rnatshadag dang bcas pa shugs la bstan pa yin no/ /ma rig pa med sogs rten 'brel bcu gnyis lugs 'byung lugs zlog bkag pas ni/ dngos bstan gnyen po'i phyogs kyi gzhi shes kyi dmigs rnams gsal bar bstan pa yin la/kun nas nyon mongs kyi rten 'brel stong nyid du bstan pa'i shugs la/ nyan rangagi gzhi shes kyang 'phangs pa yin no/ /de bzhin du sdug bsngal ba dang sogs kyis/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba'i rnam pa rnams bstan te/ gzhi shes lam shes kyi rnam pa rnams ni/ bden bzhi spros pa dang bral ba'i rnam par 'dus la/ rnatshamakhyen gyi rnam pa rnams ni ye shes zhes par 'dus so/ /thob pa med pa dngawathob pa med pa zhes pas ni/ mi gnas pa'i spyor ba dngos su bstan cing/ de'i khyad chos mi sbyor ba'i sbyor ba sogs shugs la bstan la/ thob pa zhes pa yon tan dang 'bras bu thob pa kho na la 'chad pa lhar na/ slob pa phyir mi ldog pa'i tshogs la sogs pa/ don tshan phyi ma bzhi yang don gyis bstan par 'gyudaro/ /thob pa med pa'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mol ba tshe cingaganas zhes pa ni/ mi gnas pa'i sbyor ba'i rgyun shin tu goms shing byang b.laganas pa'i don te/ rtse mo'i sbyor ba dngos yin la/ sgrib pa med cing skrag pa med ces pas mthong sgom gyi rtse sbyor gyis/ spang bya gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa spong— 154 —

sdol she te/nas mi mthong ba la pa'iX 'i mthong gshe kho kau/minyad kha na ༷ ༷nas sa nus par skrag she sgam she med da zhes dngas su bstan laX/thin ci she dang 'a/lag sgrub spang ba rnams kyang shugasardzu' sa/she/the sda pas mthar gyis pa'i ༷rab bstan te bslab pa gsu 'ji sbyin tsho//'i ༷she shes pa'i sbyar ba bstan /bslab pa ༵sgasardepar 'dzin pa jiXpre ༷nyan par te sna rngol dge she ༷ drug dang /rtag pa mi rngasagapar 'an pa lhags she ba 'a' ba phyi dī/ log gi ba sdog dung / rta~Xpa la /ga sa she 'an ༷ la saXsna rdo lta zi sheX rde rnyig ge mu par bdag dzhai spyir myo kya mu la rdza pa dngas da nga ba nga me deX gyas pa ma gnyi/ kyi/ra mthar gyas pa' rnam di rnam pa bzung du da /sbyar ba snga ma gyi rnam pa dpa ni 'a la~X rnyi pa mang she dzi /'as te sgri rtsi losasu rtse mu pa/phyan cas zhes 'al/ ge zhe mu par ge rdzo pa' phyar te/ she 'ag/sang cig ma'i rgyore ste sangs rgya gyas pa bstan ta//she sti sags pa she ga ma' sbyar bshe sangs rgyasa~Xms cad gang sa ༷ la twa phyin nas/dngas su sangs rgyas thab pa 'a sdo/ra ba lam shes rab kya pha ral tu na pa de ni/skad cig ma'i sbyor ba yin te/rgyun mtha'i ye shes kyi ming gi rnam grang༅ra tsho ‘ri ra 'ge dzo ste/ra pob/swā//lte ge' ༵na gas zhe na she mdzad pa dang ༵dhi/pa / /shesatsākyā she mu tu phyan pa na meng swā rte/ maX bstan dang /rten khams nga ba nyad sku dang /bla na nid pa lis rnyings sku dang /'ag na khams sumanyam/ pa dang mnyam/ pa sprul pa / 5 sku gsum dang /sdug bsngal thaman/

cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa ni 'phrin las te chos sku'i mdzad pa'o/ /chos kyi sku 'gyu ra med yongs grub de ni/ mnyam gzhag ye shes 'khru/la ba dang bral bsanyams su myong bya yin pa'i phyir/ bden par grub pa yin la/ brdzun pa kun rdzob 'khor ba'i chos thams cad las gdod nas grol ba'i phyir/ mi rdzun pa stobardzun pa ma yin pa'i don no/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sngags zhes pa ni/ 'phrin las kyi khyad par chos sku'i rgyu mthun pa'i rigs sngags go kha cigasngags don la/ lam lnga dang sbyor ba ni skabs 'dir yang blang ste/ gte ni songapa ste tshogs lam/ ga te gnyis pa ni sbyor lam/ pa ra ga te ni mthong lam ste/pa ra zhes pa mchog ste 'jig rten las 'das pa'i ye shes yin pa'i phyir ro/ /pa ra sang ga te ni de bas kyang lhag pa yang dag par song ba'i ye shes te sgom lam mo/ /bo dhi ni byang chub ste 'bras bu rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sa'o/ /zhes skyes bu dam pa 'ga' zhig gsung ngo / /da ni sher phyin snying po'i mdo 'di'i don gyi nying khu sgom rim gyi lag len cung zad brjod par bya ste/ de yang thub pa'i bstan pa la brtul zhugs yangadag par blangs nas/ theg pa chen po'i sde snod la thos bsam ci rigs parabya'o/ /tshe 'dir mang du thos pa kho na ma lcogs na yang / gong du ji skad bstan pa ltar mdo sde dam pa 'di nyid kyi/ dngos bstan tshig don dang 'grel pa'i gob rnams legs par rtogs shing / the tshom med pa blo la gsal po 'byung ba zhig nges par gal che'o/ khyad par stong pa nyid kyi lta) ba dang / snying rje chen po dang/byang chub sems pa'i spyod pa rnams la nges pa rnyed pa dang / chos la yid ces pa — 156 —

dang dad pa brtan por gyur gyi bar du yang yang bsam pa gal che na/ de'i don du skyes bu gsum gyi rim pa lta bu sngon 'gror byas na legs so/ /de nas byang chub tu sems bskyed cing / 'grub na 'jug sems kyi sdom pa yang blang b.rabya'o/ /spyir mdo sde'i rgyan las gsungs pa ltar/ dmigs pa'i sems drug dngayid la byed pa bcu gcig dang / sems gnas pa'i thabs dgu la sogs pa dgos kyang / 'dir don gyi snying po mdo tsam ni 'di lta bus bsgom par bya ste/dang por gnas khang gtsang mar/ sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs dang mdo sde 'di'i glegs bam bzhugs su gsol/ mchod pa ji ltar 'os pa bshams/ khrus lasogs pa gtsang sbra dang ldan pas/ yan lag bdun pa dang / skyabs 'gro sems/bskyed byas te/ lus rnam snang gi chos bdun dang ldan par bya/ snanas rlung la na gsum bsal/ dbugs rang babs su bzhag ste/ bdag gang la brten nasasgom zhing sgrub pa ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i snying po'i mdo 'di'o/ /zhes yid la dran cing gzhan gang la yang ma yengs par/ 'i de ltarabasam ste/ sho lo ka nyer lnga'i rgo tsam 'di ni sher phyin snying po'i mdo yin no/ /bdag ni 'di la brten nas sangs rgyas sgrub bo snyam pa de nyid lan brgya tsam dran par byas nas/ bar der dge ba byang chub tu bsngos te/ khams/gsengazhing / 'chag pa la sogs pa ji ltar bde bas ngal gsos la/ yang sngar gyi tshad tsam du bsgom par bya'o/ /de ltar thun bcu tsam byas pas zhag gcig la/ yid la byed pa stong phrag gcig tu 'gyur la/ thun gyi tshad nyi grib la sogs pa ngesapa can du byas nas/ gal te khams dub na nyi ma gcig gam gnyis sam gsum — 157—

du thun thams cad nas cha phri ba'am/ thun 'ga' zhig cha phri ba'am/ gang mi bde ba'i thun 'jog pa lta bu ji ltar 'os pasang la gso/ thog ma'i thun gyi tshad ni ring thung rang gi blo dang 'tsham par sbyar bas rung ste/ de nas cung zad rga sla༅shing sgom pa la spro bar gyur pa'i tshe/ thun cung zad cung zad bskyed cing/ yangakhams log na cung zad cung zad phri'o/ /de la cung zad goms pa na/ mdo sde'adi la ni dang por gleng gzhi dang / de nas gleng bslang ba dang / de nas zab mobargyad kyi stong nyid dang / mkhas par bya ba drug phan yon dang bcas pa dang yi rang gi bar du yod do/ /don 'di ni bdag gi bsgom bya yin pa sogs gong bzhin bsam ste/'di dmigs pa chib ( 〈rja〉 theb ) pa'i phyir/ dmigs thengs re la snga ma las yun gsum bzhi tsam gyis ring bar 'jog dgos te/ thun re'i nangadu lan bzhi bcu 'am lnga bcu la sogs pa bsgom par bya'o/ /'di yang ring du goms nas/ thun so so'i mgor sngon bzhin bsgoms te/ dngos gzhi'i skabasasu/ mdo 'di las bstan pa'i zab mo brgyad dang ldan pa'i stong nyid ces bya ba ni/ gzhan zhig yod pa ma yin pa 'di lta ste/ bdag gzhan snod bcud kyi chosasna tshogs par snang ba 'di/ rang sems 'khrul ba'i snang ba tsam la shar bamagatogs cung zad kyang ngo bos med pa nyid do/ /zhes yang yang bsams shing / de ltar bsam pa lan nyer gcig sogs song ba na/ yang sngar gyi dmigs pa gnyis /po sngon du 'gro ba'i bar byas nas de 'dra nyer gcig sgom pa lta bu bya'o/ /de la cung zad goms na/ ma skyes pa la sogs pa'i rgyu mtshan gcig ga5— 158 —

gnyis sam mang po rang gi blo'i 'khobs dang bstun nas dran par byed pa yang bsnon no/ /yang de bzhin du phung po zhes bya ba ni rang gzhan snong bcud kyi stengan gnas 'di dang 'di dag yin la/ de thams cad kyang gdod ma nas mgrub po zhes gcig du bral la sogs pa'i rgyu mtshan cung zad dran par byas te 'dun pa shugs drag po sbyangs/ de bzhin du khams dang skye mched dang rten 'brel dang bden bzhi dang / gnas dang gnas min la yang sbyong dgos te/ blo rgya che na riwacan du sgom/ rgya chung na de dag las gang yang rung ba blo la bde zhing gsal ba cig sgom ste/ de dag ni sngon 'gro 'jug pa'i rim pa yin no/ /da ni dngos gzhi la/ yan lag bdun pa nas/ mdo don bsam pa'ibar tshang gcig song nas/ rang gzhan snod bcud 'khor 'das thams cad dziltar snang ba 'di sgyu ma lta bu yin/ yang dag par na cung zad kyang ma grub bo/ /gcig du bral la sogs pa cung zad gcig dran par byas nas nges shesakyang bskyed/ de ltar rang gzhan snang ba thams cad kyi steng du bsnyams pa'i tshe/gang yang ma grub pa de la che re mnyam par gzhag tshul des bden med du bsam pa dang / nges shes bskyed pa dang / ngang la 'jog pa gsum po de dag yang yangabaskyar te/ bcu 'am nyer gcig la sogs pa ji ltar rigs pa song ba na/ yangamado don dran pa sngon dus song pas dmigs pa nyer gcig la sogs pa bya'o/ /de dag gi bar bar du sher phyin gyi mdo 'di'i phan yon dang/ ga a ba po sangs rgyas kyi yon tan dran nas/ sangs rgyas dang chos spyi dang / dgosasu'adi la mos gus dung nge ba re bsgom/ sems can 'khrul ba rnams la snying rje — 159—

lhag par re yang gsal btab/ de ltar gnad du 'gro bar byung na/ zhag bdun bdun tsam re nas/ bsam med du mnyam par 'jog pa de cung zad cung zad reyun ring du btang / de yang mi rtog pa'i blo ngo na ci yang ma yin pa'i rnam pa de 'char gyi 'dug na de yun ring du gtong ba yin gyi/ shes pa mi gsal ba mun mun par yod na/ shes pa bzo med du bzhag kyang mi phan pas/ gnad snga tshaganyis la shugs bskyed pa gal che/ de dag gi skabs su sgom thun yun ring porathub na thun 'tshams su ngal gso zhing / chos spyod kyi rim pa cung zad ( 〈dzi〉 bcu mdo tsam ) re byas pas chog la/ thun yun thung ngu las mi byed na/ thun mtshams kyi chos spyod gal che ste/ de la thun mtshams kyi spyod pa ni spyir chos spyod sgo thams cad nas yin kyang / khyad par mdo sde 'di nyid yi ger 'bri ba dang/'di'i gleg bam la mchod pa dang / gleg bam klog pa dang / kha don du byed pa dang / mdo'i don 'chad pa'am/ nyan pa'am/ bsam pa la sogs pa zho /de dag goms nas/ sems gnas par dgu'i rim pas stong nyid la dmigs pa'i zhi gnas dang / rang sems kyi ngo bo nyid dang / khyad par yang yang brtsal bsacha shas tsam gyi lhag mthong la brten nas stong pa nyid la nges pa rnyed par 'gyur ba sogs spyi dang 'dra'o/ /de'i tshe rang bzhin gang du yang ma grub pa'i nga ba nasasems kyi gsal snang dang / ting nge 'dzin kyi spyod yul kyi gzugs na tshogasarde'abyung ste/ gtso bor mi rtog pa'i stobs las 'gyung gi dpyad pa'i skabasasu'agyung ba ni nyung ngo / /de ni sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ba dang/ rangabazhin rnam pa thams cad pa yin pa'i rtags su ngo sprad par bya'o/ /sgom tshulo— 160—

gnad kyi snying po de ltar bzung nas/ rnal 'byor gyi sa bzhi'am/ theg pa chen po'i thun mong ma yin pa'i bsam gtan bzhi'am/ rnal 'byor gyi sa lnga lasogs pa ji ltar rigs pa sbyar te bshad pas drang zhing / dngos gzhi'i skabasasu dpyad mthar mi rtog par 'jog pa dang / thog ma'i dus su dpyad pa byed cingaphyis mi rtog pa kho nar 'jog pa dang / thog ma nyid nas kyang mi rtog pa nyid la'ajug pa dang / sngags kyi theg pa dang go mthun du sgrub tshul sogs/ thams cad kyang gang zag so so'i blo dang bstun na legs par 'gyur ba sha stag go khen tuzab pa'i mdo sde 'di/ /rang blo'i stobs dang sbyar te spund/ /ha cang mang na rtogs dkar 'gyur/ /dka' 'grel tshul du mdo tsam bkrol/ /dgob 'i de yis sems can thams cad/ /sangs rgyas rtag pa'i go 'phangs thob gyur/ /de srid du yang legs bshad mang pos/ /phan bde phyogs kun khyab par gyuracig /ces bcom ldan 'das ma shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i snying po'i 'grel pa/ sngon med legs bshad ces bya ba 'di yang / rgyal khams/pa twar nā thas sbyar ba'o/ /mdo 'di la dri med bzhes gnyen gyi 'grel pa rgya 'grel yin nges bstan pa snga dar la 'gyur ba de dang / de la 'grel bshad rngog lo chen pos mdzad pa dang / de gnyis kyi dgongs 'grel klags chog ma/ ar byang chub ye shes kyisamadzad pa dang / bcom ldan 'das rig ral gyi tshig nyung la don bzang ba'i 'grel chung zhig dang / rong ston shākya rgyal mtshan gyi 'grel pa dang / mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan shākya mchog ldan gyi 'grel pa dang / bstan 'gyur du chug pa la/ro— 161 —

bo rjes mdzad zer ba'i 'grel pa legs po zhig dang / dz+nyā na mi rmi pa mdzad zerab dang / pra shwa sta gya nas mdzad zer ba dang / mahā dza nas mdzad zer ba rnamasakyang snang ngo / /phyi ma 'dis gzhan stong gi tshul du yang 'grel zhing/ de dag phalacher bshad sgros dri med bshes gnyen gyi 'grel chen dang phyogs mthun rung ngo / /gang ltar mkhas pa rnams kyi dpyad gzhin gyur pa'i 'grel pa de dgamathong zhing / gzhan yang rtse thang 'bum ram pa'i khyi ka sogs blo gsar ba'i rnamartog 'ga' re dang / bal po a su'i ngag sgros bstan 'gyur du chud pa thig dang/lce sgom ljong pas mdzad pa dang / gzhan yang bar skabs su byung ba'i phyagardzogs zhi byed kyi lugs su bkral ba sus byas mi shes pa sna tshogs dang /dngos grub dpal 'bar bas rang gi yon tan sgrog pa kho nar lhur blangs pa'i ṭika chung sogs phyis byung gi ston sgom du 'dod pa sna tshogs pas sbyar ba'i 'grel pa shob thag can 'ad wa mang po yang snang ngo / /'dir ni bi ma le'i ba ched pa sogs su bkod pa ma gtogs gzhan de dag gang gi yang rjes su ma 'brangs par/ rang blo'i stobs kyis spund pa'o/ /'o na paṇ+ḍita dang lotswa ba chen po dang / sde snod 'dzin pa'i dbang phyug rnams kyis bshad pa byas zin pa'i phyir/ khyod kyis 'dir rnam bshad byed mi dgos la/ de dag dang bshad sgrosamimathun par byed pa yang 'os pa ma yin te/ chen po dag gi gsung la gras btod pa ni smra kham ha cang ches so snyam na/ spyir gzhan la phan pa'i rgyur kho bos rnamabashad byed dgos pa ma yin pa dang / de dag bas bdag cag blo gros kyi stobasamachog tu gyur pa yang ma yin pa dang / de dag go bsod nams dang ye shes dang/— 162 —

tshul khrims kyi tsho gis la/ bdag cag gi myong yang skrun pa nus pa ma yin pa ni bden no/ /'on kyang rang gi blo gros goms pa'i phyir byed pa dang /tshes tsheb dag gis ni gzhung phra mo dag la che thang du ma mdzad pa yang snang zhing / blo grosachung bas kyang bsgrims pa na/ blo chen dag gis ma rnyed pa'i legs bshad tsirigs pa rnyed pa yang srid pa ni yin no/ /de dang gi yon tan la mchog tu gusapa dang / sku drin dran pa ni yod mod kyang / de dag des bshad pa gang la gnod byed gsal bar mthong ba dang / de dag gis ma bshad pa dag la yang rtagasadang rgyu mtshan tshad ma mthong ba'i nges shes skyes pa'i tshe/ rkyen gang gis kyangazlog par ma nus te 'di tsam zhig smra ba la nyes pa ci yang med do/ /bdag cana'aphags pa'i blo can ma yin pas 'khrul bar smras su zin kyang 'os yin cing /phyogs 'dzin tsam gyi chags sdang ma yin par nges pa nyid du nor bar shes na ni/kho bo cag gi bshad pa 'di yang ci bder spongs shig dang / bdag gi khrob dang 'khon pa'i sems bskyed par mi byed do ci ste lung rigs gsal zhing nges pa yod na kho bos kyang lan par bgyi'o/ /stod lungs rgya dmar ba chen po'i zhal na re/ ma rabs mtho sar phyin pa dag /gzhan gyis byas la bskyor 'byin bzhin/ /dam pa'i legs bshad spangs nas ni/ /gzhan du rnam 'jogamirigs mo/ /rnam dag yid tshes ma skyes pas/ /dbang med rnam dpyod 'edi ltararig /ces dang / rje btsun dam pa mkhas rnams kyi/ /ba ched dang mthu rangamu zhad kyang / /bram ze gtsang sbra kun spyod bzhin/ /rnam dpyod rtog go pa yi tshul/ /des na mkhas rnams mi mnyes med/ /bla ma dag gi drin yin mod/ /rang — 163 —

gi sbyangaX'i bzhi las kyang //rnam dpyod rtog spya sems la shar//dkyus/sabastan pa 'arta ba na she/she/༵she yul la kha she thub/sna/ngasanga' dbang med//skye ba bla din nar ldan rnams//phyags 'an spangs pa' yad kyas dpyod//skal ldan 'a la dga' cig pa skye//zhes spros myo~X/pa ltar bdagakyang smra ste/blun na shi po'i yi ba'o //mod kyi gag pas//dam pa snga gsungs rjesasu//'brang na —na yī bang mod //blo gros chung yang lted byed dā/ //skrubabyed tshad ma mthong ba 'a tshe//smra ba po de ches/ bzang yang //'gal brjesasna'ajug ma 'dod//yang 'a pa/zhe 'a khrobs smras na ༵nga//dam pa /ji thi5—bzod mdzad na//gus pa' ngas na ma btang bas/gi/ dgyes par lastir//dngos dang brgyud pa' slob ma la//gang — blo gros mchog skyesapa//'di yang de de'i drin yin ces//gus pa'i tshul ni nyams pa med//rgyal/ra tsho:/rde phar ge rwa tsho kar ge hwa tsho ri 7 ge tsho ge tsho ra tshopa 'a pa' blan pa mu ge//stabs rig bsad nams bla bzhi/nga//de /snalto' kyas ma go ba//zhang pa blun pos ga ge ges yod//de ba bdagabye'adar yang ste//spyo med zhwa/sa phrad gsar ba 'a phreng //blos rnams mgul rgyan 〉/rdo/na pa' la khrirang byos/gi//sa pa'ang smras te 'arabasha/da pa 'ad gag pur ma zad/bdag rdo bye / / sdu nye bar sbyar ba 'a bstan bcos gyar ci bka la rka ༷ni gos sdi//yang kha ga mu skad du/go brdzun du smra zir ma gyur bzhi pa 'di sa ma 'a pa' legs bshad mang du smrasas bya ba ྅dug na/khyed kya // ba ྅da rnams kya nang na/sngon gzhan/ sus kyangaslabashad pa' legs bshad gang yan/6/ yang ston dgos so zhe na/de la smras

pa/ spyir dam pa snga ma dag gis gtan nas ma bsha/da pa'i legs bshad kho bo la yod pa ma yin te/ de 'dra ba ni yod kyang ro mtshar mi che'o/ /'on kyang sheraphyin snying po'i mdo 'di'i steng du/ brjod bya'i don zab mo 'di dang 'di yod do zhes ston pa na/ mdo 'di'i 'grel byed sngar byung dag gis ma bshad pa ni rangadu yod do/ /de la thog mar 'di yin te/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i 'jig rten las 'das par bstod pa ni/ sher snying gi don 'grel khyad par can du 'dug pa la/ sngon chad de ltar yin pa'i kha skad tsam yang mi snang mod/ 'edirabastod pa des mdo 'di'i don legs par bshad de bkral ba ni sher snying gi 'grel pa sngon chad byung ba su la yang med cing ngo mtshar smad du byung ba'i legs spund dang po'o/ /bsdus don gyi gnas skabs su/ gzugs stong pa'o zhes sogs zab mo'i mtshan nyid brgyad po gnas lugs spros bral dmigs pa'i yul gtan la 'bebs byed du 'chad pa dang zab mo brgyad po stong nyid gsum dang sbyar te 'chad pa ni gnyis pa'o/ /stong pa nyid la gzugs med ces sogs mkhas parabya ba'i dngos po drug dang sbyar te/ gnas lugs de sgom pa'i tshul dang sbyor ba ni gsum pa'o/ /de lta bas na zhes sogs de ltar bsgoms pa'i phan yon ston pa rnams kyis/ sa lam gi rim pa rgyud la skye tshul 'chad pa ni bzhi pa zho /yangashugs bstan gyi dbang du byas nas/ stong pa nyid la gzugs med ces pa nasaphan yon gyi bar gyis/ bdag tu lta ba rnam pa bcu'i gnyen por/ gang zaganibadag med rgyas pa bstan pa'i tshul du 'chad pa ni lnga pa'o/ /mdo tshig dum bu — 165 —

brgyad du byas nas/ dngos po brgyad 'chad par sbyar ba na/ shin zhi tugs langa'agrigs par byung ba 'di ni drug pa'o/ /'di ni rigs pa dang yang mthun te/spros bral gyi stong nyid tsam ston pas/ mdo rgyas pa'i snying pa'i don 'dus pa'i phyir snying por 'jog na ni/ sum brgya pa la sogs pa yang ci'i phyir sher phyin gyisnying por mi 'gyur/ tshig nyung ba kho nas snying por 'gyur na ni/ 'di bas kyang yi ge gcig ma nyung ba'i phyir de la snying po tha snyad ci'i phyir mi sbyor/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mngon rtogs lam rim gyi gtso bo de/ dngos po bgyogakyirim pa 'di yin na/ sbas don gyi tshul gyis de 'dra mi ston na ni/ mdo thamasacad kyi snying po'i sgras brjod pa yang don med par 'gyur ro/ /de'i phyir waṃ ni sher phyin gyi yan lag tsam gyi mdo ma yin te/ don gyi lus yongs su rdzogs pa yang yin la/ rnam grangs kyi spros pa dor ba'i phyir snying po'o/ /yang semasabaskyed dang gdams ngag la sogs pa nyams len sgrub pa'i don gyi rnam grangs bco brgyad/ tshig don la shin tu gsal bar 'byor bar bshad de/ 'di yangasngon med pa'i legs bshad bdun pa'o/ /mdo 'dis stong nyid bcu drug ga5bco brgyad tshig zur gyis gsal bar thon pa li tshul dang sgom pa rnam g.yeng gi rnam rtog bcu'i gnyen por 'chad pa 'di yang sngon med pa'i legs par bshad pa brgyad pa'o/ /'dir dngos bstan dang sbas don gnyis ka 'chad pa las lhun mong rnams myongs gcig tu 'chad pa dang / thun mong ma yin pa rnams shosabastan la sbas don ma 'dres shing / dngos bstan dang sbas don dmigs phyed par 'chad pa 'di yang sngon med pa'i legs par bshad pa ste dgu pa'o/ /gleng— 166—

bslang ba'i skabs su/ phung lnga stong par sgom pa sher phyin la 'jug pa'i thabasasu bshad pas/ sher phyin dngos dang stong kyang mi gcig par bsgrub pa dang/stong nyid gzugs sogs zhes sogs dang / bri gang med pa'i tshig dang / stonganyid khyad gzhin byas nas 'dus byas bkag pa dang / bden par shes par bya ste/ zhes pa ste khyad par gyi tshig lngas/ dbu ma'i mthar thug gzhan stong dbu mchen po'i don gsal bar 'chad pa 'di ni bcu pa yin te/ de rnams kyi nang tshan las phye ba'i sngon med legs bshad kyi khyad par shin tu mang por 'gyur ro/ /de'i phyir 'di ni dge legs phun sum tshogs pa rab tu 'phel bar byed pa'o/ /zhes pa'ang kun dga' snying pos 'phros don du brjod pa zho /dge legasa'aphel// //— 167 —

rmad du byung ba bzhugs/she na mo kho ya/shes rib kyi pha rā ro rnal rdzo spe phyin : pa'i snying she maX na phyags tsam smoswā ༷ni/shes gtso bo ni dzo tu na pa cad kyi gnas lugala' kyang /ngas da dang ga ba na/(sa bya 'a cad sdo 'dis sherarde'ad 'a kya rnyi shes bde ge rje mu ge rtse rje po ge ge mu po de yin la/rib med pa'i yi rirasnron de' rang ban spros 'di sa /she/ltir lha ༷da po'i ma lnga gi sum po de mi rni /rmi sa mas cad 'a phyir snyi nyaX she/rded/ gya gshe ba gsum pa stan nga / shan tu nyung ngu' ra nga pa'// ltar ston zhen/med ce~Xpa la sogs pas spros she she dang /she pa zhes pa la jo gos pasa'agyu/ra shed dang /gzugs stang pa' zhes pa la sags pas rnam pa thamasacad pa 9 rdo/de /ras ra tsho rda sto/ste/ ra tshomad 'ad yil she /sheng phring ba she /gling ga thag sgo re shā/rjo dbab ༷ tshe snye 'i/she rang mngan droX bsngi ༷//dang ye ḍi/rdo she ༷nga /nasarba la po'iḥs she sa//she ༵ ri/she skad sbyisata/gnas rgyal pa khab sngi nang dhoXlha bya pa 1 nga ljad phuX pa la/stan ga rdo bcas sdod rngogorde'adun gyi tsho hūṃ/kya thub pa 'khar kho slang kā/thas dgra bcam sna da 'dun sa chen po dang / la 1 6 8 sna sa nas 'dus pa' byang chub/

sems dpa' 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rgya chen po dang / thabs cig pa lhan cig tu bzhugs shing / 'khor tshogs thams cad chos 'di'i snod du gyur cingargyud smin pa'i dus cig na/ chos sher phyin snying po'i tshig 'di skad ma norabar/ bsdud pa po phyag na rdo rje bdag gis thos so/ zhes gnas dus nges pa dang / 'khor tshogs dpang bor gzhag pas/ ston pa'i gsung du ces shesabaskyed cing / ngo mtshar ba'i dad pa bskyed pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa mdo sde chos 'byung ba'i sgo ni/ de'i tshe bcom ldan 'dasasogs so/ /rtogs par dka' bas na zab mo ste gnas lugs shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /de mngon sum rtogs pa'i ye shes ni snang bste/ tswamesu mthong ba'i don yin la/ ye shes de dang ldan pa'i mnyam gzhag ni tingange'adzin te/ bcom ldan 'das ting nge 'dzin de la rtag tu bzhugs pa yin kyang /der 'dus kyi gdul bya rnams kyi snang ba la/ zab mo snang ba'i ting nge 'dzin de la gsar du mnyam par gzhag pa ltar snang ngo / /yang bcom ldan 'das mnyam par gzhag ma thag pa de'i tshe/ byangachub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras 'gazags dbang phyug kyang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu byin pa zab mo mngon sum du rtogs shingaspyod pa'i ye shes/ ting nge 'dzin dang rjes su 'brel ba'i mnyam gzhag rnawapar lta ba stomakhyen pa'i ye shes la gnas pa dang / de 'dra ba'i sher phyin ladangos su spyod pa'i rgyu/ phung po lnga po rang bzhin gyi ngo bos ma grub cing stongapar/ ye shes kyis rnam par blta zhing sgom mo/ /phung po lnga po rang bzhin gyi —169spo

stong pa de nyid/ sher phyin zab mo las logs su bstan pag sher phyin zab mo ni rang gi ngo bos mi stong par grub pa'i phyir/ 'di ni gzhan stong dbu mgasal bar ston pa'i tshig dang po'o/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi sher phyin la gsar du mnyam par gzhag pa'i tshul bstan ma thag pa de nas zhes snga phyi 'tshams sbyor te/ gnyis pa don gtan la dbab pa la/ dril na gyi sgo nas gtan la phab pa dang / mthun 'gyur gyi sgo nas the tshom bsal ba'o/ /dang po la dris pa dang / lan bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ de nas sangs rgyas kyis mthus sogs te/ shā ri'i bu lasogs pa nyan thos rnams kyi rang stobs kyis chos zab mo 'di 'dri bar yang mi shes mod/ sangs rgyas kyi byin gyis brlabs pa'i mthu las/tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la 'di skad ces smras so/ /ci smras ce na rigs kyi bu skyes pa'am/ rigs kyi bu bud med yin yang rung ste/ gang su yang rba5ba la la dag byang chub tu sems bskyed nas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la/ thos bsam sgom gsum gyi sgo nas spyad pa spyod pa sto nyamasalen byed par 'dod pas/ sgom tshul ji ltar bslab par bya dgos zhesapa'o /gnyis pa lan la/ sher phyin la spyod tshul mdor bstan/ sher phyin gyi ngo bo rgyas par bshad/ de rtogs pa'i lam gyi phan yon bstan/ la5desartogs pa'i 'bras bu bshad/ phan yon dang bcas pa'i gzungs sngags—170—

bstan/ don bsdu'i tshul du sher phyin la slob par gdams pa zho /dang po ni/de skad sogs te/ shā ri'i bus de skad ces smras pa dang / de'i lan du byangachub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis/ shā ri'i bu la 'di skad ces smras so/ /ci skad ces zer na/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo spyad pa spyod par 'dod pa de/ tshul 'di ltar rnam par te shin tu lta zhingabasgom par bya'o/ /'dir spyad pa zhes pa ni/ spyad bya de las su bya ba'i tshigayin la/ spyod pa ni spyod tshul te/ byed pa'i tshig yin pas spyad bya sher phyin de la spyod lugs ji lta bu zhes pa ste/ nyams su blang bya sher phyin gang la/nyams su len pa'i thabs gang gis tshul ji ltar nyams len byed par 'dod la zhes pa'o/ /spyod pa'i ngo bo ni chos spyod bcu dang phar phyin drug la sogasapa'o/ /ji ltar rnam par lta bar bya ce na/ phung po lnga po de dag dang / gzhan yang khams dang skye mched la sogs pa'i dbye ba'i sgo nas kyang / snang gragasakyi chos de dag thams cad rang bzhin nam rang gi ngo bos ma grub pa'i tshul gyis ma nor ba yang dag pa'i gnas lugs la/ yul can sgom pa'i ye shesakyis kyang gnas lugs dang rjes su mthun par blta zhing sgom mo/ /gnyis pa sher phyin gyi ngo bo rgyas par 4zhad pa la/ rang bzhin sheraphyin gtan la dbab pa dang / lam sher phyin sgom pa'i tshul lko /dang po ni/gzugs stong pa'o sogs te/ bden gnyis thun mong du sbyar na/ da lta byas pa so so skye bo rnams la gzugs phung du snang ba'i gnas 'di na/ gzugs phung—171—

ni yod pa ma yin te/ gzugs de ni 'khrul snang tsam ma gtogs rang gothobos stong pa'i phyir ro/ /des na gzugs kyi rang ldog nas med cing ma yin pa'i stong pa'o/ /gzugs kyi shul na stong pa'i chos nyid gnas pa de nyid stongapa nyid khos de/ 'di ni bden cing yod pa dang zhi pa'i stong ṣ+ka do/ /gnas tshul la yod pa'i chos nyid stong pa nyid la byas pa so so'i skye bo rnams la gzugs phung du snang yang 'khrul snang tsam ma gtogs ngo bos med do /gzugs khyad gzhir byas na de las gzhan du chos dbyings stong nyid logs su gnas pa ma yin te/ gzu/gas snang 'char ba'i gnas de nyid chos dbyingasayin pa'i phyir dang / khyad gzhi gzugs phung nyid yod ma myong bas/phung gi chos nyid la tha dad du rang so 'dzugs pa'i rkya mi pher ba'i phyir dang /chos nyid kyi rig pa de yang spros bral yin pa'i phyir/ gzugs dang do sdo ba'i zla bo tha dad pa'i mashaṃ nyid mi 'dzin pa'i phyir ro/ /chos dbyings stong pa nyid de nyid khyad gzhir bzung na/ de las gzhan du gzugs yod pa ma yin te/ chos nyid gnas kyang gzugs phung med pa'i phyir dang / rgyu mtshan sngatsharnams kyis yang phyir ro/ /dper na mkhris nad can gyi dung la bltas na/gong bu dkar po 'khyil ba can du mi mthong gi ser bo 'khyil ba can du mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /mthong yang ser po 'khyil ba de ni 'khrul snang tsam tshagatogs gdod nas med la/ dkar po ni yod pas na gang la ser po snang ba 'a'ang ba dang dkar po gnyis gzhi tha dad med pa'i tshul gyi gcig pa la bsams nas/ ser por mthong ba de ni gzhan ma yin gyi dung ngo / /dung —172—

khyod kyis mthong ba'i ser po de'o//khyed kyis mthong ba'i ser po de lasagazhan dung med do//dung las gzhan du khyod kyis mthong ba'i ser po de grub pa ma yin no//zhes brjod pa lta bu yī te/don la shin tu lor rdo/rastong smra ba rnams kyi ltar na ni/stong pa la don dam gyis khyab par 'dod pagagazugs phung don dam bden par thal bar 'gyur la/stong pa nyid gzugasam yin gzugs las gzhan pa yang ma yin zhes brjod par 'thad kyi/gzugs stong pa'o//stong pa nyid gzugs so zhes pa 'di mi rung ngo //de ltar na 'di ni gzhan stong dbu ma chen po gsal bar ston pa'i tshig gnyis pa'o//'di ltar 'chad pa ni mdo 'di'i dngos bstan dgag tshig tu gsal ba ltar bstan pa yin la/sbas don ltar bshad na sgrub tshig kho na te/chos nyid don dam pa'i gzugs gang yin pa de ni stong pa nyid kyi ye shes so stong pa nyid kyi ye shes gang yin pa de chos nyid kyi gzugs su snang ngo //zhes bstan pas/de gnyis gzhi mthun pa yod pa tsam du go yang /stong pa'i ye shes don dam gyi gzugs ma yin pa yang srid/don dam gyi gzugs stong pa'i ye shesam yin pa yang srid snyam pa'i dogs pa dgag pa'i phyir/gzugs las kyangasogs so//de la skabs 'dir stong pa zhes pa stong rkyang ma yin te gnyisastong gi ye shes so//don dam pa'i gzugs phung ni gzugs phung ma yin mod/chos dbyings rnam pa thams cad pa'i nang gi gzugs phung gi rnam pa don dam pa de ni/chos nyid kyi gzugs phung pa5/don dam gyi tsogs phungazhes bya'o//de'i 'og ma rnams la yang rigs 'gre ste/de bzhin du tshor ba

dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa rnams stong pa sho /stong pa nyid tshor ba nas rnam par shes pa'i bar ro/ /tshor ba nas rnam parashes pa'i bar las stong pa nyid gzhan ma yin/ stong pa nyid las kyang tsor ba nas rnam par shes pa'i bar gzhan ma yon no/ /zhes sbyar ro/ /de lta bu'i stong pa nyid bshad pa'i mjug bsdu ba ni/ de lta bsan chos thams cad stong pa nyid de zhes pa ste/ ji skad du/ chos kyi dbyings ni mgatogs pa/ /gang phyir chos med de yi phyir/ /zhes rje btsun gyis gsungasapa'o/ /mawo nyid med pa zhes pa ni/ kun rdzob ni rang gi ngo bos stong pa'i phyir de dang de'i mtshan nyid med de/ bum pa bden par med pas bum pa'imatshan nyid kyang bden par med pa bzhin no/ /don dam ni rang gi ngo bos yod kyang / don dam gyi mawo nyid tswabazhin gyis ma grub ste/ mtshan mtsho ni gzhi gsum ni blos gzhag pa tsam yin gyi gnas lugs la med pas so/ /de bzhin du skye ba med pa'i phyir 'gag pa med ces bya ste/ skye med dang 'gag med 'di gnyis la yang snga ma dang 'dranyekun rdzob la ni snang ngo tsam du skye 'gag gi mtshan nyid yod kyang 'khrul snang tsam yin gyi/ kun rdzob nyid ye nas med na/ de la skye rgyu dang 'gag rgyu med pa'i phyir skye 'gag med la/ don dam ni rang gi ngo bos stong ba yod kyang/ de la skye 'gag nas gsum ma grub pas ma skyes shing ma 'gags pa'o/ /de ltar na/ stong pa ni 'dus byas kyi stongs pa'i don yin pas/ 'dus byas dang/mtshan nyid/ skye ba dang / 'gag pa rnams kun brtags tsam yin pas med —174—

par bstan la/ chos nyid ni kun brtags kyis stong pa'i don no/ /'dusabyas tsam kun brtags su byar mi rung ngo snyam na/ 'dus byas yin na kun brtags yin pas ma khyab kyang / 'du sa byas thams cad la kun brtags/kyi mtshan nyid 'jug pas khyab ste/ 'dus byas thams cad kyang mdor bsdun/yul dang yul can gnyis su zad do/ /yul can gyi steng na yul gzung ba las/ yul can nyid logs su tshugs thub pa ltar snang ba de ni kun brtagasayin pas shes pa thams cad la kun brtags de 'jug la/ shes pa lan/logs su yul gzung ba phyi don yod par snang yang / kun brtags yin zhingade nyid gzugs sogs yul dang / mig sogs dbang po thams cad la'ajug pa yin no/ /de dag las gzhan brtags yod kyi dngos po dang/dngos med thams cad ni kun brtags yin pa smos ma dgos te/ de'i phyira'adus byas thams cad la kun brtags kyi mtshan nyid 'jug pa yin no/ /des na gzhan dbang kun brtags kyi mtshan nyid can yin zhing / kun brtags kyang gzhan dbang gi mtshan nyid can no/ /yongs grub dngos ni de ltar ma yin kyang / yongs grub brtags pa ba yang de dag dang 'dra'o/ /da ni dkyus la 'jug par bya ste/ dri ma ni 'khor ba ste/ las nyon gyi dbang gis sdug bsngal sna tshogs 'byung bar snang ba'i dri ma 'khor ba yang rang gi ngo bos med la/ dri ma dang bral ba ni mya ngan las 'das pa ste/ lamabasgoms pas sgrib pa spangs nas byang chub thob pa yin na/ lam sgom pa yangabaden par med la sgrib pa rang bzhin med pa'i phyir/ sgrib pa dang bral bar—175—

snang ba yang blo'i 'char tshul tsam las ngo bos med do//yang dag pa'i sangasargyas bden par grub kyang /de thob par snang ba ni blo'i 'char tshul yin pagakun rdzob sgyu mo tsam mo//de ltar na/kun nas nyon mongs pa dang/rnam parabyang bar bya ba'i lam 'di dag ni/gzhan dbang yin la de ngo bos med parabastan pas/chos nyid la gzhan dbang gis ma gos shing /gzhan dbang rangagi ngo bos stongs par bstan to//don dam dbyings de la 'khor ba'i cwasaskabs na yon tan bri ba dang /myang 'das kyi gnas skabs na/sgrib pa spangs shing bri ba ltar snang yang 'khor ba pa dang rnal 'byor pa'i blo'i 'char tshul yin gyi/gnas tshul la bri ba med cing /'kho 3 ba'i dus na skyon gyisagang ba dang /myang 'das kyi dus na yon tan gyis gang bar snang ba yang/gong ma dang 'dra ste bden par ma grub bo//de'i rgyu mtshan sgrib pa yod nasam grub pa'i phyir dang /yon to gdod nas rang mas su gnas pa'i phyira'aphel 'grib tu snang ba ni log snang tsam mo//'dis ni don dam yo po sna grub la kun rdzob 'khor 'das kyis stongs par bstan cing /yongs grub don dawagyi ye shes de 'khor 'das kun khyab yin yang /'khor 'das so sos gos pa med la/de med pas 'phro 'gyur med pa'i phyir rtag par bstan ho/'de ni gzhan stong dbu ma gsal bar bstan pa'i tshig gsum pa'o//de ltar na/stong nyid dang /mtshan nyid med pa dang /ma skyes pa dang /tsha pa dang /dri ma med pa dang /dri bral med pa dang /grib med pa dang/gang ba med pa sde/zab mo mtshan nyid brgyaX ces/grags la/des na rang gzhin

sher phyin stong pa nyid kyi ye shes de/ stong nyid yin pa nas gang ba med pa'i bar du yin no/ /gnyis pa lam sher phyin sgom pa'i tshul ni/ mkhas par bya ba'i de ngosapo drug la slob pa'i dbang du byas nas/ dang po phung po la mkhas par bslab pa ni/ shā ri'i bu de lta bas na stong pa nyid la gzugs med ces bya bste/stong pa'i gzhi bde gshegs snying po don dam pa'i sems nyid/ yongs grusastong pa nyid chen po de la chos can glo bur gyi dri ma/ gzugs kyi phung po med/tshor ba'i phung po med/ 'du shes kyi phung po med/ 'du byed kyi phung por/rnam par shes pa'i phung po med do/ /de'i rgyu mtshan ni de lta bas na zhes pa sgestong pa nyid nas gang ba med pa'i bar du zab mo brgyad kyi rang bzhin gyi phyir ro/ khwa ri'i bu zhes bya ba ni bod pa'o/ /stong pa nyid la zhes pa'i tshig 'di ni/ ma thob pa yang med do zhesapa'i bar thams cad la sbyor rgyu ste thog ma'i gsal byed do/ /'di ni stong nyid kyi ye shes khyad gzhir byas nas/ de la kun rdzob kyi chos gang yang med paraston pa yin pas/ gzhan stong dbu ma chen po gsal bar ston pa'i tshig bzhi pa yin no/ /rang stong smra bar grags pa rnams kyi ltar na/ stong pa nyid lamed ces pa mi rung ste/ khyad gzhi stong nyid ma grub pa'i phyir/ de la khyad chosagazugs logs su 'gog pa nam du yang mi 'thad la/ rang stong pa'i stonganyid blo ngor grub zin la gzugs sogs 'gog na bkag zin 'gog par —177—

thal ba'i phyir ro/ /de rnams kyi ltar na/ gzugs med pa ni stong pa ṣ+ka do zhes/ mdo tshig bsgyur te 'don dgos so/ /gnyis pa skye mched la bslab pa ni/ stong nyid kyi ye shes de la/ rigagi skye mched med/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ rna ba med/ sna med/ lco med/ lusamed/ yid kyi skye mched med/ gzugs kyi skye mched med/ sgra med/dri med/ro med/ reg bya med/ chos kyi skye mched med do/ /gsum pa khams la mkhas par bslab pa ni/ stong nyid kyi ye shes de la/ mig gi khams med pa nas/ yid kyi khams kyi bar du med do/ /migagyikhams dang / rna ba/ sna/ lce/ lus/ yid kyi khams te drug dang / gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos kyi khams te drug dang / mig gi rnam shes/ rna ba'i rnatshashes/ sna'i rnam shes/ lce'i rnam shes/ lus kyi rnam shes/ yid kyi rnam parashes pa'i khams kyi bar du yang med pa'o/ /bzhi pa rten 'brel la mkhas par bslab pa ni/ stong pa nyid kyi yeshes la/ ma rig pa med pa nas/ rga shi'i bar du med de/ ma rig pa'i skrun lag med/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ 'du byed kyi yan lag dang/ rnam par shesapa dang / ming gzugs dang / skye ma rtsen dang / reg pa dang / tshor bdang/sred pa dang / len pa dang / srid pa dang / skyeb dang / na shi'i yan lag med cing / lam bsgo mes pas ma rig pa'i yan lag zad cing / she pa med pa dang / de bzhin du sbyar te/ 'du byed kyi yan lag 'gags pa med pa dang/rnam shes kyi yan lag 'gags pa dang / ming gzugs kyi yan lag 'gags —178—

pa dang / skye/mched drug gi yan lag 'gags pa dang / reg pa pa dang / tshor ba 'gags pa dang / sred pa 'gags pa dang / len pa 'gagasapa dang / srid pa 'gags pa dang / skye ba 'gags pa dang/ rga shi'i yan lag zad cing 'gags pa'i bar du yang med do/ /lnga pa bden pa la mkhas par bslab pa ni/ stong nyid kyi steng na phungakhams skye mched rten 'brel ma grub pa de bzhin du / stong nyid kyi ye shesalasdug bsngal bden pa thams cad dang / kun 'byung bden pa thams cad dang/'gogs bden gsar thob rnams dang / lam bden rnams ngo bos med do/ /de yang spang blang gi gzhi 'gog bden ni stong ṣ+ka yin la/ sa dorabyed pa'i bden pa bzhi car 'gog go /drug pa gnas dang gnas ma yin pa la mkhas par bslab pa gi lha zhebapa nyid kyi ye shes la/ lam gyis bsdus pa'i ye shes med cing / des ngesapar 'byung ba yang med/ dngos po rnams kyi rgyu 'a 'bras kya gnas skabs sosothob par 'gyur ba yang med la/ rgyu min las 'bras bu'i gnas skabasamathob pa yang med do/ /de dag thams cad kyi don gyi mdo 'di ltar gas ste/'khor ba'i sems can rnams dang / lam sgom pa po thams cad la/chosadabyings de gzugs sogs gzhi'i chos kyi 'khrul ba dang / lam dang 'busabu'i chos kyi snang ba sna tshogs su shar zhing / gnas lugs de'i rang gzugasasu ma mthong la/ des na gzhi lam gyi snang ba de dag thams cad med bzhin du stesnang ba yin pa'i phyir/ thos bsam gyi dus su de ltar gtan la phab nag—179—

sgom pas gzugs phung nas ma thob pa'i bar gyi chos thams cad rig pa'i ngo bor rang sangs su btang ste/ rang bzhin stong nyid kyi ye shes de la mnyamopar 'jog dgos par bstan to/ /ngo bo nyid med gsum du 'chad pa dang 'di gnad gcig pas/gsum du bshad pa'i grub don la'ang don dam dbyings yang dag par gnas pa de/ glo bur kun rdzob kyis stongs pa tsam kho na ཿnga ba'i phyir ro/ /des na kha cig bsha/da tshul de gnyas 'gal bar sems pa ni/ ma go ba yus che ba'i tshul lo/ /de ltar drug las phung khams skyed mched gsum la bslab pas ni/chos thams cad kyi mtshan nyid la mkhas par 'gyur la/ rten 'brel dpabaden bzhi la bslab pas blang dor 'jug ldog la mkhas shing / gnas dngaganas ma yin pa la bslab pas rgyu rkyen 'bras bu la mkhas par 'gyu/ra ba yin no/ /gsum pa de rtogs pa'i lam gyi phan yon ni/ de lta bas na/ byang chub sems dpa' sogs so/ /thob pa med pa'i phyir zhes pa mtha'i gsal byed de/gzugs med ces pa tshun chad thams cad la snyeg par mngon la/ gtso bo rdethob pa smos pa ni/ gnas lugs la skyed byed rgyus bskyed bya 'bras bu bskyed du rung ba dang mi rung ba gang yang ma grub ces par gzhan rnams kyang 'dus par dgongs so/ /des na 'di ltar gzugs nas ma thob pa'i bar gang yangadangos lo gnas tshul la ma grub pa ltar/ theg chen pa rnams kyis sgo5dgos pa de lta bas na/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mnyam gzhag ye —180—

shes kyi rang ngo la/ rgyu dang 'bras bu'i dngos po bya byed dang bcas pa gdod nas ma grub pa'i phyir/ 'khrul ngor rang sems la shar ba'i sgrib gnyis bgachags dang bcas pa yang / gshis la gdod nas med cing / 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal dang las nyon gyis skrag cing / 'jigs pa yang gshis la nams yangamed pas/ med pa mngon sum du rtogs pa na/ gzung 'dzin zhabrul pa phyin tsilog gi snang ba rnams rim pas spangs pas/ mthar 'khru/la ba thams cad las shin tu 'das nas/ mya ngan las 'das pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go'aphang gi mthar phyin cing reg par 'gyur ro/ /phyin ci log las rim pasa'adas tshul ni/ mos spyod kyi sa dang / 'phags pa'i sa bcu'i ri༅pas/mthar rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi bar ro/ /bzhi pa lam des thob pa'i 'bras bu mngon du 'gyur tshul ni/ dusagasum sogs te/ dus gsum du mngon par bzhugs pa ste sngon byung ba dang/da ltar bzhugs pa dang / ma 'ongs pa na 'byon 'gyur gyi sangs rgyas thamasacad kyang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo mtshan nyid brgyad dang ldan pa 'di nyid la brten nas/ mkhas pa'i tshul drug gis bsgoms pas blan med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgyas zin pa dang / sangasargya bar 'gyur ro/ /de dag thams cad kyi dngos bstan la chos kyi bdag med kho na gsungs te/ gang zag gi bdag med ni de'i shugs la 'gyung b.radagongs so/ /'on kyang gang zag gi bdag med byang chub sems dpasamisgom pa ltar gsungs pa ni/ dgag gzhi phung po yod par byas nas/ de'i steng —181—

du nga bdag med par sgom pa'i gang zag gi bdag med sgom tshul de 'dra mi byed ces pa'i don yin gyi/ spros bral gyi rnam pa can gyi gang zag go bdagamed ni rgyal sras rnams kyis bsgom bya kho na'o/ /gnas tshul la nga bdagagang yang ma grub pa ni/ gang zag gi bdag med yin la/ gnas tshul la snangagrags kyi shes bya gang yang yod ma myong ba ni chos kyi bdag med yin pas/snga ma phyi ma'i nang du 'dus pa'i phyir/ chos kyi bdag med bsgoms pas gangazag gi bdag med sgom par shugs la 'grub bo/ /lnga pa phan yon dang bcas pa'i gas pa sngags bstan pa ni/ de ltabasan shes rab kyi sogs te/ mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa de ltabasan/ rang bzhin shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi snang cha la/ rig sngags byung ste/ chos sku'i rgyu mthun pa zho /sngags de'i tshe ba ni/ 'dod pa'i don dang las thams cad 'grub par byed pa'i phyir/rig pa chen po'i gsang sngags yin la/ sngags kyi ngo bo 'jig rten thamasacad la 'das shing / theg pa dman pa zil gyi gnon pas/ blan med pa'i yeshes nyid rig sngags kyi rnam par shar ba dang / 'di yis 'dod pa'i lasagazhan byed pa lta smos kyang ci dgos/ rang don du mi mnyam pa dang snyam pa ste/ srid zhi gnyis la 'gran zla dang bral ba'i sangs rgyas kyang thob par byed pa'i sngags so/ /gzhan don du sems can gyi sdug bsngal thams cad rabatuzhi bar byed pa'i sngags kyang yin no/ /chos kyi sku bslu ba med pa'i phyir rdzun pa ma yin zhing / rang gi ngo bo mi 'gyur zhing rtag pas na bden par grus pa —182—

ste/ sngags 'di yang chos sku de dang ngo bo gcig pa'i phyir/ mi bslu zhingamirdzun pas na/ bden par shes par bya ste/ zhes pa'i don yin la/ 'di gzhan stong dbu ma chen po gsal bar ston pa tshig lnga pa yin no/ /sher phyin gyi rig sngags dngos ni/ sangs rgyas kyi thugs rgyud labazhugs pa de yin pas chos sku dngos dang bden grub dngos yin zhing / slob pa rnams dang so so skye bo rnams kyi ngag dang yid ngor snang ba de ni/ de 'dradangos ma yin kyang / de thob byed kyi rgyu yin pas 'bras bu thob pa la mi bsluba'i bden pa ni yin no/ /'on kyang rgyal bas gsungs pa'i rig sngags 'di lta bu dag so so skye bo lam ma zhugs kyi blo la shar ba tshun chad kyang / yongasagrub tu gtogs shing zag med yin par gsungs so/ /phan yon de dang ldan pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sngags 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang pos smras shing bshad pa ni/ ta du thā/ zhes pa ni 'di lta ste/ ga te ni gshegs shing rtogs pa/ lan gnyis 'byung pa ni kun rdzob rtogs pa dang / don dam rtogs pa'o/ /pa ra ni mchogs khas lugs/ga te rtogs pa/ yang pa ra mchog sam ni yang dag pa/ ga te rtogs pa/ bo dhi ni byang chub ste bden pa gnyis kyi gnas lugs phyin ci ma log par rtogs pa'i ye shes/ byang chub ste chos dbyings dang ro cig par gyur pa zhesapa'o/ /swāhā ni gzhi tshugs shig pa ste/ sngags kyi mtha' 'grub par byed pa'o/ / drug pa don bsdu'i tshul du sher phyin la slob par gdams pa ni/ shā 183—

ri'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sogs te/ shā ri'i bu zhes bos nas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis mkhas tshul drug la sogs pa de lta bu'i sgo nas/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo mtshan nyid bgyod ldan la bslab par bya'o/ /gnyis pa mthun 'gyur gyi sgo nas the tshom bsal ba ni/ de nas bcom ldan 'das sogs te/ de ltar bshad pū'i rjes de nas/ bcom ldan 'dasazab mo snang ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin de las bzhengs pa'i tshul bstan te/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la legs so zhes bya ba byin nas/ ces mdor bstan la/ ji skad du/ ngo mtshar ba dang rtsod pa dang/ khrodang zhum dang nges bzung dang/ /dga' dang dad pa dag las ni/ /tshig gcig lan gnyis/ 'byung ba yin/ /zhes pa ltar/ rab tu dgyes pas legs so legs so rigs kyi bu zhes spyan rasagazigs la bos nas/ khyod kyi bshad pa de ni ma nor ba de khon bzhin no/ /de ni de kho na bzhin yin te de'i rgyu mashaṃ gyis ji ltar spyan rasagazigs khyod kyis bstan pa de bzhin du/ shā ri'i bu la sogs pa der 'dusakyi 'khor khyed rnams sa kyang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab rmolamakhas pa drug la sogs pa'i sgo nas spyod tshul de ltar spyad par bya dgongs te/ spyan ras gzigs kyis bshad pa 'di dang / 'khor gzhan rnams kyis de dang mthun par bsgrub pa 'di la/ da ltar bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa bdag gis yi rang mdzad par ma zad/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa —184—

rnams thams cad kyis kyang rjes su yi rang bar mdzad do/ /zhes ston pa shākya seng ges dpal gyi mgur las gsungs so/ /rtsa ba'i gsum pa yi rang mngon par bstod pa ni/ bcom ldan 'dasakyis de skad ces sogs te/ 'khor rnams sngar spyan ras gzigs kyisabastan pa 'di las lhag pa'i sher phyin gyi don zhig kyang yod dam snyam du thetshom dang bcas pa las/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal snga nas phyogs bcu sangs rgyas kun gyis bstan kyang sher phyin gyi don de kho na bzhin yin te gzhan du ma yin no zhes bka' stsal pa dang / drib byed pa shā ri'i bu dang /lan ldon pa byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa sbyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang / thams cad dang ldan pa ni thams cad yod pa ste/ yul tha dad pa dang / rigs tha dad pa dang / 'gro ba thad da pa dang/gzugs tha dad pa dang / longs spyod tha dad pa dang / skad rigs thad da pa la sogs pa thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de dag yi rang zhes pa go /thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de'i gtso bo dang / phal ba'i khyad par sposan/ nam mkha' la spyod pa'i lha dang / sa steng na spyod pa'i mi dang/ sa 'og na spyod pa'i lha ma yin dang / gnas gsum na spyod pa'i dri za ste/ gtso tsheb bzhipo de dag smos pa'i 'jig rten phal pa'i 'khor dpag tu med pa rnams dga' zhing mgu la yi rang ste/ spyan ras gzigs kyis bshad pa dang mthun par bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa de la/ yid brton cing mngon parabastod de/ ched cher 'dzin pa dang nges bzung du byed do/ /de la de bzhin —185—

spugasa~X sa mthun 'a rdo bzhin ri mi gsungs na ni/'bor rnams kyangaya dam rum bza//'a yang bdag dri bsta/ral/gdul bya gzhan snangadang bstun nas shā 'a bu yang bdag gi ba skabs su ma bab ḍiX/ snyam pa srid /spyan ras ༷zaXsta kyang bdag sa lan legasaparda ༷/ stana~X ba khardoso'i snyam du zhum zhang dgas pa dang tha ri re 'gyur na/'a pas 'idri~Xmathun 'gyu/ra bka' stsal pas/shā rge ge ge sde sde yig shad da/rang nyad kya ni dri ga~X pas kro' ba dang no/dzad ༷rde spyan rwas gzags ga rang lan gas ying smi thing the tsho~X' pas / pa ga'i nga tshim nga/༷ltara~Xdi rnams sdo dir da shang di ni 'a sku pas/ra pa'i myo pa thab pan na//yang 'ar mdo / zab mo 'a na zha/ḍi res bar pa mdor gtogs pa yin na/ge ge' da~Xm ba med pa gzi so//zhes dang /de ston na b.rage shes sang ce la she rdob she she ur ra//'a she ba byed pa dag byungastong gi dba~Xn ci shā/wa bzag she la gsum car gya dgangs dro yang gzhan stang she dbu spra rjo ci ri /dang pa /dā baX ba kau kyang sgras zan la gsornobardu she pa' sa she she pa 'a da//dan dam rnam zhes nges pa zhabar la spege rje ge ru ra/zhabar la dang bar gnyas ka las ches gsal zhang she zi sbangs shang she du phyung mu/par yang 'byurdo nga zhi she/ga bar go cho/rdel gsum la mchag dman gya khyad par yang 'khyu/nga nga /dgangs pa pa yang yin pas skyon de gnyis med do//de bsan mdo 'di'i dngos lha rang tsho ra tsho :de si dzo0ri ge tsho skyo sku/la/gzhan stang thun mang pa sgro 1 6 / bar stan zhang /thun mang ma kyi pan pa

bde bar gshe/gas pa' nga po'i don/rtag brtan g.yung drung rnam pa thamasardecad pa de sbas don gyi tshul gyis 'chad pa yi no//sher phyin snying i 6snyo rdelbo ngeb/rderde ༷tre/ 0rirdeshe gci rmad du dge ༵ 'ad sding /rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas smrasapa'//gag zhus/da gas sne 1 8 ////

cher 'grel pa 'phags mchog rnams kyi gsang ba'i mdzod ces bya ba bzhugs so/oṃ swā sti/ 'phags pa bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam gyi rgyal po'i rgya chera'agrel pa 'phags mchog rnams kyi gsang ba'i mdzod ces bya ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa dang 'phags pa kun tu bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'phags pa bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam gyi rgyal po'i don cung zad bshad par bya ste/ de la 'di ni byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam thams cad yongs su 'dus pa smon lam gyi mdo chen po yin pa'i phyir/ tshigs bcad waṃ nyid logs su phyung ba mdo sde rang rkang tshugs pa zhig tu yang 'gyur la/ spyir ni 'phags pa sangs rgyas phal po che las/ 'phags pa sdong pos brgyan pa'am/'phags pa sdong po bkod pa'i mdo zhes bya ba/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rab 'byams mtha' yas ston pa zhig ste/ dam tshig gsum bkod kyi rtog pa las/ theg pa chen po'i mdo sde mchog tu bsngags so/ /mdo sde de nyid kyi slas/gi cha la gnas pa las smon lam 'di phyung ba'o/ /logs su bzhugs pa lamado sde rang rkang tshugs par 'gyur ba dang / tshig de nyid mdo sde rgyas pa gzhan gyinang na yod pa yang mi 'gal te/ 'phags pa tshigs bcad gcig pa dang/'phags pa rten 'brel snying po dang / sher phyin brgya lnga bcu pa dang/ sgo nyer lnga —188—

pa la sogs pa mdo rgyud du mar snang ba bzhin no/ /de yang spyir sdong po bkod pa yongs rdzogs kyi dbang du byas na ni 'byam klas pa zhig yod pa las/ dengasanga'adzam bu'i gling du spyod pa 'di ni/ nor bzang gis dge ba'i gshes gnyen bsten tshul phyogs gcig pa ste/ 'on kyang 'di kho na'i don tsam yang gzhal b.radaka'o/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dag pa'i salaganas nges pa zhig tshong dpon gyi khye'u'i tshul bzung ba/ nor bzang zhes bya ba zhig gis/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal nas 'byams pa 'a bar gyi dge ba'i bshesaganyen bsten te/ mthar dpag tshad brgya rtsa bcu'i pha rol nas 'jam dpalagyis phyag brkyang ba/ grong khyer yid bde ba mngon du gyur pa zhes bya ba na nor bzang yod pa'i spyi bor bzhag stogo du brjod pa mdzad do/ /de nas tshong dgo gyi bu nor bzang ye shes kyi spyod yul mtha' yas pa thob pa/ 'jam dpal gyi byin rlabs kyis kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa'i dkyil 'khor la 'jug nus par byin gyis brlabs shing / rdo rje rin po che pad+ma'i gdan la bzhag sto de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi seng ge'i khri la mngon du phyogs par 'dug go /de nas byang chul sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa kun tubazang po mthong bar 'gyur ba'i ltas ngo mtshar mtha' yas pa bcu tshan gnyis nor bzang gis mthong ngo / /de nas 'phags pa kun tu bzang po nyid mthong na thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob pa dang 'dra bar sems pa las/ skad cig de nyid la ye shes mtha' yas pa 'phel bar gyur te/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snangamadzad kyang mngon sum du mthong / de'i spyan snga na byang chub sems dpa'i gobor—189—

gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad kyang mthong ngo /de nas byang chub sems dpa' ca tu bzang po de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang mnyam pa nyid rjes su thob pa de yang rin r+pā pad+ma'i khri la bzhugs pa mthong ste/de'i ba sbu'i khung bu rerenas kyang 'jig rten gyi khams thams ༷da kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi 'od zer gyi sprin mang po thon 'a/nam mkha' 'a gsags pa snaX bar te byas te/sems can thams cad kya sdug bsngal rab tu zha bar byed pa la sags pa rnam par thar pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i cho 'phrul chen po nyi shu lhag cig mthong ngo //de nas nor 'a yid dga' ba dang bde ba skyes nas/(phyogs pa smra tu bzang po'i sku lus kya cha shas rnam par phye nas/mthar ba sbu' khung bu gas /la yang /dbus su mi mjed 'jig rten gyi khams dang bcas pa'i phyogs bcurab 'byams mu med pa'i 'jig rten sdi ga pa'i rnga bkid pa mtha' dag dang de dag kyang /'a5pa chags pa dang 'ag pa bar gya tshul rnams ma lus pa/spru/zwa / gas brnyan 'a snang na 'dod tha1rdo/ 1sdo //sa 'as skabs 'a na 'dod pa khamasa~X/ yul mu bcas/gzugs kya ༷zhi/sakya yul dang bcas/gzugs med pa khams kya yul dang bcas/ dngabacas/rten dang bcas/dbyibs dang bcas/zhes 'byung zhing/gzhan yangaphal po che 'dir/gzugs med khams la snod kyi 'jig rten yod pa'i tshigasashāsnoyang dang yang du 'byung bas/gzugs med ces pa dman pa la dgag pasgra'o//kun tu bzang po de'i mawo bzang po re re la yang sngon gyi mtha' chubathug pa'i bar gyi 'jig rten gyi khamasaXms cad dang /sangs rgyas rnams dang
