bskal pa'am bskal pa mang po 'khyongs par yang byed do/ /de ltar na dusathams cad mnyam pa nyid du rtogs pa'i ye shes kyis/ dus ring thung dbye ba med par spyod pa ste/ 'di'i dgos pa ni skad cig la yang mtha' yas pa'i byed longayod la/ bskal pa la yang yun ring bsgug mi dgos pa'i phyir te/ dus thudangul bya ba rgya chen po mi 'grub par dogs pas/ blo tsab tsobo tu 'gyur ba dang/ rgyachen po la yun ring thogs pas ngal zhing skyo bar 'gyur ba'i gnyen po'o/ /gsum pa ni/ dus gsum gshe/gas pa mi yi seng ge gang / /de dag skad cig gcig la bdag gis blta/ /dus gsum du byung zhing gshe/gas pa'i mi'iseng ge bcom ldan 'das gang yin pa de dag thams cad skad cig gcig la dus gcig tu/ lus pa med par bdag gis mngon sum du lta zhing/ dus kyangathung ngu ma yin par rtag tu blta bar bgyi'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ rtag tu de dag gi ni spyod yul la/ /sgyu mar gyur pa'i rnamathar stobs kyis 'jug /rtag tu sangs rgyas de dag gi ni spyod yul te/rtagasabya'i yul dang rtogs byed kyi ye shes dang / de dag gi rnam par thar ba dang/ rdzu'aphrul gyi rnam par 'phrul ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa la 'jug par gyur cigatshul ji lta bus 'jug na/ mnyam bzhag gi ye shes bde bar gshe/gas pa'i snyingapo spros bral rnam pa thams cad pa sgyu ma lta bu'i ye shes mngon sum du rtogs pa'i nus pas/ rjes thob kyi ye shes sgyu ma ltan snang bar gyur la de lta bu'i tingange 'dzin gyi stobs las/ sgrib pa'i khyad par mang po las grol zhing rnam parathar ba'i stobs kyis gang la gang 'dod du sgyur thub cing spyod pa'i tshul gyis—244—

so/ /'di ni don la nges par na sangs rgyas dang 'phrin ltas mnyam por spyod pa'i don no/ /lnga pa ni/ gang yang dus gsum dag gi zhing bkod pa/ /de dag byo5gcig steng du mngon par sgrub/ /de ltar ma lus phyogs rnams thams cad du/ /rgyal ba dag gi zhing rnams bkod la 'jug /gang yang dus gsu༅du byungazin dang 'byung ba dang 'byung 'gyur dag gi sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi bkod pa de dag thams cad/ mos pa dang / stson lam dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi stobs kyis/ rdul phra rab gcig gi steng ste go sa sa mngon par sgrub cing / rdul gcig po de lasgrub pa ltar/ ma lus pa'i phyogs rnams thams cad du/ rdul mtha' dag la rgyal ba dag gi zhing rnams sgrub cing bkod pa yid du 'ong ba dang / rgyan gyi khyad pararnam pa thams cad pa la 'jug par gyur cig pa ste/ skabs 'di'i 'jug pa zhes pa ni/ zhing khams de lta bu ston nus pa'i bya ba la 'jug pa zho /rdas gcig la dus gsum gyi zhing khams mtha' dag ston pa ni gzhi phra shos dang bkod pa rgya che shos kyi ya mtha' nas bzung ba yin pas/ spyir bkod pa yang/ rdu wagasapa'i bkod pa nas brtsams te dus gsum gyi zhing gi bar du sna tshogs par ston to/ /des mtshon te rim pa bzhin du sbyar nas/ nyi zer rdul re re la yang dusagasum gyi zhing khams la sogs pa de ltar ston pa dang / bye ma'i 'bru re re 'am/sbu nyag re re'am/ 'bras la sogs pa 'bru re re'am/ rtswa re re'am shing gel ba re re'am/ lo ma re re'am/ me tog re re'am/ 'bras bu re re'am/ khyimarere'am/ de bzhin tu sbyar te/ rgyang grags re re'am/ dpag tshad re re'am/ ri bo —245—

re re'am/ grong khyer re re'am/ gling re re'am/ 'jig rten gyi khams re re'am/stong gsum re re la sogs pa'i bar du yang de ltar ston la/ so so so sor ra mnyam pa la yang / 'jig rten gyi khams gcig la go sa tha mi dad par/ 'i segarten gyi khams tha dad pa yang tshad mnyam pa du ma gcig shul du gcig ston la/gzhi tshad chen po la chung ngus khyab pa yang dpag tu med pa ston te/ stong gsukhogacig gling bzhi pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams gcig gis khyab pa dang / womo bu gling gcig gis khyab pa dang / 1kha ri khyer gcig gis khyab pa dang/ lus gag gis khyab pa dang / skra gcig gis khyab pa dang / rdul phran gcig gis/khyab pa'i bar du yang ston to/ /yang rdul phran gzhan gcig gi nang du chud pa de nyid kyigagazhan stong gsum mang po yang non pa dang / gzhan du dus kyang nges pa med paraston te 'das pa yang ma 'ongs ba dang ma 'ongs pa yang 'das par sgyur ba la sogs pa rnam par 'phrul ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa kho na 'byud ba'o/ /drug pa ni/ gang yang ma byon 'jig rten sgron me rnams/ /de dag rimapar 'tshang rgya 'khor lo bskor/ /mya ngan 'das pa rab tu zhi mtha' ston/ /mgon po kun gyi drung du bdag mchi'o/ /gang yang ma byon pa'i sangs rgyasa'ajig rten snang bar byed pa'i sgron me de dag rnams/ rang rang gi mdzad pa'i rim pa mtha' dag ston pa rnams ma 'khrugs par spyod de/ sangs rgyab dang/chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang / mya ngan las 'das pa sdug bsngal rab zhi tu ba'i mtha' thob pa'i tshul ston par mdzad pa'i/ mgon po sangs rgyas de dgakun gyi drung du bdag dus gcig tu mchi ba ste/ 'gro zhing bslebs la phyin par—246—

bgyi'o//'a smon pa shes zhe rgya ba sogs mdzad pa ge sgo dra 'a rme'u/ pa ste/sangs ci zhi shā ༷da ce pa stan she gnas skabs thams da rdad du dar she par byas sprus/ byad namaX pa mu she /rdzu spre'i sbra dri ba/la kau pa dang za|bstan pasa' /kyi dpung ro 'a ba pe yi sags ༷/mdar na tsarnya/rgyas kya maX pa she cad dpung rags mu bsan la/dan la nim gsar du mngan par rdzags par sangs rgyas zan gya dbang du byas na /mdzad pa 'phrin las gcig pa khon ra 'gyu/ra zhing /sa bcu pa nyid la gnas pa'irga ri yi ri de)stisnyen 'a yan na yaX /sangs rgyas kyas 'dul ba mi rdzungs rgyas su gyur sangasargyus kya mdzad 'cha da she /sangs rgya~X su she stan yang /4lo rgyas gas rgyas mdzad pa~X las byad pa par ༷phyung ba na na/tshe/ yi sagā ba gsum pa/ge sde mu ༷nga dang thun slang ma ma skab pa gtsoXkar tsholag/ zhes/snga grangs gzhan gya she la~X ༷stan pa la/sgrub pu mi khyaba~X ltir pa stabs kya sman ga rna/phan yana~X bar ka rdo tse : pa ka no bsam ste khyab sman lam tung /spyar thug sman lam bla na / ༵༷ gag tu bya bshe/gsu5༷snardedang pa la/ge zla ri bcu baX/da pa dang/ rdzo~Xtheg/ṭāX//kun tu myur ba 'a rdzu 'phrul pa ge tsho stabs ge rdzo/yi pa sgyu/ye //kun nas sga ga pa stabasarnams dang //kau sri yan to spyad pa ge ba'i she //she tu khyag parabyams pa dag stabs//kun 'i ye the she sa rab thabs dpa | ༵/'dzi //chags she pa gis gyur ba ༷ (/sa stabs/khres rab bas/r+sha'an stabs dag sa//byang chub /bas rnams yang dag sgrub par //

mchod pa dang / chos ston pa dang / sems can gyi don du/ mtshan med pa'i zhingakhams rnams kyang skad cig gis bgrod nus shing / zhing tha dad par du mar yangadus gcig car bgrod thub pas kun tu myur ba'i rdzu 'phrul gyi stobs rnams dang / kun nas sgo zhes bya ba ni/ sgo kun dang ldan pa'i don te thabs tshuthagyis rim pa mtha' yas pa'i sgo nas/ sems can gyi don spyod pa dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed ni/ de la brten nas bla na med pa'i byang chub tu bgrod nus pa'i phyir/ bzhon pa dang 'dra bas theg pa'i stobs te de rnams dang / pha rol tu phyin pa dang bsdu dngos bzhi dang tshad med bzhi la sogs pa/ yon tan du ma dang 'grogs pa'i snyoms 'jug dgu dang zad par bcu dang / zil gnon bgyod dang / mngon shes drug la sogs pa yon tan kun tu spyod pa'i stobs rnamasadang / kun nas sems can thams cad la nye ring med par khyab pa'i byams pa la sogs pa tshad med bzhi po dag gi stobs dang kun tu sems can thams cad la phan pa dang bde ba byed pa'i phyir/ rab tu dge ba'i sbyin sogs bsod namasakyi stobs rnams dang / dus gsum gyi dngos po thams cad la chags thogasamed par 'jug pa'i mngon par mkhyen pa/ ye shes kyi stobs dang /chosadabyings ji lta ba bzhin rtogs pa'i shes rab kyi stobs dang / gzhan don sgrub pa la mkhas pa thabs mkhas kyi stobs/dang / dmigs pa la rtse gcig pa gad zhig mngon shes dang rnam 'phrul la sogs pa yon tan bskyed pa'i rgyu/ dpa' bar 'gro ba la sogs pa ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs te/ stobs dgu po de dag gi sgo nas 'bad pas/ byang chub kyi stobs te bla na med pa'i byang chub 'phral du thob —248—

par byed pa'i ye shes kyi khyad par/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi ye shes nyid dngarnam pa mthun cing rgya khyon mtshungs pa'i lam gyi bden pa ni/ byang chub kyi stobasayin la/ de yang rnam pa mtha' yas pa 'dzin pa'i phyir/ rnams zhes rang po'i rgyosmos te/ de rnams yang dag par sgrub par byed par shog cig pa go /'dirabashad pa'i stobs 'di rnams/ 'phags pa dkon mchog sprin dang phal po lce'i skabs gzhan las 'byung ba ltar gyi byang chub sems dpa'i stobs bcu dang phal cher 'dra bar snang ste/ ji ltar zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa'i stobs bcuthibasam pa lhag bsam spyor ba dang / shes rab smon lam spyod pa dang/ theg pa rnam 'phrul byang chub dang / chos 'khor bskor ba'i stobs rnams go /'dirashes rab kyi stobs dang / byang chub kyi stobs dang / spyod pa'i stobs dang / theg pa'i stobs ni dngos su gsal la/ rnam par 'phrul pa'i stobs ni rdzu wa tsho/dang bsam pa'i stobs ni byams pa dang lhag pa'i bsam pa'i stobs ni ye shes dang / sbyor ba'i stobs ni bsod nams kyi stobs dang / thabs stobs gocogapo'i nang tshan nas gtso bo khyad par can legs su phye ba ni smon lam gyi stobs dang / chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i stobs gnyis so/ /de bas na gzhungarabashad pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs lhag pa ltar byung yang spyod pa dang / lhagabasam du 'dus par mngon no/ /gnyis pa stobs kyi byed las ni/ las kyi stobs rnams yongs su dgabyed cing / /nyon mongs stobs rnams kun tu pham par byed/ /bdud kyi stobasarnams stobs med rab byed cing / /bzang po spyod pa'i stobs ni rdzogs par—249—

bgyi//de la spangs par bya ba'i las ni/khams gsum po spyod par byed pa ste/las dngos dang/las rjes su mthun pa'o//la~Xdangos kyang mi dgo/dzhai ga tsherdedang /zag bcas kyi dge ba'o//zag bcas dge ba de yang ———teg/'dod khams kyis bsdus pa'i dge ba bsod nams dang /khams gong ma gnyisardekyis bsdus pa'i dge ba mi g.yo ba'i las so//rjes su mthun pa'i las ni/las rnams kyis bzhag pa'i bag chags gang yin pa ste/de lta bu'i las kyi ke tsho sdo nge :destabs 'a yongs su dag par zhes nga /nyon mongs pa /'i rngamachog thesashe tu ma zha bar rjog ༷ dang rang nyad la rim ri par byed pa /༵ rtog ste/min tha chal/sa dang //pa khra dang /nga rgyal dang ma ga pa dang /the sto lta ba na pa lnga dang /'gas tshogs la lta ba dang /log par lta ba dang/mtharaltachar 'a /lta~Xmachog 'dzin dang /she 4tshe snye gres slo te ltab lnga'o//de dag na she ba na ge mu/gzhan yang khyab la sags pa nye ba 'a nyon mongs pa shu 'a /nyon mongs pa'i rab dbye phra mo/sku rwarngo rnams dang /nyon mong༅pa rnam/kya bag chags dang gnas ngan len gang na pa rnams kyang ste/shing mong༅rdeg stobs rnams kun tu pham pa ste/nyon mongs phal cher spangs nga/'ga' zhigartsad nas rang ma spangs kyang /de la rang dbang 'byor pa'i tshul gyi gde'i zhe tsho dge rje mu sde ge ged she lam gyi grogs ྅ gis pa'o//skabs 'dir sdi pyis 'byi ༵gnan gya gnyen pa tsho ri rnam par sbyang ba dang/stub kyi yan lag / / yi / gar+sā po bdag kyi ga lta/ri ge /sto mongs byang chub yan lag tu skyurathabs mkhas la sags pa' rnam bzhag /mas gzhan las 'byung ba ltar rgyas

par shes par bya'o//bdud kyi stobs rnams zhes pa la spyir bdud bzhi yin yang /nyon mongs pa'i bdud ni sngar bshad zin pas/phung po'i bdud dnga'atshebadag gi bdud dang lha bu'i bdud do//gang 'dus byas thams cad la/rangabazhin gyis grub pa dang rtag pa'i chos rdul tsam yang mi dmigs te/phu lo stongapar rtogs pas phung po'i bdud bcom pa dang /de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po ni rtag cing brtan la/skye 'jig thams cad dang bral par rtogs pas 'chibadag gi bdud bcom shing /kun rdzob tha mal gyi sdug pa dang mi sdug pa sogasardeyul la mngon par ma zhen la/chos nyid kyi gzugs sogs don dam pa'i spyod yul mtha' yas pa la mngon par spyod pa'i phyir/gang zhig nyon mongs skyed du 'jug cing /sdig to mi dge ba'i chos la 'khrid pa'i lha'i bu'i bdud bcom pasan/bdud kyi stobs rnams ni stobs med cing mi mngon par rab tu byed pa dang/bzang po spyod pa'i stobs ni rdzogs par bgyid pa ste/bla na med pa'i sangasargyas thob par smon pa'o//gnyis pa phan yon gtso bor ston pa bsam mi khyab gyi smon lam ni/zhing rnams rgya mtsho rnam par dag byed cing //sems can rgya mtsho dag ni rnam paragrol//chos rnams rgya mtsho rab tu mthong byed cing //ye shes rgya mtshor gturtogs par byed//spyod pa rgya mtsho rnam par dag byed cing //smon la5gyomatshorab tu rdzogs par byed//sangs rgyas rgya mtsho rab tu mchod byed cing//bskalapa rgya ma sna ri mi skyo spyad par bgyi//sangs rgyas kya zhing rnams rgya mtsho thams cad bde ba can dang /pad+ma can gyi 'jig rten bzhin du ngan 'gro dang nad dang sduka

bsngal dang / lta ba log pa dang / ngam grog dang / tsher ma la sogs pa spangs pa/rin po che'i sa gzhi dang ljon pa la sogs pa rgyan thams cad kyis rnam par brgyan pa'i zhing khams rnam par dag pa stobazang po 'ba' zhig tu byed cing /sems can rgya mtsho dag ni sdug bsngal dang sgrib pa las rnam par grol bar byed pa dang / lung rtogs kyi chas rgya mtsho rnams ni/ shes rab kyi mig gis rab tumathong bar byed cing / ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa'i cho semangon sum du mthong ba'i ye shes rgya mtsho rnams ni/ rab tu rtogs pa ste thob par byed la/ spyod pa stobadagagazhan la phan pa'i thabs rgya mtsho lta bu dag la ni/ bsam pa dri ma can lasogs pa'i skyon rnams/ rnam par dag par byed cing rang gzhan gyi don gyi smen lam grangs med pa rgya mtsho rnams ni/ rab tu rje gis pa ste 'bras bu 'grub parabyed pa dang / sangs rgyas rgya mtsho thams cad ni/ mchod pa rnam pa bcu la sogs pa thams cad kyis/ rab tu mchod par byed cing / de ltar zhing dag par byed pa la sogs pa bdun po de yang / bskal pa rgya mtsho ste mtha' med pa'i bar du skyo ba med cing rab tu dga' bas spyad par bgyi zhes smon pa'o/ /de ltar na rgya mtsholta bu brgyad kyis// dang po gnyis ni zhing sbyong dang sems can smin byed yin la/lhag ma lnga ni smon lam dang tshogs rdzogs pa'i thabs so/ /tha ma ni rdzogs smin sbyang gsum de ji tsam du spyod pa'i dus bstan pa'o/ /gsum pa smon lam mthar thug bla na med par gcig tu bya ba ni/ gangayang dus gsum gshegs pa'i rgyal ba yis/ /byang chub spyod pa'i smon lamabyebrag rnams/ /bzang po spyod pas byang chub sangs rgyas nas/ /de kun ma lus—252—

bdag gis rdzogs par bgyi/ /gang yang dus gsum du byon gshegs mdzad pa'i/ rgyal ba mtha' yas pa rnams kyis sngon thog ma med pa'i dus nasabartsams pa'i/ byang chub spyod pa'i smon lam gyi bye brag mtha' yas pa de rnamasakun/ ma lus par bdag gis rdzogs par bgyi bar smon pa'o/ /de yang dusanam gyi tshe rdzogs par 'gyur snyam na/ bzang po spyod pa spyad pas bla na med pasabyang chub tu sangs rgyas par gyur nas zhes pa'o/ /de lta bu'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi smon lam bdag gis rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir/ rgyal sras mchog gnyis dang yang smon lam gcig tu bya ba ni/ rgyawab kun gyi sras kyi thu bo pa/ /gang gi ming ni kun tu bzang zhes bya/ /mkhas padedang mtshungs par spyad pa'i phyir/ /dge ba 'di dag thams cad rab tu bsngo/ /de yang rgyal ba kun gyi sras kyi mchog thu bo pa/ gang gi ming ni kun tu bzangapozhes bya bar grags pa'i/ mkhas pa de dang mtshungs par chos la spyod pa'i phyir/bdag gi dge ba 'di dag thams cad rab tu bsngo bar bgyi'o/ /'di la kun tubazang po nyid kyis rang dang mtshungs par smon lam byed par mi 'thad do snyam na/'di ni gzhon nu nor bzang la sogs pa rjes 'jug rnams kyi 'debs pa'i don du gsungs pas mi 'gal la/ kun bzang nyid kyis rang don du ni smon lamagazhan rnams kyang 'debs mi dgos par khyad med do/ /tshul ji ltar na/ lus dang ngag dang yid kyang rnam dag cing / /spyod pa rnam dag zhing rnams yongs dag dang / /bsngo ba bzang po mkhas pa ci 'drab/ /de 'dra bdag kyang de dang mtshungs par shog /sems can gang lagang—253—

'dul gyis lus mtha' yas par ston pa dang / dbyangs gcig 'gro ba kun gyi skad dang 'byor ba'i ngag dang / rnam par mi rtog bzhin du ma 'dres par shesalasnying rje chen po'i ting nge 'dzin la yang 'jug nus pa'i yid kyang ste/ sgo gsukhornam par dag par gyur cing / phar phyin drug gi spyod pa la/ ser sna sogs kyi drim rnam par dag pa dang / zhing ma dag pa rnams kyang yongs su dag par 'gyurab dang / bsngob bzang po mtha' dang bral ba btab pa'i mkhas pa byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams/ kun bzang dang lhan cig spyod pa ci 'dra ba de 'drar bdag kyang kun tu bzang po dang mtshungs par shog cig 'grel pa kha cig las/ mkhas pa bzang po bsngo ba ci 'dra ba/ /zhes 'don te/don la khyad cheramed do/ /kun nas dge ba bzang po spyod pa'i phyir/ /'jam dpal gyi ni smen la༅spyad par bgyi/ /ma 'ongs bskal pa kun tu mi skyo bar/ /de yi bya ba ma lusardzogs par bgyi/ /thog mtha' bar gsum kun tu kun nas dge ba'i chos/bzang po spyod pa spyad pa'i phyir/ 'phags mchog 'jam dpal gyi smon lam ji lta ba bzhin du bdag gis kyang spyad par bgyi ste/ spyod par gyur cig sangs rgyasarnams dang kun bzang dang 'jam dpal gyi smon lam de kun/ ma 'ongs mtha' med pa'i bskal pa kun tu mi skyo zhing / dga' spro dang bcas par/ rgyal bsrasabacas de'i bzhed don gyi bya ba ma lus pa bdag gis rdzogs par bgyi ba smen pa'o/ /gsum pa don bsdu ni/ spyod pa dag ni tshad yod ma gyur cig /yon to —254—

rnams kyang tshad gzung med par shog /spyod pa tshad med pa la gnas nasakyang / /de dag 'phru la pa thams cad 'tshal bar bgyi/ /bdag gis spyin pa lasogs pa rgyud spyod pa dag gi mtha' ni/ 'di tsam mo zhes tshad bzung du yod par ma gyur cig /de las 'byung ba'i 'bras bu gzungs dang spobs pa la sogs pa'i yon tan rnams kyang / tshad bzung du med par shog cig /de ltar spyod pa dang yon tan tshad bzung med pa la gnas par byas nas kyang / sangs rgyas dngabyang chub sems dpa' de dag rnams kyi/ sku gsung thugs kyi rnam par 'phrul pa thams cad bdag gis 'tshal pa ste/ thog mar mthong zhing shes la/ mthar thob par 'gyur bar smon pa'o/ /gzhung 'dir 'bras bu mthar thug sangs rgyasalasbyor tshul/ yang nas yang du byung yang / 'bras bu'i rnam gzhag sgos su rgyas/shing gsal bar mi 'byung ba ni/ bzang po spyod pa po 'dod chen pa ma yin pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis/ dang po'i sems bskyed pa dang 'brel ba'i smon lam gyi dbang du byas pa dang / sems dpa' chen po'i gnas skabs na/rang don yid byed kyi khyad par gzhan ni cher mi 'byung la/ bdag don du byang chub gnyer ba tsam zhig 'byung nye na/ de spong pa'i du yang bzang po spyod pa'i dmabaca' byed pa'o/ /so so skye bo'i gnas skabs thams cad du yang / rang don yid byed 'gog pa la/ dam bca' 'di kho na gal che zhing / bdag gzhan brje ba'i byang chub sems kyi rtsa ba dang mthar thug pa yang bzang po spyod pa'i dam bca' la ltos pa yin pa dang / byang chub bsgrub pa la ngang thung ba spong ba'i gochar+pā po yang 'di'o/ /—255—

gsum pa smon lam gyi sheX nga phan yon she pa she4/na ma 3 ltasnromatha' bsha/da pa yi pa spre pe/phan yan dngas bsha/da pa'//dang pa kai/di de bzhin mthar ga thug rje tsa skyo gyur pa tsam par//sems can ma lus mtha' / bdag yi yang deb te// tsam she dang nyon snrongs mthar gyur pa//bdag smon la༅mtha' yang de tsam sa//spyam mkha' mthar thug pa ji pa zhes pa la/nam mkha' rdelamatha' med phyar/phyags bcu mtha' med pa tsam par/sems can ma lusapa'i mtha' yas de bzhin te mtha' med pa'o//sems can ji tsam par lasadang wo mongs pa yang de tsam ste/ji tsam las dang wo mongs pa'i ma4 3 gzung du med par gyur pa de bzhin du/bdag gi smon lam gyi mtha' yang de tsam dang mnyam pa'i ge ge rtsa ri dge rtse rtse sde cha//mdor na gis se can thams cad kyilas ka ( tshe rje ka ku mongs gcag kyang ma lus pa bdag rtes sel ba dang/'ju pa'i/can gag kyang ma lus par ge dzo ri cad bla na med pa byang chub swā 'god pa smona~Xm dang /de ma rdzogs kya ga gi du yang sems can rnams kya sdug zang jirdedang she rtse' pa mtha' shā~X/ bdag sa 'joms pa dang /spre gi/ḍi dang gang du sbyir 'as pa' phun sum sa pa ning rnyi / rnga cad ge mu bdag sgrub ༵/sko smen snying /de ltar smon pa yang dad pa dang tshong stobs shin tu brtan pa la byagatshong rje wo po dang /snyun pa dang brtson 'grus drag pos mtshams sbyar/de thams cad stong nyid rtogs pa'i ye shes dang ji ltar dmigs pa de ltar thamasake tsho 'a0ri :rdon sbyo)rdecad la dbang 'byar ba 'a tang nge 'an nang du bcug ste/dus bskal pa mtha' med par sgyur byed kyi grogs tsho/sa bsags pa'i sgo grangs med pas

yang ji su sgyur hūṃ bsngos shing slo pre ra ni 9 khri sgrib pa she pa'i sdir/smon ༵de kyi pas sgo dod dod dod do / yang ka cig bsngas pa dang mthun par ri shā/dī la/༷ge rga mi ba 'a gnas na diyican ga kyang ma lus par rdzogs pa na da pa' phyar/smon lam 'a pa : kho /bu 'a mi 'chag nas zad pa ni mi srid pa/des na sems 'a mtha' yasapa rgyun 'chad/ par grol/ bar 'gyu/ra yang /sems can gya khamasala'aphel pe na pa'i ga' na ngon zabs chen rba na mi/'i byi dzon bzhin ges rima'i pa' gzhan don rlabs wo 'a 'chad sa bas bzang cingaXshen du lja mi sri mu mthar thug par spyad du zan kyang /'a 'bras bu zad brdzagasapa 'idaX//des na smon 'a di pa lha re pa dā 'grub rung thams cad /grusashe pa spyo ye she/mu ge char swā pa don she no//rdogs rbar 'a yangs gya nga ba sha/ sku bya / pa'i phyi zhang rgya che snang na sdi sna 7 /na pa na pas dang /grub 'bras kya che ba ston pa na pa' ra/phan yon don tshan du 'dus so snyam pa ni bdag gi rnam par rtog pa'o/kha cig smon lam ji tsam du 'debs pa'i rgo :sku de tshobastan pa 'a te legs sa//gnyas pa ༷na yon dngos spyan pa kyi/ni gang yang ༷ dang/༵spradhib4/dpa dang/dan ༷// gsum ma//dang pa /gang yang phyag kha(rde mi yirnams 'ad yas pa//na chen zhing gi te rgyal ba rnams la phul//lha dang bde ba 'a 'ba'i/ rnams 'di //nga rdul snyed bskal gi phul ba bag/kangakris bsngo bci rgyal po 'a thos nas//byang gra mchog rjes su 'i mchosashang //lan ga tsam yang dad pa bskyed pa na//bsod nams dam pa mchog/

tu 'di 'gyur ro/ /'dis ni bsod nams khyad par du 'phags pa yongs su sdud pa bstan te/ mchod pa'i yul zhing gi mchog sangs rgyas la/ mtshod pa'i de hrasapo rgya che ba sna tshogs phan byed mang / zhes pa ltar/ khyad par bzhi ldan phul ba de'ajig rten du bsod nams tshes che bar grags na/ de bas bsngo ba 'di la mosardepa bskyed pa yang phan yon che ste/ 'di la 'di dang phyi ma'i phan yon gzhan mtha' yas yod pa ni smos kyang ci dgos/ zhes pa'i don te/ gang yang phyogs 'tshe ri 'jig rten gyi khams zhing khams mtha' yas pa rab tu rgya che ba rnams/ mchod pa'i khyad par sna tshogs pa/ rgyal srid rin po che sna bdun dang / in+d+ra nī le'i ribo la sogs pa/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan cing bkang na ga de las gzhan phan par byed pa'i dngos po/ lha dang mi'i bde ba'i rgyu mo chog ste/ khazas dang gos dang gnas khang dang bang mdzod dang / bzhon pa dang/ 'bru dang/gzhan yang 'dod pa'i yon tan mtha' yas pa dang bcas pa'i phyogs bcu'i zhing khams de dag rnams kyang / grangs ches mang ba zhing gi rdul snyed dang/ dusamang ba bskal pa'i bar du rgyun mi 'chad par/ zhing gi dam pa rgyal ba rnams laphul na bsod nams shin tu che'o zhes grags so/ /de ni gong du smos pa ltar/gzhi dang mtshams sbyor dang / 'dzin byed dang / sgyur ba khyad par can bzhi po des ma zin cing / byang chub tu ma bsngos na nan tar na de tsam du ches tsheb mayin te/ bsod nams de yang zag pa dang bcas pa dang / rnam smin myong nasazad par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /de bas ni 'di bzang ste gang gis bzang po spyod pa bsngo ba'i rgyal po 'di/ thos shing thos byung gi shes rab kyis go nas blan —258—

med pa'i byang chub mchog gi rjes su rab tu mos pa ste/ byang chub lamatha' yasapa'i yon tan dang ldan par nges shes skyes shing / des drangs te snying thag pa nasabyang chub la dang ba'i dad pa lan cig tsam yang skyed cing smon lam 'debs pa de ni/ snga ma de bas ches khyad par du 'phags pa'i bsod nams dam pa'imachog tu 'gyur te/ dad pa po'i dad pas smon lam 'debs pa po 'di ni de 'drar 'gyur ba'o/ /yang na 'dir dad pa bskyed pa khona'i phan yon la sbyar kyangachog ste/ gzhung gi dngos bstan de tsam yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de las de mchogayin pa'i rgyu mtshan ni phyi ma 'di ni zag pa med pa'i dge ba yin pa dang / 'di las nges par sangs 'a rgyas kya sa bon thebs nas/ phugs kyi 'bras bu mi zad pa'i phyir ro/ /rjes su mos pa'i don ni/ byang chub nyid kyi gnas tshul dang mthun par/ mos pa byas pa'i don yin te/ mos pa gang dag mos yul de ngosapo'i rjes su mi 'gro ba/ lha nag po dang drag po dbang phyug la sogs pa nyon mongs kun tu spyod pa la nyon mongs med par 'dod pa sogs mos pa dngos po dang rjes su mi mthun pa de rnams dgag pa'i don no/ /thos nas zhes pas/don ma go ba dang / mo se pa dang dad pa zhes bstan pas gzhan gyis bskul ba dang 'gran pa'i phyir dang / g.yom rgyugs su smon lam 'debs pa so gos/ 'di dag la dngos su phan yon chen po de lta bu mi 'byung ngo / /zhes pa'i don te/ 'on kyang bsam pa dag pa dang ma dag pa gang yin yang rung ste/ chos 'di dang 'brel pa thob pa'i phyir ma 'ongs pa na don chen po dang 'phrad pa'i rgyu ni nges par yin no/ /—259—

gnyis pa rgyas bshad ni/ gang gis bzang spyod smon lam 'di btab pa/ /des ni ngan song thams cad spang bar 'gyur/ /des ni grogs po ngan pa spangs pa yin/ /snang ba mtha' yas de yang des myur mthong / /de dag rnyed pa rab rnyed bde bar 'tsho/ /mi tshe 'dir yang de dag legs par 'ong / /kun tubazang po de yang ci 'dra bar/ /de dag ring por mi thog de bzhin 'gyun/ /mtshams med lnga po dag gi sdig pa rnams/ /gang gis mi shes dbang gis byasapa dag /de yis bzang po spyod pa 'di brjod na/ /myur du ma lus yongs su byangabar 'gyur/ /ye shes dang ni gzugs dang mtshan rnams dang / /rigs dngakhadog rnams dang ldan par 'gyur/ /bdud dang mu stegs mang pos de mithub/ / 'jig rten gsum po kun na'ang mchod par 'gyur/ /byangs shingadabang drung du de myur 'gro/ /song nas sems can phan phyir der 'dun ste/ /byangachub 'tshang rgya 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /bdud rnams sde dang bcas pa thamasacad btu'// /skyes bu gang gi dad pa phun sum tsho gi/sa pa dang ldan pag phan yon rnam pa bcu gsum po 'di dag rim gyis thob par 'gyur te/ phan yon dngapo ni/ skyes bu gang zhig gis smon lam 'di brtson pas btab par byas na/ ngan song du skye 'gyur gyi sdig pa thams cad byang nas/ des ni re zhig las dbangagis ngan song du 'gro ba thams cad spangs par 'gyur ba'o/ /phan yon gnyis pa ni/ smon lam 'di 'debs pa des ni/ tshe 'di dngaphyi ma thams cad du grogs po ngan pa spangs pa yin te/ grogs ngan pa dang 'phrad par mi 'gyur zhing / sngar 'phrad pa'i rgyun dang 'bral ba yin no/ /de la grogs—260—

po ngan pa ni sdig pa'i grogs po nyon mongs pa 'phel bar byed cing / lasang na sdig pa la sbyor bar byed pa dang / tshul khrims dang thos bsam sgom gsum 'phel ba la bar du gcod pa'i byed pa ste/ tshe 'di'i 'dod yon dang / dgraganyen la sogs pa 'jig rten pa'i bya ba la sbyor ba'am/ thar pa'i lam du rlomayang rung ste/ lta ba dang spyod pa log pa la sbyor ba de dag ni bla ma'am rje dpon nam/ grogs thad kar mnyam pa'am/ g.yog gam slob mar gyur pa yin yangarung ste/ mi dge ba'i bshes gnyen nam sdig pa'i grogs po dang / 'dud kyi dpung gnyen zhes bya ste/ me 'bar ba'am/ sprul gdug reg pa dug can ltararing du spong dgos rgyu'o/ /de 'dra ba'i sdig grogs rang min yang / theg chen du zhugs pa dag theg dman du sbyor ba dang / zab pa dang rgya tshel mos pa drang don gyi chos la sbyor ba sogs kyang grogs ngan no/ /phan yon gsum pa ni/ snang ba mtha' yas de yang des myur mthang/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa snang ba mtha' yas te 'od dpag tu med pa zhing khams bde ba can dang bcas pa yang / gson pa'i tshe la'ang myur du mthong ba dang / sangs rgyas de las chos thos pa dang / shi nas kyang zhing khams/der skye ba'o/ /phan yon bzhi pa ni/ smon lam 'di la brtson pa de dag don chen po 'grub pa'i phyir rnyed pa rab tu rnyed pa'am/ 'bad rtsol med par chos dang ldan pa'i zas gos bsod snyoms la sogs pa rab tu rnyed pa ste 'phongs pa med pa'o/ / —261—

phan yon lnga pa ni/ bde bar 'tsho ba ste bde ba'i don ni legs pa yin la/ des na tshe gang du legs par spyod pa/ dge ba dang ma bral bas 'tsho ba'am/dgra dang gdon dang nad la sogs pa'i nyer 'tshe med pas bde bar 'tsho ba'o /phan yon drug pa ni/ mi tshe 'dir yang smon lam 'debs pa de dgamir skyes pa don yod par 'gyur bas legs par 'ongs ba ste/ mi tshe don ldan du byung zhes pa'i don no/ /de yang 'dir dge ba 'phel bar gyur pas/ skyeb shin tu mang por bde ba'i rgyu grub zin pa'i don no/ /yang na smon lam 'di 'debs pa de dag mi tshe 'dir yang tshe ring ba dang / longs spyod che ba dang/'khor dang nye du sogs rtsa 'jings rgyas pa dang / lo legs pa dang/ gzhan rnams byams pa dang / snyan par grags pa sogs legs tshogos thams cad dngaldan par 'ongs te/ 'ongs zhes pa 'byung 'gyur la byung ba'i sgras bstan pa'o/ /phan yon bdun pa ni/ kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa thob pa ske phan yon drug po de tsam du ma zad 'phags pa kun tu bzang po yon tan dang rnam par 'phrul pa mtha' yas pa/ mchod pa dang smon lam rgya mtsho la dbang 'byor pa de ci 'dra ba de 'dra bar yang / dus ring por mi thogs par smon lam 'debs pa de dag kun bzang nyid kyis ji ltar yon tan brnyes pa'i go rim dang mthun pa de bzhin du 'gyur ro/ /de la kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa cung zad grub pa ni/ sa dang po rab tu dga' ba nas yin la/ phal cher grub pa ni sa brgyad pa nas dang / legs par grub pa ni sa bcu pa'o/ /phan yon brgyad pa ni/ las sgrib byang ba ste/ mtshams med pa lnga po dag—262—

gi las kyi sgrib pa rnams las/ gang yang rung ba zhig skyes bu gang gi sdig pa'i nyes dmigs mi shes pa'i dbang gis snga rol tu byas pa dag phyis de yis dad pa bskyed nas bzang po spyod pa 'di snying thag pa nas brjod na/ de yi mtshamasamed kyi sdig pa de dag ma lus pa myur du yongs su byang bar 'gyur bzho /midage ba'i las thams cad dug gsum gang rung gis 'phen zhing sbyor ba yin la/'dod chags dang zhe sdang gis 'phen zhing sbyor ba rnams la'ang / gti mun gisa'aphen pa sngon du 'gro dgos pas sdig pa thams cad mi shes pa'i dbang gis byas pa'o/ /byang chub tu sems bskyed cing dad pas smon lam 'di yang yangabatab pas/ mtshams med byas pa'ang tshe 'di la byang bar nus na/ sdig pa phra mornams lta smos kyang cig dgos so/ /phan yon dgu pa ni/ ye shes phun sum tshogs pa thob pa ske gong du bstan pa ltar khyad par bzhi ldan gyi bsngo ba 'dis yongs su bsngo ba ni/'phags pa'i ye shes rnam par mi rtog pa thob pa'i rgyu drug po yin la/ dang ni zhes pa gzugs sogs dang so sor 'byed pa'i tshig go /phan yon bcu pa ni/ lus phun sum tshogs pa ste/ yid kyi rang bzhin gyi lus kyi gzugs dang / de'i yon tan mtshan bzang sum cu rtsa gnyis dang/ dpebyad brgyad cu ste mtshan gyi yon tan brgya dang bcu gnyis la sogs pa rnams dang / 'gro ba drug tu skyes pa'i tshe yang / bram ze chen po dang / rgyal rigasamachog la sogs pa/ rigs phun sum tshogs pa/ kha dog gi yon tan rnams dang ldan pa'i gzugs mdzes par 'gyur ba'o/ /yang na kha dog ni/ gyo skad du war+ṇa—263—

te rus la 'jug pas/ go ta ma dang / 'od srung la sogs pa bram ze dang/ zla ba'i rigs dang / nyi ma'i rigs la sogs pa rgyal rigs kyi rus te/ rusatshezhing khungs btsun pa rnams so/ /phan yon bcu gcig pa ni thub par dka' ba ste/ bdud dang bdud kyi rigs kyi lha dang 'byung po rnams kyis glags lta bar mi nus shing / gangasangasargyas kyi bstan pa 'di las phyi rol tu gyur pa/ lta bang na pa'i 'thibs po can dedag ni mu stegs byed de/ de dag gi shes rab dang stobs kyis 'di thub parami'agyur la/ gzhan du na bdud dang mu stegs de dag rnams phar zil gyis yon par 'gyur ro/ /gzhung phal cher du/ /bdud dang mu stegs mang pos de mithub/ /ces 'byung ba dang / 'grel pa rngog lo chen pos bsgyur ba ltar na/ bdud dang mu stegs tshogs kyis de mi thub/ /ces 'gyur ba don la 'dra bas ji ltarabade bar sbyar ro/ /phan yon bcu gnyis pa ni/ mchod 'os su 'gyur ba'i yon to te/ sa'og dang sa steng dang nam mkha' la spyod pa'am 'jig rten gsum po kun na yang lha dang mi dang 'byung po rnams kyis smon lam 'di 'debs pa po de la dngos dang brgyud pa'i sgo nas mchod pa byed cing / gus pa dang phan 'dogs par 'gyuraro/ /phan yon bcu gsum pa ni/ mthar thug gi phan yon no/ /smen lam 'di 'debs par byed cing btab pa mthar phyin pa'i phan yon ni/ tshogs gnyisayongs su rdzogs nas bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par 'gyur ba ste/ de ni byang—264—

chub kyi shing gi dbang po'i drung du myur du 'gro zhing /song nas sems cwa zhus༅cad la phan pa'i phyir shing drung der 'dug ste/bdud kyi rgyal po rnams rabarangagi 'khor gyi sde dang bcas pa thams cad bshul nas/byang chub tu mthon parardzogs par sangs rgyas te/chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor bar khrur rdo/de ltar na byang chub kyi snying por gshegs pa dang /bdud 'dul ba dang/sangasargyas pa dang /chos 'khor bskor ba ste/mdzad pa bzhi po dngos su bstan pagamadzad pa mtha' yas pa thams cad kyang shugs la go ba'i phyir ro//'dir 'gro ba rnams kyi go rim 'di ltar du mdzad pa/mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi rim pa dngamathun zhing /gzhung gi dkyus ltar na bdud bshul ba'i mdzad pa ni/byang chubasnying por bdud bshul ba gcig pur ma zad/snga phyi thams cad du bdud kyi 'ang/yang dang yang du 'joms par mdzad pa nyid yin te/mdo sde nyi ma'i snying po dang/'dus pa rin po che tog la sogs pa las 'byung ba lta bu ste/snga phyi thams cad du sbyor dgos pa'i phyir/mjug tu smos pa yin pas/sangs rgyas rnyas/pa ltabu'i lo tsā ba ye shes sdes kyang de bzhin du pond do//byang chub kyi snying poragade/gas pa la sogs pa 'di rnams/gtso bor gzugs kyi sku mchog/ go sprulardesku'i mdzad pa yin mod kyi/des de ltar ston pa la rgyu ni 'og min gyi gnasasulongs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i rnam 'phrul la yang de bzhin du 'char ba yin no//longs sku rtag tu bzhugs pa dang /'og min gyi gnas su bdud kyi 'junapa med pas/yab yum gyi skye ba ston pa dang bdud 'dul ba ldogs longs skra zhi mdzad pa la mi 'grig go snyam pa ni ke 2 6 tu blo chung du gnas 'di dag la mun

par gyur pa'i gtam yin te/ longs sku de'i ba sbu'i khung bu gcig la yang/phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa mtha' dag ston pa yin pa'i phyir/ de tsam gyis longs sku mya ngan las 'das par mi 'gyur zhing / de na bdud yod par thal ba yang ma yin no/ /de ltar na phan yon dang po gnyis dang /brgyad pa las sgrib byang ba ste/ gsum po de ni mi mthun phyogs spangs pa dang/bzhi pa rnyed pa dang / lnga pa 'tsho ba dang / drug pa legs par thob pa ste gsum po de ni/ mthun rkyen 'byor ba'i phan yon te/ de ltar drug ni/ las dang po pa nyid nas 'phral du 'byung ba rnams so/ /gzugs phun sum tshogs pa dpa/ mchod 'os su gyur pa ni/ gtso bor smon lam la brtson pa nas bzung ba'i skye ba gnyisapa phan chad du'o/ /thub par dka' ba yang / 'di dang phyi ma gnyis kar na ste/de'i phyogs gcig phar zil gyis mnan pa ni/ phyi ma phan chad do/ /bdun pa kun bzang gi spyod pa la 'jug pa dang / bcu pa gzugs phun sum rnyas pa'i phyogs gcig yid kyi lus ni/ sa thob pa'i dus kyi phan yon no/ /bcu gsum pa ni sangs rgyas thob pa'i dus kya ste/ phan yon bcu gsum po yang mthong ba'i chos la 'byung ba'i phan yon dang / tshe phyi ma so so skye bo'i gnas skabs kyi dang/'phags pa'i sa thob pa'i dang / mthar thug gi gnas skabs kyi phan yon te sdetshan bzhir 'dus pa yin no/ /gsum pa don bsdu ni/ gang yang bzang po spyod pa'i smon lama'adi/ /'chang pa dang ni ston tam klog pa yi/ /de yi rnam par smin pa sangs rgyasamakhyen/ /byang chub mchog la som nyi ma byed cig /skyes bu gang yang bzang po —266—

spyod pa'i smon lam gyi rgyal po 'di'i/ don dang tshig dang glegs bam gus pasa'achang ba dang kha ton du 'don pa dang / glegs bam klog par byed na yang rung ste/de yi rnam par smin pa ste 'bras bu ni/ mtha' yas shing bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ji lta ba bzhin du ni sangs rgyas kho nas mkhyen gyi/ nyan thos dang rang rgyal gyi yang spyod yul ma yin na/ so so skye bo rnams kyi lta smos kyang ci dgog de'i 'bras bu mthar thug pa/ byang chub kyi mchog bla na med par thob par 'gyurabal/ som nyi ma byed cig ste the tshom med pa'o/ /'dir shākya bzhes gnyen gyi 'grel pa las ni rgyu mthun pa'i 'bras bu mngon par mthoba'i phun sum tshogasapa mtha' dag ni/ nyan rang sogs kyis bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang/ ba chod nams kyi rgyu mthun pa'i 'bras bu byang chub mchog ces 'chad do/ /rtsa ba'i bzhi pa phan yon can gyi smon lam nyid bsngo ba la/ sras byangasems kyis bsngos pa la 'jug pa/ rgyal bas bsngos pa la 'jug pa/ smen lam gyi 'bras bu mngon gyur du bsngob/ dngos su lung bstan thob par bsngob/sems can la phan pa sgrub par bsngo ba ste lnga las/ dang po ni/ 'jam dpalajiltar mkhyen cing dpa' ba ltar/ /kun tu bzang po de yang de bzhin te/ /de dgakun gyi rjes su bdag slob cing / /dge ba 'di dag thams cad rab tubasngo/ /'di la dpe phal cher nas/ 'jam dpal ji ltar mkhyen cing dpa' bltar zhes 'byung ba ltar na/ ji ltar 'jam dpal shes bya thams cad mkhyen cinga'agro ba'i don la dpa' ba ltar/ de ltar kun tu bzang po yang ngo zhes par 'gyudal/ 'gyur 'di ltar la dpa' ba dang zer pa yig nor tsam mo/ /rgya 'grel—267—

rnams dang mkhan po ye shes sde'i 'grel pa las/ 'jam dpal dba' bosadziltar mkhyen pa dang / zhes 'don pa ltar na/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal bdud kyi sde 'joms pa dang / 'gro ba'i don spyod pa dang / shes rab mchog gis shosapor 'dzin pa 'joms pa la/ dpa' bor gyur pa des/ ji ltar bsngo ba thugs su chud cing mkhyen pa dang / 'phags pa kun tu bzang po de yang de bzhin du dpa' bo chen po yin la/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i bsngo ba thugs su chud pa yangadebazhin te/ byang chub sems dpa'i mchog de dag kun gyi rjes su ste/ de dnga'adrabar bdag kyang slob par 'dod cing 'dun pa'i bsam pas/ bzang po spyod pa'ismon lam btang pa'i dge ba ji snyed mchis pa 'di dag thams cad rab tu bsngobar bgyi'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ dus gsum gshe/gas pa'i rgyal ba thams cad kyig /bsngo tsho ba gang la mchog tu bsngags pa des/ /bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di kun kyang / /bzang po spyod phyir rab tu bsngo bar bgyi/ /dus gsum du sems can gyi don la byon cing gshegs pa'i rgyal ba thams cad kyis mchog tu bsngags shing bstod pa'i bsngo ba'i rgyal po bzang zhing rgya che ba'i bsngo ba mtha' yas pa gang dang gang la/ mchog tu bsngags par mdzad pa'i bsngob de rnams kyis/ bdagagis smon lam 'di btab pa la sogs pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di kun kyang/ kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa thob pa'i phyir rab tu bsngo bar bgyi'o ste/ de'i don ni bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi smon lam dang gcigatu'adres te/ dge rtsa 'dis smon lam de rnams 'grub par gyur cig /de rnams—268—

kyis kyang 'di 'grub par gyur cig ces dang / smon lam de rnams kyi grub 'bras kyang kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa'o/ /'jam dpal dpa' bos zhes sogasardetshigs bcad 'di gnyis ni/ bsngo ba ma lus pa thams cad 'dus pa'i phyir/ blan med pa'i bsngo ba'o/ /gsum pa ni/ bdag ni 'chi ba'i dus byed gyur pa na/ /sgrib pa thams/cad dag ni phyir bsal te/ /mngon sum snang ba mtha' yas de mthonganas/ /bde ba can gyi zhing der rab tu 'gro/ /der song nas ni smon lam 'a dag kyang / /thams cad ma lus mngon du 'gyur bar shog /de ltar ma lusabadag gis yongs su bskang / /'jig rten ji srid sems can phan parabagyi/ /bdag ni nam zhig 'chi ba'i dus byed par gyur pa na/ las dang nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa thams cad dag ni phyir bsal zhing med par byas pa ste/sgrib pa spyi dang khyad par du 'a spyod pa la sogs pa'i sgrib pa lnga po dang / rungasargyas mngon sum du mthong ba la bar du gcod pa'i sgrib pa rnams byang bgo /de nas sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas de mngon du mthong bar 'gyur la/ de mthongabs kyang slar yang sgrib pa mang po zhig ni dag /ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo du mthob nas/ gnar gcod la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal med cing / 'chi ba'i sems de yang rab tu rnam par dkar ba'i ting nge 'dzin du ma dang bcas par 'gyur zhing /de song ma thag tu gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha'i rgyal po'i lus dang mtshungs pa'i bar do'i lus grub nas/ skad cig thang cig yud tsam de la bde ba can gyizhing khams der rab tu 'gro zhing / der song nas ni rin po che'i pad+ma'i ze'u—269—

'bru'i khang par brdzus te skye ba blang nas/ bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam btab pa 'di rnams kyi 'bras bu de dag kyang thams cad ma lus pa mngon du 'gyur zhing 'grub par shog la/ de ltar bdag gi smon lam gyi 'bras bu de dag ma lus pa rang rgyud la dgos pa rnams kyang yongs su bskang zhing rdzogs la/ sems can gzhan rnams kyi don du dgos pa kun kyang / yongs su rdzogs shing re ba bskongabar byas nas/ 'jig rten ji srid ma stongs pa de srid du/ sems can rnamasalaphan pa mtha' yas pa rtag tu bgyid par gyur cigabazhi pa ni/ rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor bzang zhing dga' ba red/ /pad+mo dam pa shin tu mdzes las skyes/ /snang ba mtha' yas rgyal bas mngon sum du/ /lung bstan pa yang bdag gis der thob shog /rgyal ba 'od dpag tu med pa'i zhingakhams phun sum tshogs pa der spyod pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor bde zhing skyid pas bzang zhing dga' ba'am/ yang na gzugs bzang zhing yid yon rtan gyisadaga' bar gyur pa zhes 'chad pa ltar ram/ yon tan thams cad kyis rnam parabargyan cing / gnas ngan len gyi spyod pa spangs pas bzang ba/ nang du ting nge 'dzin gyi dga' ba dang / phyi rol tu smon lam gyi stobs las grub pa'i dzinasadang yo byad dang 'dod pa'i yon to thams cad kyis dga' bar gyur pa rnamasakyi dbus der/ pad+mo dam pa rin po che'i pad+mo shin tu mdzes pa lag brdzusateskyes nas byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa'i tshe rgyal ba snang ba mtha' yasakyis mngon sum du khyod 'jig rten khams 'di zhes bya bar bskal pa 'di zhes bya ba la/ sangs rgyas 'di lta bur 'gyur ro zhes lung ston pa yang bdag gis—270—

dus de skabs su dang gnas dang grogs kyi khyad par 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor der thob par shog cig pa'o/ /lnga pa ni/ der ni bdag gis lung bstan rab thob nas/ /sprul pa mang po bye ba phrag brgya yis/ /blo yi stobs kyis phyogs bcu rnams su yang/ /sems/can rnams la phan pa mang po bgyid/ /bde ba can gyi zhing der ni smon la5'debs pa po bdag gis/ lung bstan de lta bur rab tu thob nag sprus pa mngapo bye ba phrag rgya la sogs pa mtha' las 'das pa yis/ gzhan don la gcig tu gzhol ba'i blo'i stobs kyis phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams ma lus pa rnams su yang / skad cig re re yang sems can mtha' yas pa rnams la/ ngan song gi sdug bsngal las skyob pa nas brtsams te/ mtho ris dang / nyan rangadang / bla na med pa'i byang chub la 'god pa'i bar gyi/ phan pa mang po ji srid 'khor ba ma stong gi bar du bgyid par ste sgrub par shog ces pa'o/ khwakya bshes gnyen gyi 'grel pa'i lugs ltar na/ sprul pa bye ba brgya phrag du ma yig /zhes 'don zhing / der song nas ni zhes pa'i sho lo ka gcig po de/ phan pa mngapobagyid ces pa'i rjes 'dir 'don pa snang ngo / /bzang po spyod pa'i smon lasab kho pa yi/ sogs sho lo ka gnyis ni sdong po bko pa'i mdo dngos bod du yod pa 'di las mi 'byung zhing / rgya 'grel rnam dag gzhan rnams na yang bshad pa med do/ khwakya bshes gnyen gyi 'grel bar ni 'byung zhing / bzang spyod kyi glegs bam logs su byas pa'i rgya dpe gcig na yang snang ngo / /mkhan po ye shes sdes kyang bshad pa mdzad pas/ spyir mdo sde'i tshig ni yin par bya dgos—271—

so/ /des na 'dir sngar gyi sa bcad lnga po la mi the yang / gzhan don khonarayongs su bsngo ba zhes bya ste/ tshigs bcad dang po ni/ bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam bton pa yi/ /dge ba cung zad bdag gis ci bsags pa/ /des ni 'groba'i smon lam dge ba rnams/ /skad cig gcig gis thams cad 'byore b.rashog /bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam gyi glegs bam bklags pa dang kha rtan du byas pa ni bton pa'o/ /de las bdag gis dge ba cung zad tsi bsags pa desani 'gro ba sems can thams cad kyis yid la smon zhing / ngag gi gyur cig parabarjod pa'i smon lam gyi rigs las dge bar gtogs pa rnams thams cad 'bad stsol med cing / yun ring du thogs pa ma yin par/ skad cig ga khrig gisate myur du thams cad 'byor zhing 'grub par shog cig pa'o/ /'dis ni bdaganyid kyi bzang spyod bton pa'i dge bas sems can thams cad kyi bzang smon 'grub par smon pa yin pas/ gzhan don kho nar bsngo ba'o/ /tshigs bcad gnyis pa ni/ gang yang bzang po spyod pa 'di bsngosapas/ /bsod nams mtha' yas dam pa gang thob des/ /'gro ba sdug bsngal/chubor bying ba rnams/ /'od dpag med pa'i gnas rab thob par shog khresapa'am dpe 'ga' las/ bzang spyod yongs su bsngos pa'i bsod nams ni/mtha' yas shin tu khyad 'phags gang thob des/ /zhes kyang ngo / /bzang po spyod pa'i bsngo ba byas pa 'di yis/ gang yang bdag gi rgyud la bsod nams te dgoba'i rtsa ba rgya che bas mtha' yas shing / ngo bo bzang pas dam par gyur pa gangazhig thob pa des/ 'gro ba gas drug gi sems can skye rga na 'chi la sogs—272—

pa'i sdug bsngal gyi chu bor bying ba rnams/ bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag med pa'i gnas bde ba can gyi zhing khams sdug bsngal gyi ming yang mi grag cing /rtag tu bde ba'i gnas de rab tu thob par shog cig pa ste/ der skye bar gyuracig pa'o/ /bzang po spyod pa'i gzhung 'di la sngon bstan pa snga 'gyur gyi dusasālo paṇa sprul pa'i skyes mchog rnams kyis bsgyur ba la/ slob dpon chen po dpal phyogs kyi glang po dang / shākya bzhes gnyen dang / sangs rgyas grags pa dang / rgyan bzang po ste/ bzhi po des mdzad pa'i 'grel pa dag 'gyur la/ de rnams kyis don legs bsdus kyi steng du/ mkhas pa'i gsung dang mdo don 'ga' zhig gis brgyan pa/ mkhan po ye shes sdes rjed byang gi 'grel chen mdzad do/ /slob dpon r+pā po dbyig gar+sā gyis mdzad zer ba'i 'grel pa dang / rngog 'gyur klu sgrub kyis mdzad zer ba'i 'grel ba de gnyis rgyan bzangapo'i 'grel pa dang / 'gyur khyad ma gtogs gcig pas/ dpe thog mdabangabatsan par byas te rgyan bzang po'i yin gyi/ slob dpon chen po de gnyis kyi mayin no/ /rgyan bzang po'i 'grel pa 'di yang phyogs glang gi 'grel pa'i bsdusadon bor zhing / mgo zhabs su tshigs bcad bsnan pa tsam ma gtogs lhagawarnams bris bshus lta bu snang ngo / /sangs rgyas grags pa'i 'grel pa ni ma mthongal 'dir phyogs glang dang shākya bshes gnyen gyi 'grel pa'i don gyi snying po gal che ba rnams tshang bar byas la/ phal cher ye shes sde'i gsung gi yang rjesasu'abrangs shing / rang blos rtogs pa'i legs bshad cung zad kyis kyang bgyon te bshad pa yin no/ /de ltar na sdong po bkod pa nyid las 'byung ba dang/ rgya—273—

'grel phal cher ltar na/ sho lo ka drug cu yin la/ shākya bshes gnyon gyi 'grel pa ltar na phyi ma gnyis po bsnan pa'o/ /'di nyid kyi sgos kyi glegs bam bod ma phal cher gyi mjug tu/ smon lam rgyal po 'di dag mchog gi gtso/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba kun la phan byed cing / /kun tu bzang pos brgyan pa'i zhing grub ste/ /ngan song gnas rnamasawalus stongs par shog /ces 'byung ba ni/ mdo dang / sngar smos pa bdag gisamathong ba'i 'grel pa rnams na mi snang zhing / sangs rgyas grags pa'i 'grel pa na'ang med par grags la/ pa gor be+e ro tsa na rak+ṣi ta la sogs pa 'di'i gzhuda'agrel rnams 'gyur mdzad pa'i lo tsā ba dag gis/ 'gyur gyi smon lam gyi tshuwadu mdzad pa yin no zhes grags te/ de ltar yin pa yang sems la/don ni bzang po zhig ste/ smon lam gyi rgyal po 'di dag ni/ mchog gi gtso bo sangasargyas su 'grub cing / mtha' yas pa'i 'gro ba kun la phan par byed pa dang/khyad par du phyogs bcu'i zhing khams ma lus pa'i ngan song gi gnas thams cad ma lus par stongs pa dang / phyogs thams cad kun tu bzang po'i smon lamagyis brgyan pa'i zhing khams khyad par can du bsgrubs pas grub par gyur cig pa'o/ /der ltar na tshigs bcad tha ma de gsum ni/ sdong po bkod pa nyid lasami 'byung ba'i phyir/ ma bton yang chad pa'i nyes pa med par shes par bya'o/ /'dir smras pa/ zab cing rgya che'i smon lam dam pa 'di/ /bdagaltarmongs pa'i spyod yul ma yin mod/ /rang gi blo gros rnam par sbyang pho phyir/ /dam pa'i gsung gi rjes zhugs skyon med snyam/ /stong pa nyid dang snying—274—

rje'i rang snang las/ /ting 'dzin spyod yul dam pa'i 'jig rten dang/ /yid kyi lus dang bsam mi khyab pa yi/ /skye dang 'chi 'pho rnam 'phrul mtha' yas pa de ni rgyal dang sems dpa' tshe rnams kyi/ /spyod yul nyid yin gzhan gyi ma lags mod/ /smon lam 'dis ni de don rdzogs par a/ /de phyir 'phags pa'i spyod yul nyag gcig go /zhes pa ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bsam pa phun sum tsho gos pa gang yin pa de yang /skyes bu chen po'i rnam par rtog pa brgyad du 'dus pa yin no/ /rnam pa brgyad pode la ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams nyin dang mtshan du mngon par phyogs par byed do/ /de la sdom ni/ sdug bsngal sel dang 'byor pa dang/ bdag lus don dang ngan 'gror 'jug /re ba rdzogs dang 'khor las 'dren/ /'grol phan med 'dod bral dang / /brgyad pa bdag gzhan brje ba yin/ /rnam rtog dang po ni/bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal nam zhig/ sel bar 'gyu/ra snyam nga dang / rnam rtog gnyis pa ni/ sems can dbul po rnams 'byor pa chen po la bdag gis nam sbyor bar 'gyur snyam pa dang / rnam rtog gsum pa ni/ sha khrag dang bcas pa'i lus 'dis sems can gyi don nam byed snyam pa dang/ rnatshartog bzhi pa ni/ bdag ngan 'gror song nas kyang / sems can rnams lanamazhig phan 'dogs par 'gyur snyam pa dang / rnam rtog lnga pa ni/ bdagasa'ajig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i 'byor ba ste/ rdzu 'phrul dang longasaspyod dang yon to dang yon to rnams kyis sems can kyi re ba rdzogs par nam 'gyur snyam pa dang / rnam rtog drug pa ni/ bdag sangs rgyas su gyur nas—275—

sems can 'bor ba las nam zhig 'dren par 'gyur snyam pa dang / rnam rtagardebadun pa ni/ sems can la phan pa rgya chen po mi 'gyung na skye ba dang spyod pa dngalongs spyod tshes phun sum tshogs pa zhig yin yang rung nam yang mi 'dod cing skra rtse bskyod pa tsam dang dbugs 'byung rngubs tshun chad kyang / sems can laphan pa khon byed nus par nam zhig 'gyur snyam pa dang / brgyad pa ni sems can gyi sdig pa dang sdug bsngal bdag la smin par gyur cig bdag gis bde ba dang dge ba sems can la 'byung bar gyur cig ces smon pa'o/ /byang chub semasadapa' rnams smon lam 'debs pa'i rtsa ba bsam pa phun sum tshogs pa ni de dag yin te/ de la smon lam de dros ni/ ngag tu brjod pa la mi bya sto yid kyisaso/ /de ltar yang brtan pa rnams kyi smon lam ni/ sems pa 'dun dang bcas/pa ste/ /zhes gsungs pas/ skabs 'dir yang smon par bya ba'i gnas brgyad po de dag la/ rtag tu sems par byed cing / thob par 'dun pa ni smon la mo stosaso/ /de dag kyang / gzhung 'dis gsal bar bstan pa kyi yin te/ skyes bu chen po'i rnam rtog dang po sems can rnams sdug bsngal med cing bde bar 'dod pa ni/ phyogs bcu'i sems can gang rnams ji snyed pa/ /de dag rtag tund med bde bar gyur/ /zhes pa'o/ /gnyis pa 'byor pa thob par 'dod pa ni/ zhing sbyong ba dang mchod pa'i tshig rnams dang / de'i bya ba ma lus rdzogs par bgyi zhesapa'o/ /gsum pa rang lus kyi sems can la phan 'dogs pa ni/ lus dang bkadang yid kyang rnam dag cing / /zhes pa la sogs pa ste/ sgo gsum gzhan don du spyod na rnam par dag par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /bzhi pa ngan 'gror zhugs nas—276—

kyang gzhan gyi don byed pa ni/ sems can dag gi spyod dang mthun par 'jug/ces pa'o/ /lnga pa sems can gyi re ba skong ba ni/ 'gro ba kun gyi chos kyis don rnams ni/ /zhes pa nas/ thams cad skad du bdag gi chos ston to/ /zhes pa'i bar ro/ /drug pa sangs rgyas thob nas 'gro ba sgrol ba ni/ byang chub shing dbangadrung du de myur 'gro/ /sogs dang / sprul pa mang po bye ba phrag brgya yis/ sogasaso/ /bdun pa don dam du mi 'gyur ba ni/ gang yang dus gsum gshegs pa'i rgyal ba yi/ /sogs dang / gzhan yang shugs bstan la mang wo/ /brgyad pabadag gzhan brje ba ni/ zhing gi khyon dang phyogs rnams ji tsam par/ /ngan songasdug bsngal rab tu zhi bar byed/ /bde ba dag la 'grob kun 'god cing//sems can thams cad la yang phan par bgyid/ /zhes pas bstan to/ /yangabyang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa rnams kyi smon lam grangs med pa 'bum phrag bcu ni/ smon lam chen po bcur 'dus pa yin la/ de dag kyang 'phags pa sabacu pa'i mdo las/ sa dang po'i don bsdu tshigs bcad kyi skabs su 'di skad ces 'byung ste/ rgyal ba lta ba'i don du smon lam mngon par sgrub/ /dmachosayongs su bzung zhing drang srong drung 'gro dang / /spyod pa mchog gi don du slo lam mngon par sgrub/ /sems can yongs su smin bya sangs rgyas zhing sbyong ste//de yi zhing mchog rgyal sras kun gyis gang 'gyur zhing / /rgyal sras rnams dngabasam pa gcig cing don mthun phyir/ /skra sbubs kun tu don gyi dam pa bu zhe 'tshang rgya/ /de dag smon lam du ma mngon par sgrub par byed/ /de dag mtha' yas yangs shing mthar thug med dang ldan/ /nam mkha'i khams dang chos nyid mya—277—

ngan tha~Xdzo// dang //geng 'a/zhes mthar pre cig rgyal ba ཿnga dang ye shesadang //mas kyas she sa sa 'ju / ga pa pa pa de thug dang /rnam gsus ga rnardergyud ge ge zhe ge shes thug kau ba 'a mur thug pa/ji/ma zhi tshul bkro dra ma4 yang thug gyur cang // dag mthar thug ban bdag spyad da 'drarashog/ces gsungs la/de la smon lam r+pā po bcu'i sdom ni/'di dngadamar tshor tsho ge ra tsho ke dzo nywa snenardemu ge shege ge su bzung //spre'i zhing pa do : (lus dang spyad pa dang //yas su dngazhang gau dang //sbyanga~Xshe thud par sgrub//de lta she ga/ par spyad//mthun pa dan 'khru/bcu ste se dru rgya / sa//lha/ge ka sto/rde lam bcu pa la//she rtse rtse mu gnas kyang rnam bcu //masa~Xrnyi 'ag na ring spros skyo pas rderdemu /mi/lo ye she myang mis sangs rgyas 'byung // sa khams dang mas spru dgas/de/ sa rnyi༅/ rten rā dang ri ye she ge mu/rgyud da de shā kha lha5dirasman lam 'di dbas / ga tsho she//'ag na khu cas zhe/rdo/ri sa kya/khyud skabasaXsdirargyud gsum ṭā//she lam swo pa pre ni /༷༵rde ngam pa'i she la4da pa yongs su bzung zhing nga / srung b.raX ni gnyi tha//ye she~Xs po yangs su bzung ḍi rda/srung bar sman pa ge de de chas//phyagaX bcu sto me kying/rderges ge chang ge cha pa nga shes can mdzad pa ra can bye kya drung she ni pa ni ba da paX lus kyas bdag bse zhang bya ba 'i so par can da paX sman pa she na pa ni bzhi//tug tu byang /ba sa can thams cad yongs su smin pa par sman ༷ pa ni pa'//bdag sems can thama~Xzhi spra 'ji / spru/ su mu par byed par sa pa lnga pa'o//'tsha rgya bar 'gyur ba8 nga 'ag rten gya khams ma4 yas

pa 'grub par smon pa nī druga~X 'o//pa'i the par sgrub pa'i zhing khams rnams kyangad pa 'amachog gi/sam gyas khyab pa spyod yul can las/'byang chub semasardedapa' ni rnga sa gang ba sogs dag pa rab 'byams 'ba' zhag tu sbyong nyidardesmon pa she rges pa'o/she/byang 'a smos sheX thams cad dang ༷dag she 'a kaXsha/ ༷ra sman pa na brgyad pa'//spyad rnga pre zhe dang snams ye tha pasardecad 'a gya mchag kha na mtha' yas pa 'gru/ba par sman pa ye 'a//natsha' she gtsos pa thams cad du maXzhes ge ge sder rdzo kau she gyas ni pa ni par rdzags par sangs rgyabar sman kyi cho gis rdzogasang dro na nodang ga/nyi/da las dang pas pa dmachose mchod pa /bsod nams kya mus grel ge ge zhes gdod da pa' ched dang / pa dmachos/yongs su bzung ba ni/ye na pa'i che ) go du'o//gsum pa la so gosa~X lnga ni sems can yongs su na pa' ched du na te/zhi pa 1 pa kun tu 'gro/ba lus ni/rten lus kyi khyad par ci 'dra bas dang /ba pa spyod pa mtha' dgalaslob pa ni/sems la sogs pa'i spyod pa ci 'dra bas gzhan smin par o pa dang /lnga pa ni/sgri par byed pa dngos te/gang smin par bya ba'i sem ses 0ri chi no/ rdo skye rten/rde hwa tre/pho ni/rjo rdegyad bang du byas pa dang /pe zheng /hūṃ/lta bus smin par gab pho re/lte ge ge mu ge mu pa dang /bdun pa/rnam pa lta bus sman par 'khyu/ra ba nir /na~X'i phyir ro/'a/brgyad pa chogs pa'i yi kun dang mthun par spyo pa /mo— ni yon sheXrtogaXphyaXnga'i/'di ge cha yod par rma pa /khyad par rtags pa gang nas gang / 'gra ba phyar dang /bcu pa byang chubarde

kyi smon lam ni 'bras bu mthar thug gi phyir ro/ /de lta bu'i smon lam bstopo de yang / bzang po spyod pa 'di la yongs su rdzogs par tshang pa yin te/ 'jig rten dag na gang bzhugs mchod par gyur/ ces dang / de dag la yang mchod pa gyocher bgyi/ /zhes dang / sangs rgyas rgya mtshor ba tu mchod byed cing/ /zhes pa lasogs pas dang po'i dbang du byas te sangs rgyas mchod pa'o/ /rgyal ba rnamasakyi dam pa'i chos 'dzin cing / /zhes dang / byang chub spyod pa dag ni bdag spyod cing / /zhes rang gis spyod pa dang / byang chub spyod pa kun tu snang b.rabyed/ /ces gzhan la ston pa ste/ de sogs mang po zhig ni gnyis pa'i dbang du byas pa ste/ dam chos yongs su 'dzin pa'o/ /byang chub spyod pa yos su rdzogasabyed cing / zhes dang / rtag tu de dag gi ni spyod yul la/ 'i sgyu mar gyur pa rnamathar stobs kyis 'jug /ces pa la sogs pas ni gsum ju dbang du byas pa ste/ kun tu 'gro ba'i lus kyis sangs rgyas kyi spyod yul lta ba'o/ /bzang po spyod pa rnam par sbyang ba yang / /ma 'ongs bskal pa kun tu spyad par bgyi/ /zhes sogs mang po zhig ni/ bzhi pa'i dbang du byas pa ste/ spyod pa thams cad labaslab pa'o/ /bde ba dag la 'gro ba kun 'god cing / /zhes sogs dang/sems can rgya mtsho dag ni rnam par grol/ /zhes pa la sogs pa ni/ lnga pa'i dbang du byas pa ste/ sems can yongs su smin par byed pa'o/ /de ltar ma lusaphyogs rnams thams cad du/ /rgyal ba bdag gi zhing rnams bkod la'ajug/ /ces pa la sogs pa drug pa'i dbang du byas pa ste/ zhing mtha' yas pa sgrub pa'o/ /rdul gcig steng na rdul snyed zhing rnams te/ /zhing der bsam gyis—280—

sbyi khyab snangs sa rnams/she/sa pa nas/ba lnga / de zabar parang : sbyi nga sto lko rdostan/'a/sa pa' pa'i dang /zhang rnams rgya dho bye skor zhing/ par dag da //sheshe na/bdun pa dbang/khri/ge ge ges/ swo//par dgaXpa pa'i zi'//da dus sa gas sog bro pa' rgyal ba yas//ngang ying mang za sman cing bya rnog rnams//de sags dang /lus dang ngag dang da zhi zhogardedakri nga //bdag gi/she pa thams cad ༷tshal/da she/༵/bar dngas bcad kra/bdag spyad dang mtshungs par gang spyod po lta ni : gas pa mi yi seng rno//zhe spres/rdesas bcad gsum dang /dus gsum chigs pa ya nga gang //sa sna la lha // dang /tshe rabs kun tu 'a 'pho skye ba na//zhes pa la sogs pa she brgyad pa ༷nga stso sa pa ste/she chub dzis sa she thams cad dang spyo mthun ༷ra pre chamatsho//kun tu yan byed cing zhe tha stabs she dang//dang /spyad rdo rgya ma she par pyeg byad jo /yi/sa dang/yan taX tshangatsha/༵ brdo/nga da ༷za pa rna shag/zi dang/mu byā ba ma lus rtse sde ni parabashe//dzo pa kyi sags pa maX rda/ dag na ༷gu rna rdzo dbang du byas pa sta 'brasardebu dan hūṃ~Xsko pa kha nar spyad ༷//bzang pa spyad pas rnying snrob she sanas// pa dang /skra tsam khyan la dus gsum tshad da kya//sags/dang/yon to kun gyi mi zad ma sgo gyur cig/ces pa dang /kun tu a ba'i rdzude tsho re ni / sa/rde ces dkyi sne ri sku spro ye nirde'aphru/la stabs rnams dang //ni / ba/yi pa sgyu/sa pa par gyur pa ma lta~X/rdestobs//zhes/ pa la sogs pa /bcu pa dbang du sa pa ste/namashemathas gtug/sa par mdzad pa mtha' skyi 1 bstan pa' sangs rgyas su sman

pa'o//'a de pa ni kyi mas can ji tsam ya / dpa 'is la/sems can gyi 'a cing / thug pa 1/sems can tsam sa pa sa phyogs su 'a lamardegyas nga mi nga /ma 'ongs dho na jurge ge mu can ma zad kya bar du lho/ lam gya ༵smu bras bu yang zad pa'o//'ag hūm̐// gya khams dang /nam mkha khaXs/mthang thug nyis ji~Xd pa 'dra 'a/ra gyi ri rten dang nam mkhas pa mi tshad kya yul dang/de gnyas da yod pa' bar dus de zhin ༵ smen lam /da 'cha/gzhan rnams la'ang 'a thug tshul de kho na bzhin na la/choX kya das dngamyangan las bo gci pa' khams dang/༵snyen dge ge 'cha pa' ye shes kya khamardzurnams ngo bo gag ste/ngo bo chos dbyings sems nyad bde bar bshegs pa snying ༷ sa la/'on kyang snyul ba'i don du chos ston pa'i gzhi 'is myos yi myo/cho/ phyi dbyangs dang /mthar thug sems zhi/ /nga du 'dul ba 'a gnas shen pa' ra mya ngan las 'das pa dang /de ba nyad dang rnam pa mthun par sgamardepa'i chos kyi dmigs pa yin pa'i phyir/de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes kyi mngon par sa ba pa'i khams ku//thig rtse : /sa 'byung pas rtse ges ni/pa yisnamangon par ba'i nga bang ngabs zu don ga ste/ngo bo na lam gya bden pa te/'bras bu dbang du byas nas sangs dge ge'i ba pyeng /roX'i bams ni byas nas ye shes mngon par bsgrub pa'o/sa/ka rten gyi rgyud ni sdug bsngal khang shes bya thams cad do//rgyud gsum la 'jag rten gya rgyud /sdug bsngal khadangakun ཿnga ngo //chos kyi rgyud ni 'gog pa'i bden pa'o//ye shes kyi rma niyig ge rta nge5zur sdusdi/ dzo ri sna do/hūṃ)rdelam gya bden pa ste/de dag da rdod kya bar du/smon lam 'a 'bras/bu

yod par gyur cig pa'o/ /de ltar na smon lam bcu po yang / mthar thug pa'i gnas rnam pa bcu'i sgo nas 'debs dgos pa las/ de yang / nam mkha'i mthar thug gyur pa ji tsam par/ /sems can ma lus mtha' yang de bzhin te/ /ji tsam las dang nyon mongs mthar gyu pa/ /bdag gi smon la5mtha' yangade tsam mo/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don la 'dus pa yin no/ /smon las bcu po waṃ dag rgyas par 'phags pa sa bcu pa'i mdo las/ sa dang po'i rgyas bshad kyiskabs na yod la/ zhib mor shes 'dod na mdo de nyid dang / rgyal sras zhi po 'phags pa dbyig gnyen gyi 'grel pa dang bcas pa las rtogs par bya la/rgyas bshad kyi mdo'i tshig dang / 'phags pa bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam tshig phal cher zhib tu sbyor rgyu yod mod kyis/ 'dir ni ha cang mang bar gyur gyi dogs pas ma bkod do/ /phyis byung ba mkhas par rlom pa kha cig thig spon lam chen po bcu'i tshigs bcad sbyor ba mthong ste/ des ni mdo rtsa 'grelawamathong zhing / bzang po spyod pa don la sbyor tshul yang ma go bas/ ming tsam lasadon ma rtogs pa'i bzhad gad kyi gnas kyang snang ngo / /de bas na rgyal sras kyi smon lam thams cad smon lam chen po grangs med pa 'bum phrag bcur 'dus la/ de yang bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam du 'dus par shes nas/ rtag tu dza de nyid khyad par bzhi dang ldan pas kha ton du byed pa la brtson par bya ste/ theg pa chen po la rnal 'byor du byed pa rnams kyis so/ /'phags pa bzang po spyod pa smon lam gyi rgyal po'i rgya cher 'grel pa/ 'phags mchog rnams kyi gsang ba'i mdzod ces bya ba/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas nags rgyal gyi dben gnasajo—283—

nang du smras pa'o/ /las dang po la phan pa'i phyir/ /phyag rgya lnga yi mdo rnamasal/ /rnam bshad shin tu go sla shing / /zab mo'i don dang ldan par sbyar/ /'di las dge ba gang thob des/ /'gro ba kun gyis chos kyi sku/ /mtha' yas snying po nges thob nas/ /ye shes rgya mtshor ro gcig gyur/ /bkra shis// //—284—

rnam par bshad pa bzhugs/oX swā sti/ sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'phags pa byams pa'i smon lam zhes yongs su grags pa 'di ni/ 'phags pa dkon mchog brtsegs pa'i 'dus pa bzhi bcu/ zhe gcig pa/ 'phags pa byams pas zhus pa zhes bya ba'i mdo na bzhugs so/ /de yang yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas yul warga na chu srin byis pa gsod kyi ri'i ngogs/ 'jigs su rung ba'i ri dwags kyi nags na bzhugs te/ kun shes la sogs pa nyan thos chen po lnga brgya dang / byams pa la sogs pa sems dpa' chen po khri dang thabs cig go /de nas 'phags pa byams pas byang chub sems dpa' chos du dang ldan na/ ngan 'gro spong zhing sdig grogs kyis dbang du mi 'gro bar rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par 'gyur zhes zhus pa la/ ston pa bcom ldan 'das kyis chos gcig dang ldan na der 'gyur te/ lhag pa'i bsam pa phun sum tshogs pa'i byang chub kyi sems so/ /de bzhin du sbyar te chos gnyis ni zhi gnas tshol ba dang / lhag mthong la mkhas pa'o/ /gsum ni snying rje chen po dang / stong nyid nges par sems pa dang / de la rlom sems mi byed pa'o/ /bzhi ni tshul khrims la gnas pa dang / chos la som nyi med pa dang / sgom pa la dga' ba dang / yang dag par blang ba las mi g.yo ba'o/ /lnga ni stong nyid la gnas pa dang / gzhan gyi 'khrul pa mi 'tshol ba dang /—285—

bdag la rtog pa dang / chos la dga' ba dang / gzhan la phan 'dogs pa'o/ /drug ni brkam pa dang / sdang ba dang / rmongs pa med pa gsum dang / dris ma thag tu lan yang dag par 'don pa dang / bsnyen par bla ba dang / stong pa nyid kyi spyod yul pa'o/ /bdun ni dran pa dang / chos la mkhas pa dang / brtson 'grus dang /dga' ba dang / shin sbyangs dang / ting 'dzin dang / shes rab bo/ /'di byang chub yan lag drug dang chos la mkhas pa ste bdun bgrangs pa/ chos la mkhas pa ni ji snyed pa dang / shes rab ni ji lta ba'i phyogs la gzhag pa'o/ /brgyad ni 'phags lam yan lag brgyad do/ /dgu ni snyoms par 'jug pa dgu'o/ /bcu ni rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin dang / gnas dang gnas ma yin pa la mngon par brtson pa dang / thabs kyi 'gro ba dang / rnam par snang byed dang / kun nas snang ba dang / kun tu gsal ba dang / rin chen zla ba dang / zla ba sgron me dang / rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan gyi ting nge 'dzin te ting nge 'dzin bcu'o/ /de nas mgon po byams pas bcom ldan 'das la phar phyin drug gi sgo nas bstod do/ /de nas kun dga' bos 'phags pa byams pa la bsngags pa na/ston pas mthun 'gyur mdzad de/ da ltar nga la bstod par ma zad sngon bskal pa grangs med pa bcu'i sngon rol na/ bcom ldan 'das snang bas rnam par rol pa mngon par mkhyen pa zhes bya ba byung ste/ de'i tshe bram ze'i khye'u bzang dag ces bya ba skyed mos tshal du 'gro bas sangs rgyas de mthong nas dad pa cher skyes te/bdag kyang lus 'di 'dra bar gyur cig /ces smon lam btab ste sa la nyal nas/ smon lam 'di 'grub par 'gyur na/ sangs rgyas 'di'i zhabs kyis —286—

bdag gi lus la reg par gyur cig snyam du 'dug pa na/ ston pa de'i zhabs kyi bram ze bzang dag la reg par mdzad pas/ de nyid du mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob bo/ /ston pa des 'khor rnams la'ang / bram ze'i khye'u 'di'i lus la ma 'gom zhig par bka' bsgos/ mngon shes la sogs pa'i yon tan gzhan dpag tu med pa thob nas/ ston pa de la yon tan du mas bstod pa byas so/ /bzang dag de ni sems dpa' chen po byams pa 'di yin no/ /de nas 'phags pa kun dga' bos/ byams pas de dus bzod pa thob lags na/ da dung sangs mi rgya ba'i rgyu zhus pas/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bkod pa yongs su bzung ba gnyis yod de/ dang po ni sems can gyi bkod pa dang / sems can yongs su bzung ba yin la/ gnyis pa ni zhing gi bkod pa dang zhing yongs su bzung ba'o/ /byams pa dang nga gnyis yongs su bzung ba gnyis po de'i sgo nas spyir ni 'dra'o/ /byams pa 'di ni yang dag par zhugs pa ste/ 'phags pa'i sa thob nas/ bskal pa bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis lon pa'i 'og tu/ des sems bskyed de/ de'i dbang du byas na/ bskal pa bzang po 'di 'das nas/ bskal pa dgu bcu rtsa bzhi na/ nga sangs rgya bar rigs pa las/ ngas brtson 'grus drag po brtsams nas myur du sangs rgyas pa yin no/ /myur du sangs rgya ba'i chos bcu sno gnyis gsungs te/ dang po ni/ nor dang chung ma dang bu dang / mgo dang mig dang / rgyal srid dang longs spyod dang / khrag dang rkang rus dang / yan lag thams cad sbyin pa'o/ /bcu tshan gnyis pa ni/ phar phyin gzhan lnga dang / sems can mi btang ba dang / thabs mkhas pa dang / thams cad la sems snyoms pa —287—

dang / stong pa nyid kyi chos rtogs pa dang / mashaṃ med smon med gnyis gcig tu sdoms pa'i chos rtogs pa'o/ /ngas tshor ba sdug bsngal drag pa/ tsha ba rtsub pa nyams su myong bas chos rtogs par byas te/ de yang rgyal bu gzhon nu nor thams cad sbyin pa zhes bya bar gyur nas/ nad pa la rang gi khrag sbyin pas gsos pa dang / rgyal bu me tog ces bya bar gyur nas/ skya babs kyi nad can la rang gi rkang spyin pas gsos pa dang / rgyal po zla 'od ces bya bar gyur nas/long ba la mig sbyin te des kyang mig thob pa rnams su gsungs nas/ de dag la sogs pa khrag dang rkang dang spyan sbyin par btang ba'i rnam grangs rang yang mtha' med la/ 'phags pa byams pa 'di ni sngon byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa na/ theg pa bde ba dang lam bde ba dang / 'jug pa bde bas byang chub sgrubs kyi gong gi de lta bu'i dka' ba ma spyad do/ /bde bas byang chub sgrub pa de yang thabs la mkhas pa'i khyad par gcig ni yin no/ /skabs 'dir byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa na zhes pa ni/ las dang po'i sa dang / mos spyod kyi sa'i gnas skabs la dgongs pa yin gyi/ 'phags pa'i sa thob nas ni khyad par med do/ /zhes go dgos so/ /rgyal ba ma pham pa 'di nyid kyi rnam par thar ba ni bsam gyis mi khyab pa yin pas/ mtha' gcig tu brjod pa ma yin mod/bde bas byang chub sgrub pa'i rigs cig kyang yod pas/ de'i dper brjod pa lta bur mdzad pa yin la/ nges par ni sems dpa' chen po 'di'i mdzad pa'i phyogs gcig nas/ bde ba kho nas byang chub sgrubs pa'i skabs cig kyang yod pas/ de la dgongs nas gsungs pa'i phyir/ de ltar bstan pa de drang don yang —288—

ma yin no/ /de bzhin du 'o skol gyi ston pa la yang sbyar bar bya la sangs rgyas thams cad kyang de dang 'dra'o/ /yang sngar gyi 'phros las/ de nas kun dga' bos 'phags pa byams pa'i thabs mkhas ci yin zhus pas/ kun dga' bo 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pas/ sngon byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa'i tshe/ nyin lan gsum mtshan lan gsum du bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te/thal mo sbyar nas sangs rgyas thams cad mngon sum du byas te/ tshig 'di skad ces smras so/ /sangs rgyas kun la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa nas/ sa bcu po la rab tu gnas/ kun dga' bo byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa gang la gnas nas/ thabs la mkhas pas theg pa bde ba dang / lam bde ba dang / 'jug pa bde bas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub yang dag par sgrub pa'i thabs la mkhas pa ni de yin no/ /zhes gsungs te/sngon byung rgyal ba ma pham pa la'ang de bzhin yin mod kyi/ 'di'i don gyi gtso bo rjes 'jug la dgongs te/ yan lag bdun pa 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi thabs mkhas khyad par can yin pa dang / tshegs chung ngus sdig sgrib byang zhing tshogs rdzogs pa'i thabs so/ /zhes go bar bya ba'i don no/ /yang sngar gyi 'phros las/ byams pa 'di sngon sems can smin par byed pa'i dus na/ rang gi zhing khams kyi sems can rnams dug gsum shas chung zhing / dge ba bcu la ngang gi gnas pa'i thabs kho na byas la/ ngas ni sems can dmu rgod rnams kho na dngos su 'dul ba'i smon lam snying rje chen pos kun nas blangs te btab —289—

pas de lhar gyur to/ /de phyir ngas yul rnams su chos ston pa na chad par smra ba yin no/ /rtag par smra ba yin no/ /'khor 'dod pa'o/ /'dod pa che'o zhes skur pa 'debs pa dang / sku la sa 'thor ba dang / zas su dug can 'bul ba dang /me'i dong sgrubs pa dang / mdzes ldan mas skur pa btab pa kyang / da ni snying rje chen po mdun du byas nas chos ston to/ /de nas de nyid kyi 'phros kyi zhu lan dang / chos kyi rnam grangs 'di'i mtshan bstan pa dang / rjes su yi rang rnams kyis chos kyi rnam grangs de'i don tshan rdzogs pa yin no/ /da ni gzhung dngos bshad par bya ste/ 'di la don gsum ni/ rtsa ba sems bskyed len pa/ thabs mkhas yan lag bdun pa/ 'phel byed smon lam dngos so/ /dang po la/ phyag 'tshal tshul gyis skyabs su 'gro ba/ rang rgyud dag byed stobs bzhi'i bshags pa/ smon pa sems bskyed dngos blang tshul te gsum las/ dang po ni/ sangs rgyas kun la phyag 'tshal lo sogs te/ sangs rgyas ni sku gsum gyis bsdus pa dang / don dam pa dang brdar btags pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad do/ /de la gus par bya ba'i yul gyi dbang du byas nas/ chos yang dag par bsdud pa dang / phal po che las/ sangs rgyas dkon mchog gi rnam grangs bcu gsungs pa ste/ de yang / rgyu mthun rnam smin las byung dang / /ting 'dzin smon lam sems kyi ngang / /ngo bo nyid longs rdzogs sprul pa/ /rtags dang mdun gzhag sangs rgyas so/ /de la rgyu mthun pa'i sangs rgyas ni/ phar phyin drug gi sgrub pa la spyod pa'i byang sems dang / rnam smin las byung ba'i sangs rgyas ni/ theg chen gyi yid lus dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi sangs rgyas ni/ sangs —290—

rgyas nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin las rang 'khrungs su sprul pa dang / smon lam gyi sangs rgyas ni byang sems kyi smon lam las byung ba dang / sems kyi sangs rgyas ni byang chub sems dpas sprul pa dang / de nas sku gsum nyid dang / btags pa'i sangs rgyas mkhan po dang slob dpon/ mdun du bzhag pa'i sangs rgyas ni sku gzugs rnams so/ /drang srong yang yin la lha'i mig dang ldan pa ni byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa rnams so/ /drang srong gi sgra ri ṣa zhes pa'i sgra las drangs na/ sau ni rdzu 'phrul te 'byor ba/ sha ni po ṣa dhu gso wo spyong ba ste nus mthu'i 'byor pa phun sum tshogs dang ldan la/ rang gzhan gyi nad dang sdug bsngal sogs gso zhing sbyong bar byed pa'i don no/ /yang na ṛ ga be ṣa dha ra zhes pa nges brjod cha byad 'chang ba ste/ nges pa bden pa kho na smra zhing / bden par sems la bden par byed pa yang yin/ dge sbyong ngam bram ze'i cha byed kyang 'dzin pa'i don du 'chad de/ de ltar na mthu phul du byung ba dang sems can gyi sdug bsngal sel ba dang / bden pa'i rang bzhin can gsum po de yang gzhan rnams la ni phyogs mthun dang phra mo tsam las med la/ ji lta ba bzhin du mnga' ba ni sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams so/ /cha byad 'dzin pa yang mu stegs dang / nyan thos dag gis ni thor tshugs dang / g.yang gzhi dang / chos gos gsum la sogs pa/ bcos mas gsar du sgyur ba tsam yin la/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi yid lus ni mtshan dang dpe byad phun sum tshogs pas brgyan pa/ rang bzhin gyis grub cing chos nyid kyis thob pa yin no/ /yang drang po'i lam gzhung srong bar byed pa'i phyir/ drang —291—

srong ste drang po ni mtha' gnyis spangs pa'am/ bden pa'i don la 'chad dgos pa'i phyir/ bden pa bzhi'i sgo nas gang zag gi bdag med pa dang / bden pa gnyis kyi sgo nas chos kyi bdag med pa'i lam ston pa'o/ /lha mig ni lha'i mig gi mngon shes nyid kyang yin la/ gzhan du na 'gro ba drug las 'das pa'i lha ni lha mchog ste/ theg chen 'phags pa rnams yin la/mig ni gsal bar mthong ba dbang po'i don te/ shes rab kyi dbang pos ji lta ji snyed gzigs pa dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang po spyod yul sna tshogs pa bsgyur ba dang / dbang po lnga gzhan du gyur pa la sogs pa'i mngon shes sna tshogs pa mthu thob pa las byung ba rnams so/ /yang zhes pas chos dkon mchog kyang zhor la 'phangs te de ltar na theg chen pa'i skyabs yul dkon mchog gsum po dngos rnams yin la/ nyan thos rnams zhes pa ni/ rgyun zhugs dang phyir 'ong dang / phyi mi 'ong dang dgra bcom pa ste/ de dag kyang zhugs pa dang 'bras gnas kyi dbye bas/ gang zag ya brgyad dam skyes bu zung bzhi ste/ rnams zhes pa mang po'i tshig go /rang rgyal rnams kyang nyan thos dang lta spyod sgom pa gsum mthun pa'i phyir/ de'i nang du bsdus pa yin la/ nyan thos las rang rgyal mchog tu gyur pa'i phyir/ mchog dman par bsdu ba mi rigs so snyam na/ mchog dman gyi cha nas de ltar bden yang nyan thos mang ba'i phyir mang bar bsdus pa'am/ rang rgyal rnams ni spyir btang na/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i dngos kyi 'khor du mi 'byung bar grags pa dang / de ma zad bstan pa gnas pa'i sa phyogs su yang mi 'byung zhing / lung gi chos ston pa po yang min pas/ dge 'dun —292—

du 'jog pa'i cha nas nyan thos gtso che ba yin no/ /dag pa'i zhing dang theg chen gyi lam du zhugs pa dang / theg pa chen po mdo sngags kyi sde snod la dmigs te/de'i 'bras bu thob pa dang / sprul pa'i rang rgyal rnams ni dmigs gsal yin pa'i phyir nges pa de yang med mod/ re zhig thun mong gi rnam gzhag gtso che bar byas pa'o/ /theg dman 'phags pa 'di dag 'jig rten gyi yon gnas chen por gyur pa nyid kyis na 'jig rten gyi ngo bsrung ba'i phyir dang / theg dman gyi rigs can rjes su bzung ba'i phyir dang / theg pa chen por rlom pa'i nga rgyal gzhig pa'i phyir dang / yon tan che 'bring chung ngu dang ldan pa gang la yang dad pa bskyed dgos pa'i phyir dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs cung zad sad pa yin pas na/ rgyal ba'i sras kyi cha shas su chud pas/ ma 'ongs pa na sangs rgyas su 'gyur nges pa'i phyir dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhabs 'bring du gnas pa yin pas/ sangs rgyas la gus pa bskyed pa'i phyir dang / bka' bzhin du sgrub pas na/ bzang 'dun la gcig tu zhugs pa'i phyir dang / chos la thun mong du zhugs nas mthun par bgo bsha' byed pas/ skrun zla nye ba lta bur gyur pa'i phyir dang / 'phags pa'i sa ma thob pa rnams kyis ni/ yon tan 'ga' zhig gis lhag pa'i phyir yang byang chub sems dpa' nyan thos la phyag 'tshal ba'i gnas skabs yod cing / rgyu mtshan phyi ma de dang / thos pa la sogs pa'i phyir/ skyabs su 'gro ba'i skabs kyang yod do/ / sems yang dag par bskyed pa'i don dang /lam mthar thug pa la dkri ba'i don dang / 'phags mchog rnams kyi dbang du byas nas ni/ skyabs su 'gro ba yang min la phyag 'tshal ba yang min no/ /de'i —293—

phyir 'dir smos pa yang / bsod nams 'phel ba'i phyir zhor la bstan pa yin gyi/ sems bskyed pa'i yan lag tu ma yin no/ /thun mong ma yin pa'i skyabs dang phyag gi yul bstan pa ni ngan 'gro las ni ldog bgyid cing sogs te/ de yang byang chub kyi sems yin la tshigs bcad 'di ni phyag 'tshal ba'i tshul gyis sems bskyed kyi phan yon dran pas de len 'dod bskyed dgos pa bstan to/ /de ni snying rje chen po dang stong pa nyid kyi ye shes zung du 'jug pa ste/ re zhig lam gyi dbang du byas na/ snying rje chen po bdag gzhan brje ba la sogs pa'i byang chub kyi sems kyis kyang / las ngan dpag tu med pa zad cing phyin chad sdom par 'gyur bas/ ngan 'gro las ldog pa dang / sems bskyed pa nyid kyi phan yon las/ lha dang mi'i gtso bo'i go 'phang lan shin tu mang ba thob par yang 'gyu/ra la/ sems bskyed las tshul khrims la sogs pa dge ba mtha' yas pa 'byung ba'i phyir/ mtho ris kyi lam ston pa dang / rga shi med pa'i gnas sangs rgyas kyi sar 'dren par byed pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa'o/ /yang stong nyid rtogs pa'i ye shes kyis kyang / ngan 'gro dang de'i rgyu sa bon dang bcas pa spong bar byed cing / de las dge ba dpag tu med pa 'phel ba dang / rga shi med pa 'phags pa'i sa dngos su sgrub par byed pa yin no/ /yang na stong nyid rtogs pa las rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba shes la/ de las kun rdzob tu las 'brel phyin ci ma log pa rtogs pas snga ma gnyis dang / don dam du 'khor ba rtsa bral du rtogs pas/ rga shi med par 'dren zhes kyang sbyar ro/ /yang na byang chub kyi —294—

sems ni don dam pa'i chos nyid zung du 'jug pa'i ye shes yin la/ de la dmigs te sgoms pas phan yon gsum po de 'byung zhes kyang sbyar ro/ /glegs bam 'ga' zhig las/ thar pa'i lam ni rab ston la zhes 'byung ba la kha cig ngan 'gro las ldog pa'i nang du mtho ris kyi lam ston pa ni 'dus la/ thar pa'i lam ni theg pa gsum gyi lam thams cad spyir bstan pa dang / rga shi med pa ni sangs rgyas kyi byang chub kho na ste/ skyes bu gsum gyi rim pa dang yang sbyor bar bzhed do/ /de la rga shi med pa dngos ni/ de kho na yin te/ nyan rang rnams kyis ma rig bag chags kyi sa dang zag med kyi las ma spangs pas/ yid kyi lus la de nyid du gtogs pa'i skye 'chi'i bye brag mang du yod pa'i phyir ro/ / 'on kyang khams gsum 'khor ba'i skye 'chi spangs pa'i phyir/ thun mong gi gtam la rga shi med par yang grags so/ /de la 'di ni theg chen thun mong ma yin pa la 'jug pa'i phyir/ skyes bu gsum dang sbyar ba mtha' gcig tu dgos nges min pas/ re zhig dkyus ni sngar bstan pa de yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ sems kyi dbang du gyur pas na sogs te sems ni kun gzhi rnam shes te/ de la las nyon gyi bag chags yod pa mthu brtas pa'i dbang las/ nyon mongs mngon gyur pas sdig pa bsags zhes kyang sbyar la/ dngos su na sems te 'dod chags sogs nyon mongs kyi dbang du gyur pa zhes sbyar ro/ /'di la kun slong nyon mongs dang / las dngos dang / bshags pa'i yul dang /bshags pa dngos rnams rkang pa re re ste tshig don rnams go sla'o/ /dbang du gyur zhes pas sun 'byin pa dang / sdig pa zhes pas yid du mi 'ong ba de slar —295—

zlog par ston/ sangs rgyas zhes pas rten te dkar po'i sa bon shugs la 'phangs so/ /gsum pa ni/ bdag las rnam pa gsum gang gi sogs te las gsum ni lus ngag yid kyi las zhes sbyar yang rung mod kyi/ 'dir ni smon pa sems bskyed kyi cho ga rgyal tshab byams pa nyid kyi lugs las 'byung ba'i cho ga'i tshig rgyas pa dang dngos su sbyar rgyu yod pas/ 'di ltar bshad par bya ste/ bdag gi las sbyin pa'i las dang / tshul khrims kyi las dang / sgom pa'i las gsum gyi bsod nams te dge ba'i las su gyur pa/ 'khor ba thog med nas da lta yan chad du bsags pa thams cad/ byang chub kyi sems kyis bzung ste/ sangs rgyas kyi rgyur dmigs nas bzhag pa ste/ nam zhig sangs rgyas thob par 'gyur ba'i rgyu tshogs kyi sa bon nam bskyed 'phel gyi rtsa bar byas nas/ dge ba 'di las dge ba gzhan rab tu spel te/ bdag sems can gyi don du sangs rgyas su gyur cig /ces bsam pa'o/ /'dir gyur cig ces pa smon lam gdab pa kho na ma yin te smon sems len pa'i cho ga'o/ /des na 'dir sa bon zhes pa ni rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs yin la/ sems can gang ci yang rung ste de thams cad kyi rgyud la 'bras bu gsum smin zin pa dang ma zin pa'i dge ba rigs gnyis ka yang med pa ni mi srid la/ de tsam gyis rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs dngos su ni mi 'gyur mod dge ba'i sa bon de slar yang dge ba gsar pa gcig gis gsos btab la/de g.yin phan byang chub kyi sems kyis bzung nas/ bdag gi dge ba gsar rnying 'di kun gyi mthu las bdag ma 'ongs pa na sangs rgyas su gyur na ci ma rung / da —296—

lta'i dge ba 'di las dge ba gzhan spel nas/ bdag sangs rgyas su bya'o snyom pa'i bsam pa bcos ma ma yin pa skyes pa tshun chad nas/ de lta bu'i dge ba'i sa bon de ni rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs yin te/ lam gyi chos thams cad kyi 'phel ba'i gzhi yin la/ de ni byang chub ma thob bar du chud mi za ba shin tu brtan pa yang yin cing / phyin chad sems bskyed kyis zin pa dang ma zin pa'i dge ba rang gis byas pa thams cad kyis de rgyas par 'gyur bas/ de rnams de rgyas byed yin no/ /de ltar na sems bskyed kyi cho ga chen po las/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas sngon 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas tha ma da lta la thug gi bar du sbyin pa las byung ba dang / tshul khrims las byung ba dang / sgom pa las byung ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba bdag gis bgyis pa dang / bgyid du rtsal ba dang / bgyid pa las rjes su yi rang ba las byung ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba des/ zhes 'byung ba ste/ gzhung 'dir bdag las rnam pa gsum gang gis/ bsod nams tshogs ni bskyed pa ste/bdag gi kun mkhyen sa bon te/ /zhes bsdus te gsungs par snang la/ skabs 'dir dge ba'i rtsa ba dang sa bon yang ming gi rnam grangs su 'gyur ro/ khren tu bsdus pa la/ bdag gi sbyin sogs bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyis/ zhes 'don pa de'o/ /bdag gi byang chub ces pa ni/ ma 'ongs pa na bdag gis thob par gyur pa'i byang chub de ni/ 'khor ba ji srid bar ram/ nam mkha' ji srid bar/sku dang ye shes dang phrin las zad pa med par gyur cig ces smon pa ste/ mi zad pa de ni nyan rang gi byang chub la med pas/ bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi khyad chos yin la/ dge ba de chos dbyings dang ro gcig tu bsngos pas kyang mi zad pa'i —297—
